jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We Are:
Accenture Strategy. We empower clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now, and the unknown through deep industry expertise , analytics, and insights. To stay agile in a world dominated by chan ge, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously driving the total reinvention of its business. Accenture Strategy enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:
An early-career strategy consulting professional with foundational experience in banking and financial services. Your background includes supporting engagement delivery, building analytical frameworks, and contributing to client workstreams across banking and capital markets. You are comfortable working across operating model design, governance assessments, and digital transformation topics, and you bring strong problem-solving skills and are building toward independent client engagement, including presenting analysis and supporting client conversations.

As a consultant, you are eager to develop your expertise and take ownership of analytical tasks and workstream deliverables. You have excellent communication skills and a strong desire to work in a fast-paced environment.

The Work:

- Support delivery of strategy and transformation projects for banking clients, including work across commercial banking, lending, deposits, treasury management, payments, and digital banking

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative research to develop insights, benchmarking, and analysis that inform recommendations provided to client

- Build models, frameworks, and structured deliverables including presentations, Excel analyses, and written memos in support of engagement workstreams

- Contribute to operating model assessments, governance and risk framework design, and go-to-market strategy work for banking clients

- Participate in client workshops and meetings, and support the preparation of materials and follow-up documentation

- Support digital transformation workstreams, including exposure to operating model design, regulatory considerations, and emerging technology trends

- Apply AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and deliverable production; support client conversations on where AI can improve banking workflows

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Accenture’s Strategy and Consulting, Technology, and Operations practices

- Contribute to internal banking practice development, including market research, offering materials, and sector knowledge bases

- Travel may be required based on client demand. Accenture promotes a client-centric, flexible work environment

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum 3 years of relevant professional services experience in management consulting or technology consulting

- Minimum 2 years of experience working with banking or capital markets clients, including exposure to topics such as operating models, digital transformation, risk and compliance, or financial crime

- Minimum 1 year of experience designing or assessing operating models, governance structures, or risk and control frameworks for financial services clients

- Minimum 2 years of experience building quantitative or financial models to support client recommendations

-  Bachelor’s degree

Bonus Points if:
- You have experience with digital assets within banking and capital markets, including strategy or operating model design

- You have contributed to next-generation analytic capabilities such as AI, GenAI, or data models within financial services

- You have demonstrated experience supporting senior client relationships and managing stakeholder communications

- You have an advanced degree or financial industry certification

- You have experience preparing written client deliverables and presenting analysis to client audiences

- You have experience supporting multiple client workstreams at the same time

- Leverage your relationship and stakeholder management skills to accomplish team objectives
- Communicate with excellence (written, conversational and presentation delivery)

We are looking for experience in the following skills:
- Strong industry experience in utilities (particularly generation, transmission & distribution, electric vehicles or retail energy)
- Broad knowledge of global power and/or energy markets in context of current low carbon energy transition, including drivers and challenges
- Technical expertise and understanding of low-carbon asset development and asset operations, including best practice processes/activities/ways of working content
- Experience of working with technical & engineering stakeholders to drive operational excellence within the low carbon power sector, including process optimisation
- Experience of designing new business models or transforming existing ones, including organisational development, capability mapping and operating model change
- Expert knowledge in specific element of the energy system (e.g. gas to hydrogen, balancing markets/ancillary services, etc)

jobs.title: Digital Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Digital Finance Transformation Manager
Career level: Manager (CL7)  |  Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh  |  Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Platform Transformation)

Why this role
This is where a finance-transformation manager takes ownership of the design in front of the client. You'll lead the finance design on major transformation programmes: running the discovery, settling the process and enterprise-structure decisions everything downstream depends on, and holding the line on them with finance leadership. Much of that work sits where systems meet: where the finance core hands off to consolidation, planning and reporting, and where the enterprise structure has to hold across all of them. You advise on the right finance technology and target operating model for the problem, whatever the client runs, and you grow from here into a design authority clients ask for by name.
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that, bringing the CFO agenda to life for clients: stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.
"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring

Fit-to-standard and finance process design. You lead fit-to-standard and process design across the core finance processes (Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Purchase-to-Pay and Acquire-to-Retire) and across general accounting, close and consolidation, external and management reporting, intercompany, finance master data and finance controls. You take a client's requirements, run a structured fit-gap, and turn the result into a process design the business will run. That design closes faster, reports with more confidence, and strengthens control. Where the client wants something the standard doesn't do, you're the person who works out whether the answer is to change the process or change the design, and can argue either case on its merits.

Enterprise structure and chart of accounts. You can design and defend the finance backbone: legal-entity and company-code structure, ledgers, the controlling and profit-centre model, cost-centre and hierarchy design, and the chart of accounts across it. These decisions are expensive to revisit once a programme is moving, so you'll bring a point of view: what the reporting and statutory requirements demand, where a dimension serves better than an account, and how the structure holds as the group changes shape.

Finance design authority and senior stakeholder management. You own the design end to end in front of the client: chairing the design conversations, bringing options and a recommendation, writing the decision papers and driving them to closure. You work directly with finance leadership, from controllers and FP&A leads to process owners and the CFO's team, taking a contested design point, explaining the trade-off in business terms and getting an answer. You set the design standard for the finance workstream and coach the consultants around you.

Technology selection, vendor assessment and the value case. You lead technology selection and vendor assessment: framing the criteria, comparing platforms against what the client needs, and building a defensible recommendation and roadmap. You own the value case and business case behind it: the benefits, the cost of the change, and how the return on a platform investment gets tracked once the programme starts, argued in the terms a CFO signs off against.

AI in finance processes, and in how we deliver. You'll bring a working fluency in what AI is doing to the finance function, enough to hold a credible conversation with finance leadership: where it changes a process, whether reconciliations, close tasks, intercompany matching or forecasting, where it does not yet, and what has to be true of the data and controls first. You design AI-enabled ways of working into the target process: what an agent runs, what a person approves, where the human check and the audit trail sit. The same judgement applies to how we work. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, and you decide where AI-augmented delivery earns its place and what the team reuses. If your AI experience is newer than the rest of your track record, tell us what you've done with it.

Platform literacy and integration judgement. You've delivered on enterprise finance platform programmes (SAP, Oracle or comparable finance platforms) and you understand how one runs: how a design gets built, what "standard" means in practice, and what a technology decision costs downstream. Finance rarely sits on one system, so you can work through how the finance core connects to what surrounds it: the master data that has to agree, the interfaces between them, and the reporting layer reading from both. Where a process crosses that boundary, you design it to hold on both sides.

Target operating model and design-thinking delivery. You shape the operating model around the design: how the finance function, its shared-services or GBS arrangements and its process ownership need to work once the platform lands. You facilitate design-thinking workshops, co-develop solutions with the client in the room, and secure design decisions in an agile, iterative way, not through documents alone.

Shaping the work. At this level you start to see the next piece of work before anyone asks for it. You'll spot where a client has an unaddressed problem, shape a proposition around it with the team, and contribute to how we position and solution it. Origination and deal shaping are part of the Manager trajectory here, not something reserved for the level above.

Who you are

You take ownership and follow through, and you're comfortable being the person the client turns to when a design decision is stuck. You work well with ambiguity in a complex finance organisation and can hold a clear view without needing to win the room. You lead a team well, build trusted relationships across a client's management, and manage expectations and timelines when more is asked of the design than it can carry. You're closely engaged with what AI is changing in finance: you've formed your own view, and can advise a client on it instead of repeating what a vendor told them.

Things that set strong candidates apart: a track record (typically 7+ years) designing finance transformation on enterprise platform programmes; experience across more than one ERP or finance platform; work at the seams, where finance integrates with the systems and processes around it; leading a technology selection and the business case behind it through to a decision; depth in enterprise structure and chart-of-accounts design; designing AI-enabled ways of working into a finance process on a live programme; shaping new work with a client; an awareness of how controls, intercompany or tax shape a design; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team working at the design and advisory end of platform transformation, helping clients choose the right platform and design the process, enterprise structure and operating model around it, rather than building the customisations and enhancements that sit underneath it. We're a close team that enjoys the work and each other's company, and we keep looking for better ways to do it instead of repeating what worked last time. We mix platform, process, data, AI and advisory backgrounds on the same team on purpose, because that mix reaches better answers than any one background alone.

- Mandatory: Advanced level of English

- Track record designing and delivering community health programs, primary care strengthening initiatives, aged care initiatives or NCD prevention strategies.
- Experience with immunization program governance, communicable disease response, or maternal and child health program design.
- Familiarity with health equity frameworks and social determinants of health (SDOH) integration in government health programs.

- Experience leading operating model redesign, health service delivery restructuring, or health system performance improvement for public sector clients.
- Experience of shaping digital transformation roadmap, orchestrating large programs with multiple vendors and advise public health entities on vendor selection
- Familiarity with national digital health strategies and health information system (HIS) transformation in EMEA/APAC contexts.
- Program management experience for execution of public health transformation programs

International Development & Global Health:

Market and Domain Experience

jobs.description:
Oracle Finance Transformation Senior Manager
Career level : Senior Manager (CL6)
Location : London / Manchester / Edinburgh
Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle)

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the  Finance Reinvention Partner  helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.
You'd help lead our  Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led Oracle finance transformations, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to shape deep Oracle finance work and the offering around it, close to the CFO agenda it serves.

Why this role

This is a lead role for an all-Oracle finance architect — someone who can stand in front of a client and take an entire Oracle finance engagement from design through delivery. You'll own the finance solution across the Oracle estate, set the standard others build to, grow the accounts you work on, and shape how we deliver platform-led Oracle finance transformation.
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and  Finance  is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.
"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring

Your Oracle expertise.  You know Oracle finance across the estate. You're deep in Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and strong across the EPM suite — Planning (EPBCS), Consolidation (FCCS) and enterprise data management (EDMCS) — or the reverse, with the range to lead across both. You bring authority over enterprise structure, chart of accounts and finance master data, and the breadth to cover the Oracle finance modules a typical implementation touches. Depth in Oracle Subledger Accounting, Integration Cloud (OIC), profitability (PCMCS) or Oracle's embedded Fusion AI and agents broadens where you can lead.

Finance process knowledge.  Real depth across the finance process spine — Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay — and the judgement to connect the Oracle solution to what the CFO cares about: performance, control, and reporting the business can trust. Strength across consolidation and group reporting, management reporting, and intercompany and transfer pricing, with an eye for finance controls by design.

Leading the solution and the programme.  You own the end-to-end Oracle finance solution and integration architecture and act as the finance design authority — making the calls that hold a programme together, from fit-to-standard and functional design through testing and deployment. You lead programmes and workstreams in front of the client, manage senior stakeholders with authority, and lead and coach the team around you.

Growing the work.  You grow the accounts you work on — spotting where Oracle finance transformation can do more for the client, and helping turn that into work. You also help build the wider Oracle finance pipeline, shaping propositions and supporting new business beyond your own accounts.

Ways of working.  We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. Experience of AI-augmented delivery, or of Oracle's embedded Fusion AI and agents, is a real plus.

#LI-EU
#LI-MP

Who you are

You lead with authority and earn trust fast with senior finance and executive stakeholders. You run the room in a design workshop and bring people with you. You have the breadth to hold an entire Oracle finance engagement in your head and the critical thinking to keep it coherent under pressure. You have commercial instinct and a nose for where an account can grow. You're a genuine team player who develops the people around you, and you're known for sound, decisive calls.
Things that set strong candidates apart: Oracle certification; a track record leading large-scale, multi-pillar Oracle finance programmes end to end; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
You may not have done every part of this. If it's the shape of what you do, we'd like to talk.

What's in it for you

Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

jobs.description:
The work
We are Accenture’s Corporate Strategy & Growth (CS&G) practice. We help shape our clients’ strategy from the C-Suite level and thus enable them to deliver high performance and achieve growth that is sustainable. We own the strategic narrative and orchestrate strategic transformations. As part of our fast-growing Corporate Strategy & Growth team, we are looking for a Strategy Consultant. As a consultant you will work in a high-performance environment with young and enthusiastic colleagues to address priority C-suite issues with precision and speed. You will take on responsibility for your own workstreams within projects and give guidance to analysts. You will also be involved in actively growing and developing our Amsterdam-based team, where you can express your entrepreneurial capabilities.
- Team: The CS&G team operates across Europe as a strategy-only function. You will be part of our diverse, European-wide network of 124 colleagues. At the same time, you will start in our small and ambitious Dutch team which aims to grow quickly during the coming years. We are uniquely positioned to work together with our great Amsterdam-based Accenture colleagues, while being backed by our European network.
- Daily tasks: As part of a project team, you will be directly on-site with clients, developing strategies around growth, digital transformation, go-to-market strategy, and new digital business models. In our projects you will come together with motivated and ambitious colleagues from both the Amsterdam location and the European CS&G team to analyze our clients’ strategic challenges, solve complex problems, and help them determine strategic direction, vision and goals.
- Technology: You will lead with insight: use of advanced data, analytics and AI, and human-centric design to co-create and implement technology-enabled, disruptive strategies and solutions that win competitive advantage, unlock value and drive growth for clients
- Data: Data has a crucial role in your job. You make data-driven decisions. Combined with critical thinking, experience, and input from others you will bring resolutions for complex problems. You understand and know how to leverage the power of data while remaining conscious of data privacy and data security.

In today’s world, business leaders want to rapidly and confidently reinvent to increase resilience, mitigate risk, and grow with sustainable value. You will be a trusted partner to business leaders, working with a diverse team of experts to deliver successful tech-enabled transformation and new kinds of value for your clients. Join our global network of people using the latest assets, platforms and partnerships to help bring ideas to life.

Strategy & Consulting is one of five services that make up one Accenture – the others are Operations, Technology, Song and Industry X.

Corporate Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Join Accenture's Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) team and play a key role in evaluating and executing strategic acquisitions that shape the future of our business. Working alongside experienced professionals across Corporate Development, Strategy, Finance, and Technology, you will help assess acquisition opportunities, identify financial risks, and support successful integrations.
At Accenture, we take a disciplined, value-focused approach to M&A, combining deep financial analysis with strategic insight to ensure every acquisition creates long-term value.
As a Mergers & Acquisitions Specialist, you will serve as a trusted Financial Due Diligence advisor throughout the acquisition lifecycle, from opportunity assessment to deal completion and post-merger integration.

Key Responsibilities
- Support acquisitions from the early evaluation stages through closing and post-deal integration activities

- Partner closely with Accenture's Europe Financial Due Diligence Lead and Corporate Development teams

- Analyze target companies' financial performance, profitability, and operational metrics to assess business quality and growth potential

- Evaluate key balance sheet components, including net working capital and net financial debt

- Identify financial risks, opportunities, and areas requiring further investigation during the due diligence process

- Provide insights regarding transaction structures, purchase price adjustment mechanisms, and Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) negotiations

- Support business, commercial, and financial integration activities to help maximize value creation following acquisitions

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Finance, Legal, Strategy, and Integration functions

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. - Degree in economic sciences, business administration, finance, or a related topic, ideally combined with a CA, ACA, CPA, MBA, or CFA qualification (completed or in the process of completion)

- Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience – for example in financial due diligence or an audit role – within the M&A Due Diligence department of one of the big four professional services firms or another big corporation

- Track record in working on several financial due diligence projects

- In-depth skills in financial analysis and MS Excel and fluency in English

We Are:
Accenture Song, a new breed of agency that is all about the Experience. For us, customer experience is not an add-on; it is foundational to who we are and how we empower our clients. As the world’s largest, most disruptive agency, we drive lasting growth for clients by helping them design, build, and run meaningful experiences that make people’s lives better, more productive, and more meaningful. We do this in three ways: by transforming organizations through standout products and services; by building and delivering award-winning campaigns so brands can engage and communicate creatively with customers at scale; and by using our top-notch skills to pilot, integrate, scale, and run the platforms that underpin the world’s greatest experiences. Visit us at: Accenture Song

You Are:
You are a growth strategist, problem solver, storyteller, and hands-on operator who is energized by helping clients answer hard growth questions.
You are comfortable working through ambiguity, structuring complex business problems, and turning customer, market, competitive, and commercial insight into clear recommendations. You enjoy moving from strategy to execution, shaping growth opportunities, building business cases, supporting executive workshops, and translating ideas into practical roadmaps clients can act on.
You bring experience in consulting, strategy, innovation, startups, venture-building, corporate strategy, or an adjacent field. You are highly comfortable using AI and GenAI tools to improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of your work, and you are curious about how new ways of working can make strategy delivery sharper and more effective.
You will join Accenture Song Canada’s Customer Growth Strategy team, helping deliver client engagements focused on customer-led growth, innovation strategy, growth diagnostics, business case development, customer insight, operating model design, and transformation value realization.

The Work:
- Support delivery of customer growth strategy engagements, including growth diagnostics, growth acceleration sprints, opportunity assessments, business cases, and transformation value realization work
- Structure ambiguous client problems into clear workplans, hypotheses, analyses, and executive-ready recommendations
- Conduct market, customer, competitor, and industry research to identify growth opportunities, risks, demand shifts, and strategic implications
- Synthesize qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, market, and digital signals into actionable customer and commercial insights
- Develop growth opportunity maps, value pools, prioritization frameworks, customer journeys, value propositions, and strategic roadmaps
- Support innovation strategy work, including whitespace identification, new product / service / business concept development, opportunity validation, and growth portfolio prioritization
- Build business cases for growth opportunities, including market sizing, value drivers, investment requirements, risks, assumptions, and expected outcomes
- Support operating model work for organizations looking to organize, govern, fund, and scale growth more effectively
- Design and support client workshops, stakeholder interviews, executive working sessions, and internal strategy sessions
- Translate analysis and insight into compelling executive narratives, recommendations, and client-ready materials
- Support growth-related transformation work by connecting platform, data, AI, commerce, service, and operating model initiatives to measurable customer and commercial outcomes
- Work with senior leaders and cross-functional Accenture teams across Song, Strategy, Technology, Data & AI, Operations, and industry groups
- Apply AI tools and new ways of working to improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of research, analysis, synthesis, and content development
- Contribute to reusable Customer Growth assets, methods, frameworks, thought leadership, case examples, and practice knowledge
- Support business development activities where needed, including account research, opportunity hypotheses, proposal materials, pursuit support, and executive briefing documents

jobs.title: Strategy Analyst (Commodity Markets)
jobs.description:
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. We combine unmatched experience and specialized capabilities across more than 40 industries – powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. With 738,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings continuous innovation to help clients improve their performance and create lasting value across their enterprises. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

Through deep industry expertise , analytics and insights, Accenture Strategy empower s clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now and the unknown. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously identifying and investing in the new. Accenture Strategy consulting enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

The Accenture Commodity Markets, part of Accenture Strategy, is a global practice operating across multiple industries. It is one of the few global strategy practices which provides a very steep cross-industry learning curve and a truly global professional experience, working with organizations focused on commodity production, trading, logistics and marketing.

We combine our unique industry knowledge in the energy, chemicals, soft commodities, agriculture, metals, mining, utilities, transportation and consumer goods amongst others with analytics-powered core strategy consulting skills, digital and applied intelligence to create unsurpassed value for our clients across the world.

We are known within Accenture for the variety and complexity of business issues we solve for our clients, our close-knit global team, empowerment of resources to hold responsibility early on, potential for rapid career progression and international exposure, having delivered projects in over 25 countries. Further, our group creates a diverse, multi- cultural and multi-functional environment for you to learn, develop and succeed.

Our four core capability areas are:
1) Trading and Risk Management: working with commodity-centric organizations to set-up and expand their commodity trading and risk management activities, partnering with them to optimize product margin, enhance supply certainty, and reduce price/volumetric volatility through state-of-the-art analytics, AI, and risk management techniques.

2) Investment Valuation & Financial Structuring: We work collaboratively with clients to shape investment / divestment transactions, devise investment strategies, support corporate restructuring, capital planning, balance-sheet optimization and other core strategic priorities around their asset portfolio.

3) Optimization: Also , we help clients create value by optimizing their value chain, be it through developing a new strategic direction because of digital disruption or market uncertainty, helping them grow and enter new markets, or even devising new, innovative and agile business models to help them pivot to the New. Underpinning this work, we also regularly partner with our clients to enhance their corporate functions' strategies and agility in support of the wider business model and strategic plan.

4 ) Energy Transition: Finally, we work with clients to shape their strategies to develop new businesses on the energy transition and shape their overall go to market approach, operating model and implementation for these new business models such as electricity, hydrogen, carbon markets, etc.

Key responsibilities:

Client Delivery and Development

- Global project experience both in Thailand but also in Southeast Asia and globally as part of the Accenture Commodity Markets Global Strategy project staffing pool

- Work within cross-office project and client teams including both Thailand and global Accenture Commodity Markets to solve complex business issues in one of our three core capability areas, bringing structure and rigorous quantitative and qualitative skills to deliver actionable recommendations, insights and results

- Work within project workstreams with supervision to identify value creation opportunities for our clients

- Work on and develop elements of analysis required to support project delivery

- Support client interviews and workshops, develop presentation materials and recommendations

- Work on topics including corporate strategy development, trading and risk management capability set-up, operating model design, commercial optimization, investment valuation and financial structuring, balance sheet analysis , energy market liberalization, energy transition and advanced numerical modelling of energy and commodity markets

Practice Building

- Contribute to developing Thailand & Global Accenture Commodity Markets and wider Accenture Strategy practice and community, and building Accenture Commodity Markets offerings, assets and thought leadership

- Support internal Business Development activities by conducting and managing industry and company-specific research (competitors, market scanning and market fundamentals, financials, customers, etc.), as well as the development of client proposal presentations

Required Qualifications

- A n undergraduate degree or master’s degree from a leading academic institution

- Y ou’ll need to be a critical, creative and deep strategic thinker and able to break down and solve problems structurally and be able to demonstrate project evidence of this on your CV

- It’s also important that you are a natural leader, effective relationship builder and collaborative teammate who’s digitally savvy and up for a challenge

- With strong communication skills, you should feel comfortable leading workshops and have good presentation skills

- You will also need to be intellectually curious, eager to learn and have a desire to help companies turn disruption into opportunity through strategies that enable them to successfully execute with equal strength across growth, profitability sustainability and trust

- You should have the ability to work effectively in ambiguous and ever-changing environments

- Quantitative and analytical skills and a real passion for business and technology are key . Ideally, you will have taken classes in statistics or data analytics and will know how to work data visualisation tools ( PowerBI , Tableau, Alteryx) or programming languages (R, Python, Julia, SQL)

- Experience in international or multicultural work and education would be preferable

- An interest in commodities markets, the energy sector and the energy transition are highly desirable

- Proficiency to communicate verbally and in writing in English and Thai

Why join us?

- We offer a differentiated , fast paced approach career progression and employee offering which is unique to Strategy , with a focus on your strengths and continuous coaching from senior colleagues  in Thailand and Global Accenture Commodity Markets

- You will have the chance to work with leading business executives in Thailand and globally to drive the most pressing business issues of our time and solve top-agenda topics with our clients

- You will have the opportunity to work within Thailand as well as travel in Southeast Asia and globally for strategy projects , providing professional development opportunities around the world throughout Global Accenture Commodity Markets network

- You will  benefit from working alongside Accenture experts who are solving some of the biggest industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools

- Flexible work arrangements and a range of benefits including competitive rewards

- You will have access to state-of-the-art technology that will give you the opportunity to deepen your existing skills even as you help create the latest business trends

jobs.description:
Accenture, coined by Bloomberg as “ World’s most acquisitive firm ”, is seeking a highly qualified professional to join the North America Corporate Development (Corp Dev) team as a manager. The Corp Dev team is responsible for identifying, executing and integrating inorganic growth opportunities that advance the Firm's strategic objectives. This team directly works with Senior Leadership and is accountable for all elements of the deal lifecycle from origination through integration of an acquisition.

The responsibilities of this position include deal structuring and coordinating due diligence, as well as negotiating efforts using expertise in the development of business cases, valuations, investment scenario modeling, and leading post merger integration. The PMI Manager leads the mobilization of all front and back-office teams, establishes the governance framework, and works with Senior Leadership to design the operating and integration models for of Accenture’s acquired firms.

Responsibilities:
Responsibilities of the Corp Dev Manager position include but are not limited to:
- Participate in merger and acquisition ( M&A) pipeline development

- Evaluate and summarize M&A prospect information discovered through marketing materials, public filings, meetings & calls, and various other sources

- Develop and oversee financial models to evaluate a target's financial projections and perform comprehensive financial valuations involving discounted cash flow, accretion dilution, and comparable company/transaction analysis

- Compile summary materials for internal management and Investment Committee approval

- Perform industry and financial analysis leading to investment recommendations

- Develop a negotiation strategy and lead relevant negotiation efforts

- Present to Senior Leadership

- Lead workshops across the deal lifecycle ensuring relevant objectives are achieved

- Actively lead and manage various internal and external stakeholders

Program Management including:
- Due Diligence efforts amongst internal and external parties

- Meeting Coordination: development of agenda, minutes, and follow-up on actions

- Workplan management across all Workstreams ( e.g., Go-to-Market, HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Tax, Workplace)

- Milestone tracking (delayed, at risk, on track)

- Document PMI progress, prepare Status Reports for PMI Status Meetings with Workstream leads and PMI Leadership Meetings with Sponsoring Accenture Organization and acquired Company

- Participate in the development of Intellectual Property, including AI Agents, lessons learned, best practices, briefing decks, and templates

Travel Expectations : up to 35%

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Business Operations or Finance at a large corporation
- Bachelor’s Degree
- Minimum of 3 years of experience leading a team

- Exposure to M&A activity

jobs.title: Life Sciences Consultant — Commercial Strategy
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
Overview ​

Join our Life Sciences Industry & Enterprise practice to help leading pharma, biotech, and medtech clients define commercial strategy and reinvent how commercial work gets done. This role focuses on supporting strategy work across asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, market access, patient services, functional transformation, operating model, process redesign, and AI/data-enabled reinvention. ​

​

What would you do? ​

As a Consultant, you will support client workstreams that help life sciences organizations make critical commercial decisions — from how to launch and grow assets to how to redesign functions and enterprise ways of working. ​

Your work could include: ​

- Supporting asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, market access, patient services, and broader commercial strategy projects ​

- Assessing market dynamics, customer needs, competitive landscapes, access considerations, and commercial growth opportunities ​

- Supporting functional or enterprise reinvention work across operating model, process, governance, capability, and talent implications ​

- Identifying where AI, analytics, automation, copilots, or agentic workflows can improve commercial decision-making or execution ​

- Translating research, interviews, benchmarks, and data inputs into clear hypotheses, insights, and client-ready recommendations ​

​

In this role you will be expected to: ​

- Understand client and project objectives and proactively ask clarifying questions at the onset of work ​

- Own complex deliverables or workstream components from start to finish with limited guidance ​

- Conduct independent primary and secondary research and synthesize findings into hypotheses ​

- Apply life sciences commercial knowledge to connect asset, customer, access, functional, and enterprise implications ​

- Use structured problem solving and storytelling to communicate insights clearly in client-ready materials ​

- Build and apply strategy frameworks to break down ambiguous commercial questions and explore scenarios ​

- Support development of value cases by sizing commercial opportunities, defining assumptions, analyzing value drivers, and translating evidence into clear implications for strategy decisions ​

- Support AI/data-enabled strategy and reinvention work by defining use case objectives, workflow fit, required inputs, risks, and human-in-the-loop considerations ​

- Support proactive commercial strategy / reinvention opportunities and proposals by shaping the client problem, strategic approach, workplan, and value story ​

- Contribute to thought capital by developing reusable perspectives, frameworks, case examples, and market-facing points of view on priority commercial strategy topics ​

- Manage up effectively, flag risks early, and support analysts or peers through coaching, feedback, and work product review

Growth Opportunities ​

You will continue to grow through: ​

- Building broad commercial strategy experience across asset, function, and enterprise topics ​

- Supporting high-priority work for senior life sciences commercial leaders ​

- Developing expertise in commercial reinvention, AI/data-enabled strategy, and future ways of working ​

- Partnering across Accenture teams to bring together strategy, technology, analytics, operations, and industry expertise ​

- Growing into a workstream leader who can manage teams and advise clients across a range of commercial strategy questions

Who do we need? ​
We would love to hear from you if you have:​

Basic Qualifications
- Minimum of 3 years of life sciences commercial experience across asset / brand strategy, launch, portfolio growth, marketing, medical, market access, patient services, field, or commercial ops / transformation topics​
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in strategy consulting, professional services, or an equivalent internal corporate-strategy role.
- Bachelor's Degree

Preferred Qualifications
- Ability to flex across asset-level strategy and functional / enterprise-level reinvention questions​
- Strong problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous questions, synthesize research, and translate findings into recommendations​
- Understanding of commercial strategy fundamentals such as market dynamics, customer behavior, access considerations, competitive positioning, value drivers, and launch / growth levers​
- Exposure to operating model, process redesign, governance, capability building, or transformation roadmap work​
- Working knowledge of AI/data concepts, including predictive analytics, GenAI, copilots, workflow automation, and agentic solutions​
- Comfort partnering with technology, analytics, AI, and platform teams while staying anchored in the business problem​
- Proactive mindset around innovative ways of working, including how AI, automation, copilots, and agentic workflows can improve productivity, quality, collaboration, and speed of execution for external project & internal Accenture work​
- Strong PowerPoint, Excel, written communication, storytelling, and client-facing presentation skills​

​

jobs.description:
#DigitalStrategy, #DigitalTransformation, #TechnologyStrategy: Begleite Top Unternehmen in ihre digitale Zukunft – mit Technologie- und Industrie- Know-how, strategischem Weitblick und Umsetzungsgeschick.

Deine Mission
Nutze Deine umfassende Führungserfahrung und strategische Expertise, um unser Technology Strategy & Advisory Team maßgeblich voranzubringen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle arbeitest Du eng mit Entscheidungsträgern auf höchster Führsungsebene zusammen, um wegweisende Strategien zu entwickeln und die Implementierung innovativer Technologien zu leiten. Du gestaltest die digitale Transformation in verschiedenen Branchen aktiv mit und erschließst neue Wachstumschancen für unsere Kunden.
Bei Accenture gestaltest du Dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem Du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu Dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Entwickle Strategien für eine smartere, digitale Zukunft:
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den  Führungskräften unserer Kunden und unseren interdisziplinären Teams entwickelst Du umfangreiche Technologiestrategien, entwirfst agile Zusammenarbeits- und Organisationsmodelle, analysierst Werthebel für ein digitales Transformationvorhaben oder identifizierst IT-Kostenoptimierungspotentiale, erstellst Integrations- und Carve-out-Strategien im Rahmen von M&A-Prozessen und planst den Aufbau und die Steuerung eines strategischen Transformations Offices.

Du berücksichtigst disruptive Trends wie Cloud, generative AI und IoT, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.

Du übernimmst mit deinem Erfahrungshintergrund schnell Projekt- und Führungsverantwortung und prägst die Zukunft unserer Kunden und Teams

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Ein IT-Universitätsabschluss, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Zusatzqualifikation wie einen MBA oder eine Promotion.
- Fundierte Berufserfahrung (mind. fünf Jahre) im strategischen IT-Management, CIO oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb eines Industrie- oder Beratungsunternehmens.
- Du überzeugst durch Erfahrungen in der Zielbildentwicklung, Digitalstrategien und Reifegrad-Assessments (Maturity Assessment)
- Erfahrung in (Teil-)Projektleitung sowie fachlicher Teamführung und tiefes Know-how in Bereichen wie digitale und IT Strategie, Agile IT Operating Model, IT Wert- & Kostenoptimierung, strategisches Transformationsmanagement, Cloud-Technologien, Künstliche Intelligenz, IT-Security oder Tech M&A.
- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und überzeugst durch analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke sowie exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Was wir dir bieten
- Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert
- Umfangreiche Angebote für Fort- und Weiterbildung
- Persönliches Mentoring und Einarbeitung
- Arbeiten, wo du gebraucht wirst – an einem der Accenture-Standorte, remote oder beim Kunden vor Ort

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. jobs.title: Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
Join Accenture CEO Advisory’s Commodity Markets practice as a Strategy Analyst and help senior leaders address complex questions involving enterprise direction, portfolio choices, investment priorities, market opportunity, and operating model readiness. You will work with multidisciplinary and cross-border teams to develop practical, evidence-based recommendations that can withstand execution realities.

The role offers exposure to assignments across Southeast Asia and the broader global practice, with opportunities to build expertise in energy, commodities, trading, industrial markets, analytics, and AI-enabled strategy consulting.

Key Responsibilities

- Contribute to client workstreams by structuring business questions, testing hypotheses, and identifying value-creation opportunities under the guidance of experienced team members.
- Conduct market, competitor, regulatory, operational, and financial research, and translate findings into clear strategic insights.
- Develop quantitative and qualitative analyses, including market assessments, business cases, valuation support, scenario analysis, and commercial or portfolio evaluations.
- Support interviews and workshops, synthesize stakeholder input, and prepare concise presentations and recommendations for senior audiences.
- Work across corporate and portfolio strategy, energy transition positioning, market liberalisation, trading and risk capability, operating model design, commercial optimisation, and investment analysis.
- Collaborate with teams in Singapore, Southeast Asia, and the global Commodity Markets practice to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.
- Use GenAI, analytics, and digital tools responsibly to accelerate research and analysis, while remaining accountable for accuracy, quality, confidentiality, and professional judgement.
- Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, reusable assets, and knowledge-building activities across Commodity Markets and CEO Advisory.

Required Qualifications

- Currently in the final year of an undergraduate or master’s degree, or have up to two years of full-time work experience after graduation.
- Demonstrated critical, creative, and strategic thinking, with evidence of solving complex problems in a structured way through academic, internship, or professional work.
- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with an interest in business, technology, markets, and strategy.
- Effective relationship-building and teamwork skills, with the confidence to contribute to interviews, workshops, and presentations.
- Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
- Exposure to statistics, data analytics, visualiation, or programming. Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, R, Python, Julia, SQL, or comparable tools is beneficial.
- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, required to prepare client deliverables and collaborate with regional and global stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to commodity markets, trading, risk management, energy, investment analysis, or asset valuation.
- Experience combining AI-enabled approaches with quantitative modelling, research, or insight generation.
- International study, internship, or work experience.
- Familiarity with financial modelling, market forecasting, commercial assessment, or strategic business analysis.

Working Arrangements

- Opportunity to travel across Southeast Asia and, where global staffing requires, to other locations.
- Flexible working arrangements, with client-site presence when required by the engagement.

Why Join Us

- Build a career in a fast-paced strategy practice with transparent development opportunities, continuous coaching, and early responsibility.
- Work alongside strategy, industry, data, AI, and technology specialists addressing complex business challenges.
- Access the Commodity Markets global staffing network for cross-border and cross-industry project experience.

jobs.title: Data & AI Strategy Analyst / Consultant / Manager (She/He/They)
jobs.description:
Technology Strategy & Transformation (TS&T) in Warsaw supports organizations in shaping and executing technology agendas aligned with business priorities. We combine a strategic perspective with hands-on advisory , helping clients move from ambition to execution-ready decisions.
Our teams work across the full technology landscape , from enterprise architecture and cloud platforms, through operating and financial models, to data and AI capabilities . This integrated approach enables holistic advisory spanning business objectives, technology choices and scalable execution.

Join our Data & AI Strategy Team

Join Accenture and help leading organizations design and implement enterprise-wide Data & AI strategies that translate technology investments and organizational transformation into measurable business value.
We work at the intersection of business, data and artificial intelligence , helping organizations reinvent how they operate and compete. Our teams advise C-suite executives (CEO, CIO, CDO) on how to build strong data foundations, unlock value through analytics and AI, including GenAI and Agentic AI, and embed data-driven decision-making into operating models and culture.
Depending on your experience, you will join us as an Analyst, Consultant or Manager , taking increasing responsibility for solving complex client challenges, leading workstreams and teams, and shaping strategic decisions with senior stakeholders.
You will be part of a global community of strategists, working with international experts and top-tier clients across industries and shaping the future of data and AI-powered organizations.

Your Impact

Data & AI Value Realization
- Define advanced analytics and AI strategies , including GenAI and Agentic AI, aligned with enterprise ambitions and business priorities

- Identify, prioritize and scale AI / GenAI use cases across the value chain

- Define enterprise analytics and reporting strategies , including KPI frameworks, management information and decision-support models

Responsible AI & AI Governance
- Design and operationalize Responsible AI frameworks , covering ethics, transparency, regulatory compliance and AI risk management

- Define AI governance models , including decision rights, controls, accountability structures and model lifecycle oversight

Data Foundation & Operating Model
- Define enterprise data strategies spanning data architecture, Data Mesh and data product concepts, master data, metadata and data quality, as well as data security and privacy

- Design and implement Data & AI Operating Models , including data governance structures, roles, processes and ways of working

Transformation, Culture & Value
- Build business cases, investment roadmaps and transformation plans for data and AI initiatives

- Drive data-driven culture and adoption , supporting leadership engagement, behavioral change and decision-making transformation

Leadership & Client Engagement
Depending on your level of experience, you will take increasing responsibility
- Leading workstreams and project teams on client engagements

- Engaging with senior stakeholders and acting as a trusted advisor on Data & AI topics

- Managing client relationships and ensuring high-quality delivery and business outcomes

- Supporting and developing junior team members

- Contributing to the growth of our Data & AI Strategy practice

Your Impact

- Data & AI Value Realization   - Define advanced analytics and AI strategies , including GenAI and Agentic AI, aligned with enterprise ambitions and business priorities

- Identify, prioritize and scale AI / GenAI use cases across the value chain

- Define enterprise analytics and reporting strategies , including KPI frameworks, management information and decision-support models

- Responsible AI & AI Governance   - Design and operationalize Responsible AI frameworks , covering ethics, transparency, regulatory compliance and AI risk management

- Define AI governance models , including decision rights, controls, accountability structures and model lifecycle oversight

- Data Foundation & Operating Model   - Define enterprise data strategies spanning data architecture, Data Mesh and data product concepts, master data, metadata and data quality, as well as data security and privacy

- Design and implement Data & AI Operating Models , including data governance structures, roles, processes and ways of working

- Transformation, Culture & Value   - Build business cases, investment roadmaps and transformation plans for data and AI initiatives

- Drive data-driven culture and adoption , supporting leadership engagement, behavioral change and decision-making transformation

- Leadership & Client Engagement

Depending on your level of experience, you will take increasing responsibility for:
- - Leading workstreams and project teams on client engagements

- Engaging with senior stakeholders and acting as a trusted advisor on Data & AI topics

- Managing client relationships and ensuring high-quality delivery and business outcomes

- Supporting and developing junior team members

- Contributing to the growth of our Data & AI Strategy practice

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED :

Experience & Background

- Higher degree, preferably in IT, Data Science, Big Data, Computer Science, Quantitative Methods or a related field, with strong academic performance

- Experience in strategy consulting, Data & AI advisory, technology strategy or related roles :

- Analyst: minimum 1 year of relevant experience

- Consultant: minimum 3 years of relevant experience

- Manager: minimum 5 years of relevant experience, including experience in leading projects and managing client relationships

- Strong understanding of how data and AI enable business transformation and value creation

- For Manager candidates, a proven track record of leading teams, delivering complex engagements and working with senior client stakeholders

Data & AI Knowledge

Solid understanding of tools, frameworks and technologies within at least one of the following areas:
- Cloud data platforms (e.g. Azure, Google Cloud, AWS)

- Machine Learning & AI platforms (e.g. Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI)

- GenAI / Agentic AI tools (e.g. LangChain, Lovable, AutoGen, Zapier)

- Data Catalogs & Metadata Management (e.g. Collibra, Informatica)

- BI ecosystems (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)

Skills & Mindset

- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills

- Ability to translate complex Data & AI topics into clear executive-level narratives

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with increasing leadership expectations for more senior roles

- Excellent communication skills in English ; an additional foreign language (e.g. German, French, Arabic) is a strong asset

- Collaborative working style and comfort operating in fast-evolving environments

- Growth mindset, curiosity and strong motivation to solve client challenges

- For Manager candidates, passion for building teams, developing people and shaping the future of Data & AI

Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if you do not meet every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.
- A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification).
- Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.
- Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares.
- Paid employee referral program.
- Private medical care and life insurance.
- Access to the WorkSmile benefits platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card).

Working Conditions:

- Employment contract (umowa o pracę).
- Headquarter in Warsaw with offices in Kraków, Wrocław, Łódź and Gdańsk.
- Traveling to work with prestigious clients and deliver large-scale transformational change. We deliver our work in hybrid model, remotely, in our offices but also traveling and working closely with our Clients in their offices. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. That is why traveling declaration, willingness and ability to work at client locations mostly across Europe and beyond, for short or long term, is required .
- The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client, or in an Accenture office—depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning, and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

jobs.title: AI Value Strategy analyst for Newra, Part of Accenture
jobs.description:
ARE YOU READY to step into the New Era (NewRA) of AI-driven banking ?

At Accenture Newra AI Hub , we are not just building technology, we are redefining how banking operates. As part of our strategic collaboration with Piraeus, Newra is designed to responsibly embed AI at the core of its business, moving beyond experimentation to real-world impact at scale. Built to make a real difference, Newra reflects our belief that AI creates value only when it genuinely improves people’s lives.

You will work on advanced AI solutions that span the full spectrum of the bank -from core banking systems to customer experience- simplifying complexity, automating critical processes and delivering measurable results where they matter most.

Joining Newra means becoming part of a high-performing team of innovators at the beginning of a major reinvention. This is a space for people who approach AI with depth, discipline and purpose. You will collaborate across disciplines, develop future-proof skills, and help turn technology into real-world transformation.

As an AI Value Strategy Analyst, y ou’ll help turn AI ambition into measurable enterprise value, connecting strategy, investment decisions, delivery progress, and realized business outcomes. You’ll define the value framework, KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms that show where AI is creating impact and where to scale next. You’ll work across business, technology, finance, operations, and delivery teams to make AI value visible, measurable, and continuously improved.

What you'll build
- Operate and evolve the Value Office framework, governance model, reporting structure, and value tracking mechanisms

- Define and maintain value realization methodologies, KPIs, and measurement mechanisms across transformation and AI programs

- Track and monitor business benefits, financial impact, productivity gains, and operational outcomes across initiatives

- Build executive dashboards, reporting packs, and value tracking mechanisms for senior leadership and governance forums

- Develop business cases, investment justifications, and value articulation for AI use cases going live

- Connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes and operational impact

- Partner with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize initiatives based on strategic value, ROI, and execution feasibility

- Establish governance frameworks, KPI structures, and executive reporting models

What we need

- Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or related field

- 2-3 years in strategy, transformation, PMO, or value management, ideally in a tech or financial services context

- Proven track record building ROI models, business cases, and value measurement frameworks

- Strong analytical skills,   comfortable with financial modelling, KPI design, and executive-level reporting

- Excellent communicator, you translate complex data into clear narratives for senior stakeholders

- Hands-on with Power BI or Tableau for executive dashboards and portfolio reporting

- Understanding of AI and digital transformation, you know enough to ask the right questions and challenge assumptions

- Structured thinker; self-directed; thrives in ambiguity and cross-functional environments

Nice to have:
- Experience in AI program governance or technology portfolio management

- Jira / Confluence for portfolio tracking; enterprise reporting platforms

- Exposure to benefits realization in regulated or financial services environments

What's in it for you
- Competitive salary and benefits, including but not limited to: life/health insurance, performance based bonuses, monthly vouchers, company car (depending on management level), flexible work arrangements, employee share purchase plan, parental leave and various corporate discounts

- Continuous training & development through global platforms & local academy. At Accenture, we believe in bringing the best to our clients through continuous learning & improvement – from basic skills to industry-specific content – available to all our people

- Career coaching and mentorship to help you manage your career and develop professionally

- Ongoing strength and skill-based evaluation process

- Various opportunities to develop your career across a spectrum of clients, industries and projects

- Diverse and inclusive culture

- Opportunities to get involved in corporate citizenship initiatives, from volunteering to doing charity work

- Under our Brain Regain initiative, extra relocation benefits may apply

​ To learn more about Accenture, and how you will be challenged and inspired from Day 1, please visit our website accenture.com/gr-en/.

jobs.title: Join Accenture as a Strategy Analyst or a Management Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning ideas into action - working with people, processes and technology to make ambitious projects succeed? Do you want to solve complex problems when there is no obvious answer - starting with a blank piece of paper and creating clarity from ambiguity?

We are looking for ambitious graduates to join Accenture in Copenhagen as Strategy Analysts or Management Consulting Analysts, starting in 2027.

The work we do spans from defining strategic direction and identifying new opportunities to transform organizations and implementing new technologies. You will bring a strategic, analytical, and delivery-oriented perspective to these multidisciplinary teams, while gaining exposure to the broader capabilities of Accenture.

At Accenture, we work across strategy, consulting and technology to solve our clients’ most important challenges. Our projects bring together colleagues with different backgrounds and expertise, meaning you may work alongside strategy consultants, technology specialists, data experts, and industry professionals.

What you will do

Strategy Analyst
As a Strategy Analyst, you will work with some of the largest companies and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics on the questions that shape their future. You might help a company define where to grow next, rethink its operating model, identify how AI and technology can create competitive advantage, improve profitability, or respond to major shifts in its industry.

Your tasks may include:
- Structuring complex and ambiguous business problems and developing clear hypotheses for how to solve them.

- Conducting market, competitor, customer and industry analyses to identify insights and opportunities.

- Building quantitative analyses, financial models, and business cases to support strategic decisions.

- Helping clients define growth strategies, transformation agendas, operating models, and strategic priorities.

- Exploring how technologies such as AI, data, and digital platforms can create new business opportunities or fundamentally change an industry.

- Preparing structured, insight-driven presentations and recommendations for senior client stakeholders.

- Conducting interviews and workshops with clients to understand challenges, test hypotheses, and develop solutions.

- Contributing to proposals, thought leadership, and the development of new ideas for our clients.

Management Consulting Analyst
As a Management Consulting Analyst, you will help some of the largest companies and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics translate ambitions and strategy into tangible change. You might help redesign operating models, improve critical business processes, introduce new technologies, support major transformations, or help teams adopt new ways of working.

In your daily work, you may:
- Translate strategic objectives into concrete initiatives, plans, and deliverables.

- Support the design and implementation of new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

- Coordinate activities across complex transformation programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders.

- Prepare structured presentations, analysis, project plans, and decision material.

- Plan and facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews.

- Work closely with clients to understand requirements, resolve issues, and move implementation forward.

- Support change management activities that help organizations successfully adopt new solutions.

The industries we work with
Accenture works with leading organizations across a broad range of industries, including:
- Financial Services

- Consumer Goods & Retail

- Life Sciences

- Health & Public Services

- Resources

- Industrial & Manufacturing

- Communications, Media & Technology

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for candidates who are passionate about translating strategic ideas into real-world implementation projects. There is no single background that makes a successful consultant at Accenture.
You may come from business, engineering, technology, economics, natural sciences, or another relevant field. What matters most is your ability to solve problems, collaborate with others, and turn ideas into action.

We are looking for candidates who:
- Hold or expect to complete a relevant master's degree by the summer of 2027.

- Have a strong academic track record and solid analytical capabilities.

- Enjoy breaking down complex and ambiguous problems into manageable questions.

- Can bring structure to complex projects with many stakeholders and moving parts.

- Can communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely.

- Have strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

- Are intellectually curious and enjoy learning about new businesses, industries and technologies.

- Are fluent in English and thrive in collaborative, multidisciplinary teams.

Many of the projects you will work on sit at the intersection of business and technology. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but you should be curious about how technology can enable better businesses and successful transformation.

How to apply
Please submit the following documents as one PDF file, in this order:
- CV

- Cover letter

- Bachelor's and master's grade transcripts

Please note that applications without all the required documents will not be considered.

We kindly ask that in your cover letter, you tell us which role (Strategy or Management Consulting) you would be more interested in, and why. If you have experience or a particular interest in one of the industries in which we work, you are welcome to highlight that as well – but it is entirely optional and will not be a prerequisite for consideration.

Candidates are expected to start in September 2027 . If you complete your master’s degree earlier and are available and interested in starting sooner, we will take this into consideration. Please indicate this in your application.

Application deadline: October 18th, 2026.

The recruitment process
The recruitment process will include an initial assessment followed by the Accenture Recruitment Bootcamp for selected candidates, scheduled for November 26th and 27th, 2026. Please make sure that you are available on both dates when submitting your application. All candidates will receive an update on the outcome of their application no later than November 10th, 2026. Selected candidates will participate on one of the two Bootcamp days.
During the one-day bootcamp in Copenhagen, you will meet Accenture colleagues and take part in both case interviews and personal-fit interviews.
The interviews are designed to understand how you approach problem-solving, collaborate with others, communicate, and tackle business challenges. We therefore encourage you to familiarize yourself with consulting case interviews ahead of the bootcamp.
Further information about the recruitment process and relevant dates will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

What we offer
At Accenture, you join one global organization with access to a broad range of industries, capabilities, technologies and people.
From the beginning of your career, you will work as part of multidisciplinary teams solving real business challenges, while receiving structured training, coaching and support.

You can expect:
- A steep learning curve and responsibility from day one.

- Formal training in consulting, business, technology and professional skills.

- Exposure to senior colleagues and client stakeholders.

- Opportunities to work across industries and alongside colleagues from strategy, consulting and technology.

jobs.title: NA Digital Marketing Strategy Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
The NA Digital Marketing Strategy Senior Analyst will focus on developing best in class advertising and social media campaigns that leverage innovation and creativity. Operate as part of a seamless, global collective of advertising and social media experts. While a North America-focused role, you’ll work closely with social experts globally—as well as teams such as Advertising, Digital and Data & Analytics—to partner on initiatives, share content and learnings, and facilitate other collaborative efforts that drive us all forward.

You will collaborate with marketing stakeholders while being the “expert in the room,” proposing effective ways to use social media to support our marketing team’s priorities. You approach social with a strategic, not just tactical mindset - but also know that a great strategy needs excellent execution to succeed. Partner with internal teams and agency resources to strategically develop messages and creative for our key audiences in the most appropriate channels, meeting the objectives of the brief. You will help with day-to-day social channel management, assist in content creation and recommendations, and help perform listening, metrics and engagement. You have a knack for content, from crafting copy to recognizing good design, and understand that social media means listening, engaging, analyzing and optimizing—not just publishing.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain best-in-class social presence for Accenture North America initiatives and priorities

- Develop clear messages, build a unique and consistent social media presence, and ensure consistent execution across multiple social media channels

- Understand social media data and metrics and can make data actionable and a critical component to inform our efforts

- Oversee social channels and their content on a daily basis, including listening, engagement and publishing

- Develop social content campaigns with marketing partners, from ideation to execution, with an emphasis on both core content and execution

- Stay up to speed on best-in-class opportunities and stand-out creative ideas to inform our strategy and planning

- Actively integrate with social colleagues and extended teammates to collaborate and share learnings, insights and ideas to deliver best-in-class social recommendations to help guide social and marketing opportunities

- Help evolve and enhance Accenture North America employee advocacy on social

Basic Qualifications:
- Minimum of 3 years of marketing & communications experience
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in social media content management (such as content creation, social listening, metrics reporting, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with Sprinklr
- Experience with creative design tools such as Adobe, etc.

Professional Skills Requirements:
- Passion for social media with the ability to execute and implement multi-faceted campaigns
- Strong understanding of both social strategy and execution for campaigns, events and real-time activations
- Stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence outcomes
- Problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
- Demonstrated agility and resilience in a fast-paced environment with multiple competing demands.
