jobs.title: Partners in Performance - Strategy Business Analyst NAELFY27
jobs.description:
This role is with our Partners in Performance  team, part of Accenture.

Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture is a global management consulting firm with a focus on human performance working alongside client partners to make change happen. We’ve got offices in Australia, New Zealand, South-East Asia, Africa, North and South America and Europe but prefer to spend as little time in them as possible. Instead, we work alongside our clients to unleash their potential and deliver lasting impact that you hardly ever achieve by sitting in a boardroom.

The Business Analyst role is an entry level role where you would be immediately exposed to being the frontline change agent for our clients.  You are the primary source of reliable data and rock-solid analysis, providing the fact base the improvement team uses to make decisions in real time.

Responsibilities include:
- Assisting with the delivery of measurable improvements and in the implementation of processes and systems that will sustain ongoing improvements, especially by supporting prioritization and problem-solving
- To work closely with other team members and client team members to collect/analyze data and provide insights
- At times, the business analyst may be given the opportunity to take on front-line coaching roles, especially with client analysts, to broaden their management experience

Key competencies: To be successful consultant at Partners in Performance, you not only need to be an outstanding academic performer, but also be dynamic, passionate and prepared to roll up your sleeves and work inside our clients’ businesses.  You need to care about people and developing them, as coaching is a big part of our success.

This position involves a significant amount of on-site travel. The ideal candidate is comfortable and available to travel 80% as part of the role. This will include US and Canadian travel, as well as other international opportunities.

Visit pip.global , Partners in Performance, Part of Accenture on LinkedIn, or @lifeatpip on Instagram to get to know us better.

- Undergraduate with an expected graduation date of Spring/Summer 2027
- Graduation from a top-tier university, with excellent results (distinction average)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Relevant work experience/internships in blue chip consulting or industrial companies is highly valued
- Degrees in Engineering, Business Commerce, Environmental Science and more
- Natural resources industry and/or operations consulting experience
- Experience on mining, heavy industry, or construction sites
- Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with on-site travel comprising approximately 80% of the role
- Excellent problem-solving skills, including analytics
- Exceptional interpersonal skills, including ability to coach, influence, and build trust with peers and clients
- Demonstrated passion for results
- Must be fluent in English

About Accenture

Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

Introduction
At Accenture Security, we are seeking an accomplished CrowdStrike Security Architect to strengthen our Cyber Defense and Resilience practice. We are looking for a cybersecurity professional with proven experience in security operations transformation, CrowdStrike Falcon platform implementations, and client-facing advisory engagements.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise across endpoint security, NG-SIEM, identity protection, cloud security, exposure management, and AI-enabled security capabilities with the ability to guide strategic cybersecurity initiatives. This role requires a trusted advisor who can bridge business and technical priorities, helping clients modernize their security operations, consolidate technologies, and achieve measurable cyber resilience outcomes.
Working at the intersection of Accenture's consulting excellence and CrowdStrike's technology leadership, you will help leading organizations accelerate their security transformation journeys while contributing to innovative cybersecurity offerings and solutions.

What's in It for You
- Partner with leading organizations to modernize and transform security operations through AI-powered cyber defense.

- Collaborate with Accenture's CrowdStrike Business Group and global cybersecurity specialists.

- Influence strategic security decisions and large-scale cyber transformation initiatives.

- Shape innovative CrowdStrike-focused offerings and contribute to market-leading solutions.

- Access continuous learning, certifications, and the latest cybersecurity technologies.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead discovery sessions with CISOs, SOC leaders, and security architects to assess current security capabilities, identify gaps, and align Falcon platform solutions to business outcomes.

- Design and deliver CrowdStrike Falcon solution demonstrations, architecture designs, business value assessments, and executive presentations tailored to client requirements.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout pre-sales engagements and enterprise cybersecurity transformation initiatives.

- Guide organizations through security operations modernization, platform consolidation, and cyber resilience programs leveraging CrowdStrike technologies.

- Contribute to the growth of Accenture's CrowdStrike offerings through innovation, thought leadership, and opportunity development activities.

Necessary Knowledge / Skills
- Demonstrated experience in solution architecture, cybersecurity consulting, or technical delivery roles within the cybersecurity industry.

- Hands-on expertise with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including endpoint protection, EDR, NG-SIEM, Exposure Management (CTEM), Identity Protection, Cloud Security, and Charlotte AI.

- Strong technical knowledge across multiple security domains such as SIEM technologies, endpoint security, cloud security, identity threat detection, and vulnerability or exposure management.

- Broad understanding of enterprise security architectures, including cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructures, identity ecosystems, and operational technology environments.

- Excellent communication, consulting, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
- Active CrowdStrike certifications such as CCFA, CCSE, or CrowdStrike Champions Professional/Expert credentials.

- Experience delivering CrowdStrike NG-SIEM implementations, migrations, parser development, CQL use cases, or LogScale administration.

- Background in managed security services, MSSP/MDR environments, or large-scale security operations programs.

- Experience with CTEM methodologies, attack surface management, vulnerability prioritization platforms, and exposure reduction initiatives.

- Familiarity with security frameworks and threat intelligence practices, including NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA, HIPAA, FedRAMP, MITRE ATT&CK, and adversary tracking.

jobs.title: Transformation lead
jobs.description:
Do you want to help leading Belgian and international companies transform how they design, develop and bring products to market?
Do you combine a solid engineering background with a passion for business transformation? Are you energised by working at the intersection of product development, digital technology and operational excellence — helping clients move faster, smarter and more sustainably?

Your job
As an Engineering and R&D Transformation Lead within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice, you will own and lead client engagements that help product companies reinvent their engineering and R&D functions. You will work across industries including Consumer Goods, Industrial Equipment, Automotive and Pharma & Life Sciences — acting as a trusted advisor to client leadership, defining their transformation roadmap and delivering tangible results.
Examples of projects you can work on:
- PLM transformation: assess a client's product lifecycle management maturity, define the future-state architecture and lead the implementation of PLM platforms (Teamcenter, Windchill, ENOVIA, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE) to improve product data management and engineering efficiency

- R&D operating model design: help a manufacturer redesign their R&D organisation, processes and governance to reduce time-to-market and improve innovation portfolio management

- Digital twin & simulation: support clients in building digital representations of their products or production systems to accelerate engineering decisions and reduce physical prototyping

- BOM and product data management: define and implement end-to-end BOM structures, engineering change processes and configuration management frameworks

- Engineering transformation: lead current-state and future-state analysis of engineering and product development processes, and guide the design and implementation of improved operating models

In this role you will:
- Own client engagements end-to-end — from diagnostic and solution design through to delivery and value realisation

- Serve as a trusted advisor to client engineering and product leadership teams

- Define functional solution designs that leverage PLM and digital engineering capabilities

- Own requirements, process models and user stories across one or more engineering workstreams

- Guide development of digital thread and PLM strategies and roadmaps

- Facilitate and lead executive-level and working-level workshops to drive alignment and decision-making

- Lead and mentor junior team members, providing functional guidance and career development support

- Support proposal development and contribute to growing our Engineering offering in Belgium

- Collaborate with Accenture's international Engineering network to bring the best expertise to Belgian clients

Your team
Our consultants in Supply Chain & Engineering are changing businesses every day using deep industry insights, knowledge and innovative ideas. Positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and industry, we devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. With an eye for competitive advantage, sustainability, digital disruption, operating models and the future workforce, we take on the challenge of designing and implementing transformative business solutions, using the newest technology.
Our research-based advice and situational analyses enable our clients to act with speed and confidence. Whether we're investigating complex issues or identifying new opportunities, our work always comes down to one thing: unlocking value and creating real, tangible impacts.

Your background
- Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical field

- 5 to 10 years of experience combining industry roles in R&D or engineering functions with management consulting

- Preferred industry experience in Consumer Goods, Industrial Equipment, Automotive or Pharma & Life Sciences

- Solid understanding of product engineering processes: BOM management, engineering change, configuration management, lifecycle governance

- Hands-on experience with PLM platforms (Teamcenter, Windchill, ENOVIA, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, SAP PLM) is a strong asset

- Track record of owning and leading client-facing engagements and managing cross-functional teams

- Ability to communicate complex engineering and PLM concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Fluent in English, both spoken and written

- Fluent in French and/or Dutch, both spoken and written

- Ability to travel to client sites; a valid driving licence is strongly recommended

Nice to have
- Familiarity with digital twin, digital thread concepts and their application in engineering transformation programmes

- Exposure to AI or GenAI applications in engineering contexts — generative design, AI-assisted quality control, predictive engineering analytics

- Prior experience in global systems integrator consulting environment

Our offer
Within the Supply Chain & Engineering Practice of Accenture Belgium and Luxembourg, you will get the opportunity to work for leading customers on high-value projects. You will be able to build your skills and expertise by leveraging our state-of-the-art assets, methodologies, global network of experts and comprehensive training curriculum. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted in virtual classrooms, online or in collaboration with external parties. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable steppingstone to build a career.
Accenture is an incredible place to work — and keep learning. By joining us, you'll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we're very proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow — whatever it is you're great at. You will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.
Besides our high-profile, challenging projects and our nurturing work environment, we offer excellent employee benefits, including:
- 13th month + holiday allowance

- 32 holidays

- Laptop and smartphone

- Hospitalization insurance and extensive group insurance package

- Bonus program

- Training & learning opportunities

- Green mobility program: e-bikes, public transport, bike 2 work allowance, …

- Flexrewards: personalize your rewards package with our flexible benefits tool

- Discount program: get discounts at your favorite (online) shops

- Employee shares purchase plan

- Eco-cheques

- And many more!

Location: London, Manchester, Edinburgh

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

We believe in inclusion and diversity and supporting the whole person. Our core values comprise of Stewardship, Best People, Client Value Creation, One Global Network, Respect for the Individual and Integrity. Year after year, Accenture is recognized worldwide not just for business performance but for inclusion and diversity too.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” –  Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:

HR Transformation Consulting Services is a cross-industry capability, which is focused on developing and delivering market leading, innovative HR solutions to our clients. This practice is part of our UKI Talent and Organisation/Human Potential practice which leads on combining our HR Transformation and HR Technology consulting with programme leadership capabilities, change management, and leadership expertise, helping our clients to shape and deliver world-class colleague experience, HR services underpinned by digital enablement to unlock their human potential.

Accenture’s HR Transformation capability is a recognised market leader in HR Consulting. We have worked with our clients to create leading edge HR organizations, processes and practices that deliver measurable improvements in the performance of people and the organization. Our HR professionals provide knowledge and experience that help today's companies to blueprint their HR strategy, operating model and support the planning, design, and deployment activities required to achieve broad HR transformational changes across the enterprise. Accenture provides strong methods, tools, and accelerators founded in best in class thought leadership to help our client’s structure, launch, and implement these large-scale transformation programs which drives productivity, effectiveness and improves workforce performance.

We are growing our practice with ambitions to scale at pace and are looking for enthusiastic professionals to expand our HR capabilities and share our passion for innovative HR. As a group of practitioners, we work very closely with the world’s largest organisations which gives us a strong understanding of the challenges they face and how our strong ties in the wider Accenture community can support them.

In our team you will:

Learn, grow and advance in an innovative culture that thrives on shared success, diverse ways of thinking and enables boundaryless opportunities that can drive your career in new and exciting ways. As part of our team, you'll be working with cutting-edge HR technologies and will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of new skills on the job. If you’re looking for a challenging career working in a vibrant environment with access to training and a global network of HR experts, this could be the role for you.

In this role you will:
- Lead HR Consulting projects across HR strategy, HR process & experience re-design, HR function optimisation and HR-led enterprise transformation
- Lead global delivery teams to deliver the best outcomes for our clients on our HR transformation projects.
- Own client relationships and help to lead our clients to deliver leading HR transformation initiatives.
- Empower Analysts and Consultants to deliver to their full potential through coaching, mentoring and people leadership.
- Challenge our clients to think differently in how HR can support the workforce of the future and agile enterprise.
- Lead HR benchmarking, data collection and analysis to deliver data driven insights, recommendations, and innovation to solve our client’s challenges.
- Design and develop innovative HR operating models, including Service Delivery Models, using best-in-class research and insights.
- Leverage leading practice and conduct workshops with clients to re-design HR processes, with experience at the heart of how processes support colleagues and line managers.
- Help to grow HR Transformation by getting involved in sales processes, including contributing to bid submissions and client presentations.
- Facilitate HR workshops or meetings to gather requirements, present and validate solutions options and test interpretation of client needs in an interactive manner using design thinking methodologies as appropriate.
- Develop innovative HR thought leadership and assets to help re-define the role of HR for our clients, including the role of Generative AI.
- Establish good working relationships and collaboration across Accenture, both multi-discipline consulting capabilities and business lines such as Technology, Digital and Operations.

We are looking for experience in the following skills:

·        A proven track record of delivering large-scale, global HR transformation programmes.
·        Strong consulting acumen by demonstrating excellent communication, facilitation and data analysis skills to influence others.
·        Experience in one or more of the following: HR Transformation, HR Optimisation, HR Operating Model and Organisational Design and HR Process & Experience Design .
·        Excellent understanding of latest HR trends, strategy, and operations value levers, how the role of HR is changing, and the digital enablers required to add value to an organisation.
·        Showing ability to build trusted relationships, and manage stakeholders, both internally and externally to your organisation with clear ability to influence others.
·        Demonstrate continuously learning, and bring innovative, new thinking to the workplace.

Set yourself apart:

- Are forward thinking with a strong business acumen and ability to navigate the wider business context within our client organisation.
- Are passionate for working in an entrepreneurial environment and working with constantly evolving technologies and agile methodologies.
- Prioritise continuous development and self-guided learning, personally and your team.
- Have experience in leading global teams in complex HR transformations
- Have the drive and determination to lead, coach and develop others and continuously share your knowledge with others to contribute to business development and growth.
- Are open to autonomously operate in a global network & fast-paced growth model and comfortable to set your own personal growth plan.
- Are enthusiastic to extend and navigate networks in and outside of Accenture.

What’s in it for you:

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice! Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there may be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

- Relevant   Bachelor's Degree   or equivalent industry experience

- Minimum  2   years of   experience in a professional services   organisation , working alongside key senior stakeholders,   modelling   and supporting transformation journeys, and delivering strategic proposals.

Depth:

- Typically has a minimum of  2   to  7   years of experience doing similar work either at or outside of Accenture

- Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge in an area of expertise based on experience

- Expected to be knowledgeable about the work performed by their immediate team and teams they collaborate with

DECISION MAKING:

- Typically receives direction and feedback from their supervisor on setting priorities or assigning and managing tasks on a weekly to bi-weekly basis

- Expected consequences for mistakes in their work would include missing team deadlines and may be escalated to a managing director

jobs.title: GBS FP&A Operating Model (Consultant)
jobs.description:
About Finance Reinvention Partner

Accenture’s Finance Reinvention Partner helps CFOs and finance leaders reinvent how finance creates and protects enterprise value—bringing together strategy, operating model, data, AI and technology to improve performance, insight, control and execution. In the UK and Ireland, the practice combines finance strategy and transformation capabilities with the enterprise platforms that enable them, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and enterprise performance management solutions.
Our GBS and Operating Model team helps clients design and implement how finance and other enterprise services should be organised and delivered across retained functions, Global Business Services, Global Capability Centres, Centres of Excellence and external service providers. We support the full transformation journey—from strategy, value case and target operating model through detailed design, mobilisation, implementation, service management and continuous improvement—embedding data, automation and AI to create scalable, resilient and value-led operations.

Why this role

This role redesigns how FP&A services are organised and delivered across corporate FP&A, business-facing finance, GBS/GCC and Centres of Excellence. You will help clients create a scalable model that standardises repeatable planning, reporting and insight production while preserving the business proximity, judgement and accountability needed for effective decision support.

What you'll bring

Relevant FP&A and operating-model transformation experience . At least 4 years’ relevant experience across FP&A, business finance, finance transformation, GBS/GCC or consulting, with evidence of leading a significant FP&A operating-model, planning, reporting or performance-management workstream from assessment and design into implementation readiness, adoption or transition.

Practical FP&A and business-finance depth. Strong understanding of strategic planning, budgeting, rolling forecasting, scenario and driver-based planning, management reporting, KPI and value-driver frameworks, performance reviews, variance and root-cause analysis, insight generation and finance business partnering. You understand how these capabilities support commercial and operational decisions—not simply how the processes are executed.

GBS and operating-model design . Experience analysing activities and determining how work should be distributed across corporate finance, business-unit teams, finance business partners, GBS/GCC, Centres of Excellence and external providers. You understand service scope, retained-versus-delivered boundaries, governance, roles, decision rights, organisational interfaces, demand and capacity, service measures and transition implications.

Technology and data fluency. You understand how enterprise data, EPM platforms, ERP, analytics, reporting, workflow and AI shape the FP&A operating model. You can assess implications relating to planning dimensions and hierarchies, business drivers, common definitions, data ownership, quality, integration, access, reporting and governance

Automation and AI operating-model judgement. You understand relevant applications such as forecast generation, scenario modelling, variance and root-cause analysis, anomaly detection and narrative reporting. You can assess where automation or AI can support or perform activities, where human judgement and accountability must remain, and how roles, skills, controls, transparency, exception handling and review requirements should change.

Delivery and adoption. Ability to lead workshops, requirements, process and operating-model design, solution traceability, testing and business readiness, training and adoption as part of an EPM or finance transformation.

Client, team and sector capability. Strong facilitation and presentation skills, analysis, process-mapping, documentation and stakeholder management; confidence in contributing in client workshops and owning defined deliverables; and experience in Consumer Goods & Services, Utilities and/or Energy.

What you'll be accountable for
- Assess the current FP&A operating model and service portfolio, including the FP&A mandate, activity taxonomy, planning and reporting cycles, organisation and capacity, cost, performance, stakeholder needs, process variation, hand-offs, data dependencies, enabling technology and the root causes of operational pain.
- Develop target service-scope and activity-placement options across corporate or group FP&A, business-unit and regional FP&A, finance business partnering, GBS/GCC, Centres of Excellence and external service providers. Use evidence to assess scalability, business proximity, judgement requirements, value, risk and implementation dependencies.
- Design the target FP&A operating model, covering service scope, roles and accountabilities, decision rights, governance, organisational interfaces, service catalogues, demand and capacity management, location and sourcing implications, required capabilities and outcome-based performance measures.
- Define how FP&A teams will work together across the end-to-end service, including the interfaces between central FP&A, business-facing finance, GBS analytical teams, capability owners, data teams and technology specialists. Establish clear hand-offs, engagement routes, escalation paths and decision forums.
- Define the standardisation and service-delivery requirements for core FP&A activities, including strategic and annual planning, budgeting, rolling forecasting, scenario analysis, management reporting, KPI and value-driver frameworks, performance reviews, variance analysis and insight production.
- Assess the implications of data, technology, automation and AI for the future operating model. Determine how these capabilities could change activity placement, roles, capacity, skills, controls, decision rights and the balance between automated outputs and human judgement.
- Translate operating-model decisions into clear business, data and control requirements for EPM, ERP, analytics, workflow, automation and AI capabilities. Work with data, architecture and platform specialists to clarify requirements and maintain alignment through solution design, testing and implementation without owning system configuration.
- Build the supporting case for change, benefits and implementation roadmap, including workforce and capability implications, transition requirements, sequencing, dependencies, adoption measures and value-realisation indicators.
- Lead the assigned FP&A operating-model workstream, including client workshops, stakeholder engagement, team outputs, risks, dependencies and quality. Produce executive-ready recommendations and contribute to proposals, points of view and reusable FP&A and GBS assets.

Preferred differentiators
- Experience designing, mobilising or transitioning FP&A services within a GBS, shared-services, GCC or managed-services environment.
- 4+ years of relevant experience in FP&A, finance transformation, enterprise performance management, GBS or management consulting.
- Experience redesigning the relationship between central FP&A, business-unit finance, finance business partners, GBS analytical teams and Centres of Excellence.
- Exposure to integrated business planning, enterprise-wide planning, strategic planning, capital-expenditure planning, workforce planning, profitability analysis or commercial performance management.
- Experience using benchmarking, process analysis, planning-cycle metrics, capacity analysis or process-mining techniques to identify operating-model and service-improvement opportunities.
- Exposure to advanced analytics, predictive forecasting or AI-enabled FP&A use cases, with an understanding of their implications for people, governance, controls and decision-making.
- Experience supporting service transition, capability development, change adoption, benefits realisation or implementation readiness as part of an FP&A or finance transformation.
- Experience operating in a multi-country or matrixed organisation, balancing Familiarity with modern EPM platforms such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Oracle EPM, Anaplan, OneStream, Pigment, Board, CCH Tagetik, Power BI or equivalent.
- A recognised finance qualification such as CIMA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent, or substantial hands-on FP&A or business-finance experience.
- Experience in capital-intensive, project-based or high-volume planning environments, particularly within Utilities, Energy or Consumer Goods & Services.
- Strong consulting skills, including workshop facilitation, structured analysis, development of operating-model deliverables and communication of findings to finance and transformation stakeholders.

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We are:
CFO & Enterprise Value, and we partner with Finance executives to drive value across the enterprise. As Finance leaders move into business partner roles, they need processes, technology and people to help drive efficiencies, manage costs, improve profitability, and identify new areas of opportunity. We’ve got the deep industry experience, functional proficiency, insightful analytics, and the digital technology leadership to help our clients reinvent themselves. Whether we are improving processes, transforming the digital core, or harnessing the power of AI, we solve our clients’ toughest problems. Visit us here to find out more about CFO-Enterprise Value.

You are:
You are a recognized leader in finance transformation with a passion for helping organizations navigate complex business challenges and deliver lasting value. You thrive at the intersection of business strategy, finance, and technology, partnering with senior executives to modernize finance functions through innovative operating models, data, AI, and digital technologies. You are energized by building high-performing teams, developing trusted client relationships, and growing Accenture's Finance Transformation practice through exceptional client delivery, thought leadership, and business development.
The work:
- Lead finance transformation engagements by helping clients modernize their finance functions, define strategic objectives, prioritize initiatives, and develop actionable transformation roadmaps.

- Drive the growth of our CFO & EV team by strengthening relationships with CFOs and senior finance personnel, developing top talent, and shaping/delivering business development opportunities.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs and senior executives, bringing deep finance transformation expertise to solve complex business challenges and shape long-term transformation strategies.

- Help clients unlock greater business value by transforming finance data, analytics, planning, performance management, and reporting capabilities to enable better decision-making and support enterprise-wide digital transformation.

- Design future-state finance capabilities that harness generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and predictive analytics to streamline operations, enhance decision-making, and transform end-to-end finance processes.

- Lead the full lifecycle of client engagements, from opportunity shaping and proposal development through delivery, while managing project economics, engagement risk, executive stakeholder relationships, and client satisfaction.

- Develop, mentor, and inspire high-performing consulting teams while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Here’s what you need:
- Minimum 8 years of finance and/or management consulting experience with a specific focus on finance transformation.

- Minimum 8 years’ experience with finance functions (analytics, forecasting, core finance), including operating models, organization structures, and process redesign

- Minimum 5 years working with Canadian organizations in Banking, Insurance, Consumer Goods & Retail, Natural Resources, Oil & Gas, Utilities, Health, or Public Sector.

- Minimum 5 years leading large, multidisciplinary consulting engagements and cross-functional teams.

- Strong understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application across finance transformation, operating models, and enterprise technology.

- Bachelor's degree or college diploma in a field related to the business service provided is usually required

- Must be willing to travel

- English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

Bonus points if:
- You’re a pro when it comes to engagement – plus business, practice, and people development.

- You’ve designed finance, accounting, planning, forecasting, or reporting solutions

- You've worked with modern Finance technologies across ERP, EPM, analytics, AI, and data platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Workday, SAC, Anaplan, OneStream, Tableau, Power BI, Python, or similar solutions.

- You’ve got an MBA and/or CPA after your name or another type of advanced degree.

- Bilingual (English/French)

jobs.description:
Finance Transformation Senior Manager – CFO & Enterprise Value
Accenture , recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations define their future, create value, develop their digital core, optimize operations, and accelerate growth through strategy, technology, and innovation.
We are looking for Finance Transformation Senior Managers to join our CFO & Enterprise Value practice within Strategy & Consulting , helping organizations redefine the role of Finance as a strategic value driver through finance transformation, operating model redesign, performance improvement, digital enablement, and AI-powered innovation.
You will work closely with CFOs, CEOs, and executive leadership teams across leading organizations in Spain and internationally to define finance strategies, shape enterprise value agendas, design target operating models, and lead large-scale transformation programs that deliver sustainable business outcomes.
The role is suited for senior professionals who combine strong strategic thinking, finance expertise, executive presence, and leadership capabilities, and who are motivated by leading complex transformations at the intersection of strategy, finance, data, technology, and AI.

What you will do:
• Lead finance strategy and enterprise value engagements focused on performance improvement, value creation, transformation, and growth.
• Advise CFOs and executive leadership teams on strategic decisions related to operating models, finance transformation, performance management, cost optimization, profitability improvement, and capital efficiency.
• Define target finance operating models across organization, governance, capabilities, sourcing, processes, data, and technology.
• Lead the development of strategic roadmaps, transformation plans, and business cases, quantifying value and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility.
• Oversee the redesign and optimization of core finance processes, including P2P, O2C, R2R, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Controlling.
• Drive finance digital transformation initiatives leveraging ERP, EPM, Cloud, Data & Analytics, Automation, AI, GenAI, and emerging technologies.
• Assess the strategic impact of digital, data, and AI capabilities on the Finance function and enterprise-wide decision making.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across Strategy, Consulting, Technology, Data & AI, ensuring successful delivery and execution of transformation programs.
• Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor to CFOs and executive leadership teams.
• Contribute to business development activities, account growth, proposal development, thought leadership, and innovation initiatives related to the future of Finance and Enterprise Value.

What this role offers
• Direct engagement with CFOs, CEOs, and executive leadership teams on their most critical strategic priorities.
• The opportunity to shape high-impact transformation programs that drive enterprise value and long-term business performance.
• Leadership responsibility across the full transformation lifecycle, from strategy definition and operating model design to implementation and value realization.
• Continuous learning and exposure to Finance Strategy, Data, AI, GenAI, Enterprise Value, and emerging technologies.
• Collaboration across Accenture Strategy, Consulting, Technology, and Data & AI practices.
• Career growth within a market-leading CFO & Enterprise Value team.
• A hybrid working model, combining remote work and on-site collaboration in our Madrid office.

The role is based in Madrid , under a hybrid working model.

What we are looking for:
• 10+ years of experience in Strategy Consulting, Management Consulting, Financial Advisory, Big 4, Corporate Strategy, Finance Transformation, or similar senior advisory environments.
• Proven experience leading complex strategy and transformation engagements from definition through execution.
• Strong experience managing executive-level stakeholder relationships, including CFOs, Finance Leadership Teams, and C-suite executives.
• Deep expertise in finance strategy, enterprise value creation, operating model design, performance management, finance process transformation, or large-scale transformation programs.
• Experience defining transformation roadmaps, business cases, and value realization initiatives.
• Strong understanding of Finance technologies, including ERP, EPM, Analytics, Automation, Cloud, AI, and GenAI-enabled solutions.
• Ability to structure ambiguous business problems, synthesize insights, and develop compelling strategic narratives for executive audiences.

jobs.description:
Gestalte die kaufmännische Steuerung komplexer Infrastrukturprojekte mit & arbeite gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an der erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Energie- und Mobilitätswende!

Deine Mission
Als Consultant (all genders) begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der kaufmännischen Steuerung komplexer Infrastruktur- und Großprojekte. Dabei verbindest du kaufmännische Expertise mit einer ganzheitlichen Projektsteuerung und sorgst für finanzielle Transparenz, eine vorausschauende Steuerung sowie die frühzeitige Identifikation kommerzieller Risiken. Damit leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Energie- und Mobilitätswende. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Steuere komplexe Infrastrukturprojekte kaufmännisch
Du verantwortest zentrale kaufmännische Steuerungsprozesse – von Budgetplanung, Forecast und Kostencontrolling über Liquiditätsplanung bis hin zum monatlichen Reporting. Dabei analysierst du Projektfortschritt, Terminpläne und relevante KPIs und leitest daraus Handlungsbedarfe ab.
- Behalte kommerzielle Chancen und Risiken im Blick
Du identifizierst, bewertest und verfolgst kommerzielle Risiken und entwickelst geeignete Gegenmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus bewertest du Leistungsänderungen, Claims, Nachträge und Angebote aus kaufmännischer Perspektive.

Du erstellst Entscheidungsvorlagen, Managementberichte, Lessons Learned und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen.
- Übernimm von Tag eins Verantwortung!
Du übernimmst eigene Arbeitspakete und steuerst relevante Stakeholder auf Kunden- und Projektseite. Eine transparente Kommunikation, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und hohe Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse sind für dich selbstverständlich.

Darauf freuen wir uns

- Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar.

- Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft, in der Beratung oder in komplexen Infrastruktur- bzw. Großprojekten gesammelt.

- Du bist bestenfalls mit der Energie-, Infrastruktur- oder Mobilitätsbranche vertraut.
- Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und bringst temporäre Reisebereitschaft mit.

- Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, bei dem du die Möglichkeit hast, mobil zu arbeiten, ein eigenverantwortliches Überstundenkonto zuführen und deine Arbeitszeit aktiv selbst zu gestalten
- Zugriff auf umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zu den neusten Technologie- Trends sowie Soft Skills, damit du immer up-to-date bleibst
- Diverse sowie gleichberechtigte Teammitglieder liegen uns sehr am Herzen und um den Team-Zusammenhalt zu stärken, fördern wir regelmäßig Events und Veranstaltungen für dich und dein Team
- Ein attraktives und marktkonformes Vergütungspaket, welches du durch individuelle Zielerreichung selbst gestalten kannst

Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. jobs.description:
SAP Finance Senior Manager
Career level: Senior Manager (CL6) ·
Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh ·
Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (SAP)

About Finance RP
Within Accenture, the   Finance Reinvention Partner   helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.
You'd help lead our   Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led SAP finance transformations, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to shape deep SAP finance work and the offering around it, close to the CFO agenda it serves.

Why this role
This is a lead role for an all-round SAP finance designer — someone who knows how every finance module fits together and can stand in front of a client as the senior finance design authority on a large SAP programme. You'll run SAP-enabled finance transformations self-sufficiently, own the finance design end to end, set the standard others build to, grow the accounts you work on, and shape how we take SAP finance transformation to market.
Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and   Finance   is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.
"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
All-round SAP finance design.   You know how the SAP finance modules work and fit together — Financial Accounting (General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting) and Controlling (Cost Centre and Profit Centre Accounting, CO-PA, Allocations, Product Costing) — with hands-on design depth in the Record-to-Report core and the range to pick up the wider estate, including Group Reporting, Central Finance and Project Systems. You understand how a legacy ECC landscape evolves into an S/4HANA-enabled finance operating model, and — as the design authority for the programme — you make the calls that hold the whole finance design together.
Finance process knowledge.   Real depth across the finance process spine — Record-to-Report first, and the wider finance processes an SAP programme touches — with the judgement to connect the SAP solution to what the CFO cares about: performance, control, and reporting the business can trust. You're grounded in period-end close, consolidation readiness, management versus statutory reporting, cost management and profitability analysis, with an eye for finance controls by design.
Leading the design and the run.   You act as the finance design authority across the programme, balancing SAP fit-to-standard against the business differentiation a client genuinely needs and helping them make informed trade-offs. You run large, multi-workstream SAP finance programmes in front of the client — from early discovery and visioning through design, build, testing and deployment, and into the run: stabilising the finance function through hypercare and shaping how it optimises and improves once it's live. You hold your ground in complex landscapes — SAP-to-SAP, SAP-to-non-SAP and heritage integrations — working alongside enterprise architects and integration teams while retaining ownership of the finance agenda. You lead senior client forums, design authorities and steering committees, and you coach and develop the team around you.
Growing the work.   You spot where SAP finance transformation can do more for the client and help turn that into work, making the case for transformation in CFO language and connecting SAP capability to enterprise value. You shape propositions, support bids, and bring a clear point of view on where the SAP finance market is heading and how we should differentiate.
Ways of working.   We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. Experience of AI-enabled delivery models and digital accelerators is a real plus.

Who you are
You lead with authority and earn trust fast with senior finance and executive stakeholders. You run the room in a design workshop and bring people with you. You have the breadth to hold an entire SAP finance solution in your head and the critical thinking to keep it coherent under pressure. You have commercial instinct — an eye for where an account can grow and a firm hand on scope, commercials and contract realities. You're a genuine team player who develops the people around you, and you're known for sound, decisive calls under pressure.
Things that set strong candidates apart: all-round SAP finance design — knowing how the FI and CO modules work and fit together; a track record leading large-scale, multi-workstream SAP finance programmes end to end; SAP certification; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
You may not have done every part of this. If it's the shape of what you do, we'd like to talk.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

Due to the security requirements of this role, you must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

Sumate y sé el motor que impulsa a Accenture, una empresa que brinda servicios de consultoría y externalización a más de 40 industrias, incluyendo 89 de las FORTUNE 100, y gobiernos de todo el mundo.

El equipo de Deal Structuring & Pricing (DSP) busca perfiles graduados y experiencia en finanzas, inglés avanzado (excluyente) y residencia actual en las capital o zonas cercanas a Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Mendoza, Salta, Rosario o Mar del Plata.

Descripción del equipo y funciones
El equipo de (DSP) brinda soporte financiero especializado a los equipos comerciales de Accenture durante todo el ciclo de desarrollo de negocios. Su responsabilidad central es la estructuración, análisis y validación económico-financiera de las transacciones comerciales, definiendo las condiciones contractuales que rigen los servicios ofrecidos a clientes a nivel global. CTS actúa como socio estratégico del negocio, asegurando la viabilidad financiera, la rentabilidad y la adecuada gestión de riesgos de cada propuesta.

Por lo tanto el analista del CTS será responsable clave de definir el pricing de contratos de servicios mediante el desarrollo de modelos financieros avanzados, incluyendo forecast, análisis de P&L, estructura de costos, revenue y márgenes. Asimismo, deberá interactuar con múltiples stakeholders (comercial, legales, delivery), y contribuir a la toma de decisiones comerciales desde una perspectiva financiera y estratégica.

jobs.title: SAP Finance Transformation Manager (Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
SAP Finance Transformation Manager (Supply Chain)
Career level: Manager (CL7) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (SAP)

Why this role
This role owns the supply-chain finance and product-costing workstream end to end on large-scale SAP S/4HANA finance transformations, in front of the client, as the finance design authority for how manufacturing and supply-chain activity turns into cost transparency and margin insight. It's a role to become the person clients rely on to make the cost model hold up — product cost, inventory value and margin — and to grow into the design authority for our supply-chain finance work.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What you'll bring
Product costing and inventory valuation. Deep SAP S/4HANA product costing — standard, actual and variance — and how the material ledger carries actual costs and inventory valuation through goods movements. You understand how cost of goods sold is built and analysed, and how a cost estimate holds together from raw material to finished goods in a real manufacturing environment.

Margin and profitability. Real depth in margin analysis and COPA / profitability — turning production and supply-chain activity into profitability insight that lines up with how the business and finance actually want to see it. You know where margin comes from, where it leaks, and how variances and cost drivers explain it.

Finance process context. A clear view of how supply-chain finance connects to the wider Record-to-Report close and reporting — period-end for manufacturing and supply-chain environments, profit-centre and reporting structures, inventory and production-related controls, and the integration between logistics and finance. You can read the trade-off between operational flexibility and finance standardisation, and design for both.

Leading delivery. You lead the supply chain finance workstream end to end — fit-to-standard, finance process design, testing and deployment — as the finance design authority for the domain, keeping solutions business-led and scalable. You manage dependencies with adjacent finance and supply-chain areas, work alongside SAP delivery teams while retaining ownership of finance outcomes and margin insight, and lead functional teams across onshore and offshore delivery. You facilitate design workshops with finance, supply-chain and operations stakeholders, and keep delivery on track through structured issue management, decision papers and clear reporting.

Growing the practice. You contribute to how the practice grows — supporting proposals and bids, shaping supply-chain finance transformation approaches, and building reusable assets and points of view.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. Experience of AI-augmented delivery is a real plus.

Who you are
You take ownership and lead from the front. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and coordinate finance, supply-chain and operations perspectives with confidence. You bring a collaborative leadership style and a value-led mindset — you can link a sharper cost model to better margin insight and stronger decisions for the CFO — and you develop the people around you. Good judgement, critical thinking and clear decisions under pressure are second nature, and you're comfortable in complex, multi-workstream SAP transformation environments.
Things that set strong candidates apart: a track record (typically 7+ years) delivering product costing and supply-chain finance transformation on large-scale SAP S/4HANA programmes; the confidence to facilitate senior client discussions and lead complex design decisions; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).
If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP
Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.
You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led finance transformations on SAP S/4HANA, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on supply-chain finance and product costing while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's in it for you
Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society.

Closing date: 28/02/2027. Accenture reserves the right to close the role earlier should a suitable applicant be found.

jobs.title: Capital Markets Data, AI & Transformation — Consulting / Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Accenture Global Network · Capital Markets (Financial Services) Data, AI & Transformation
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading solutions and global professional services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed and scale. Accenture brings together deep industry expertise, proprietary assets and platforms, ecosystem partnerships, and the talent of approximately 786,000 people globally to deliver 360· value for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Accenture’s strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for clients and the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. For the fiscal year ended August 31, 2025, Accenture reported revenues of US$69.7 billion and new bookings of US$80.6 billion . Accenture also continues to position itself for growth in the age of AI, with significant momentum in generative AI and increasingly agentic AI.

About Global Network
Accenture Global Network brings together industry, functional, technology and operations consulting professionals to help clients solve complex business challenges and deliver large-scale transformation. Global Network professionals combine deep domain knowledge, delivery excellence, global collaboration and Accenture’s assets and methods to create measurable value for clients across industries and geographies.
Join the Global Network to work on high-impact transformation programs with leading global clients, contribute to differentiated offerings, and build your consulting career in a fast-paced, collaborative and innovation-led environment.

Practice Overview
Financial Services is one of the key Industry Practices within Accenture’s Global Network. The practice serves global clients across Banking, Capital Markets and Insurance.
Within Capital Markets, we work with investment banks, asset and wealth managers, exchanges, clearing houses, custodians and market infrastructure firms to address their most critical business and technology priorities. Accenture’s Capital Markets services focus on helping firms reinvent for constant change across investment banking, wealth management, asset management, private equity and market infrastructure. Accenture’s Capital Markets positioning also emphasizes data as capital, AI-driven insights, digital products, market infrastructure modernization and new operating models.
This role is focused on Capital Markets Data, AI and Transformation, covering data management, analytics, data products, data governance, data quality management, reconciliations, regulatory change, and AI-enabled operating model transformation.

Role Requirements:
• Operating Group: Capital Markets (Financial Services)
• Location: Manila
• Level (Experience): ○ Analyst (3–6 years) ○ Consultant (7–11 years) ○ Manager (12–16 years) ○ Senior Manager (17+ years)
• Travel Requirement: ○ Expected travel may range from 0% to 100% , depending on project and client needs.

Principal Domain and Expertise
The suitable candidate should be able to consult with clients across Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Asset Management, Wealth Management and Market Infrastructure functions, with strong emphasis on data-led reinvention and AI-enabled transformation.

TLM/Recon Primary Key Skills:
- Experience in TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management)
- Possess knowledge on TLM Recon admin and TLM Web Connect
- Performing functional & UAT testing during TLM patch releases
- Worked on trade and cash reconciliations
- Knowledge on Ledger and Statement reconciliations

Domain Areas
Candidates should have experience or strong understanding across one or more of the following:
- Front Office / Trading / Order Management / Execution Management
- Middle Office / Risk / P&L / Collateral / Valuations
- Back Office / Post-Trade / Settlements / Confirmations / Reconciliations
- Reference Data / Market Data / Product Data / Client Data / Counterparty Data
- Asset & Wealth Management, including front-office advisory, portfolio operations and client servicing
- Finance, Risk and Regulatory Reporting
- Clearing, Custody, Exchanges and Market Infrastructure
- Regulatory Change, including Basel, MiFID, EMIR, SFTR, CFTC, SEC, IFRS9 and related reporting obligations
- Data, AI, Automation and Digital Transformation
- AI-enabled operations and intelligent process transformation

Role Summary
The candidate will work with Accenture’s Global Network Capital Markets practice to deliver consulting and transformation engagements for global financial services clients. The role requires a strong combination of Capital Markets domain knowledge, consulting skills, business analysis capability, data transformation understanding and AI-enabled reinvention mindset.
The candidate will help clients assess current-state processes, data flows, systems and controls; define target-state operating models; design data and analytics solutions; support business requirements; and drive execution across large-scale transformation programs.
Typical responsibilities include:
- Capital Markets consulting and business analysis.
- Data management, data governance, data quality and data product transformation.
- Reconciliation and exception management process transformation.
- AI-enabled operations and intelligent process transformation
- Current-state assessment and target-state design.
- Target Operating Model definition.
- Business requirements, functional requirements, user stories and process documentation.
- Agile delivery, testing, UAT, change management and stakeholder management.
- Business case development, value realization and transformation roadmap support.
- Client management across onshore and offshore teams.
- Proposal support, offering development and thought leadership.
- Adoption of Accenture delivery methods, assets, accelerators and reinvention-led approaches.

Key Data Themes for the Role
The role will have strong focus on the following data themes:
1. Data Management
- Define and support enterprise and domain data strategies for Capital Markets clients.
- Assess current-state data landscapes across front, middle and back office.
- Support design of target-state data architecture, data flows, data ownership and operating models.
- Work across trade, transaction, position, instrument, product, pricing, market, client, counterparty, risk, finance and regulatory data domains.
- Support data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, enrichment, standardization and consumption requirements.
- Help clients move toward AI-ready, trusted and reusable data foundations. Accenture’s data services emphasize trusted, democratized and reusable data products as a foundation for faster insights and AI value.

2. Analytics and Insights
- Define business KPIs, reporting requirements and analytics use cases across Capital Markets functions.
- Support dashboards, operational analytics, risk analytics, exception analytics, P&L analytics and regulatory reporting insights.
- Translate business problems into analytical requirements and data-driven recommendations.
- Work with data scientists, engineers and technology teams to enable predictive, diagnostic and AI-enabled insights.
- Identify opportunities to use AI, generative AI and agentic AI for break investigation, root-cause analysis, controls testing, issue triage, reporting automation and decision support.

3. Data Products
- Support design and delivery of domain-aligned data products for Capital Markets use cases.
- Help define data product scope, consumers, source systems, business rules, data contracts, metadata, service levels and control requirements.
- Drive adoption of reusable data products across reporting, regulatory, risk, operations, analytics and AI use cases.
- Work with product owners, data owners, stewards, technology teams and business stakeholders to manage data product backlogs and roadmaps.

4. Data Governance
- Define or support data governance frameworks, roles, responsibilities, RACI, policies and standards.
- Support data ownership, stewardship, metadata management, lineage, data cataloging and data controls.
- Help establish governance forums, issue management processes, escalation paths and decision rights.
- Ensure data governance aligns with business, regulatory, risk, privacy and compliance expectations.
- Support AI-ready governance, including responsible data use, model input controls, lineage, explainability and traceability. Accenture’s modern data platform perspective highlights governance, access controls, lineage, encryption, data quality and compliance as critical elements for sensitive industries.

5. Data Quality Management
- Define and implement data quality rules, scorecards, dashboards and controls.
- Assess data quality across dimensions such as completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, validity, uniqueness and integrity.
- Support data profiling, root-cause analysis, remediation planning and data quality issue management.
- Establish data quality operating models across business, operations, technology and control teams.
- Support data observability and proactive monitoring for critical data elements.

6. Reconciliations and Controls
- Support trade, cash, position, holdings, securities, nostro, custody, P&L, fees, commissions and regulatory reconciliations.
- Analyze breaks, exceptions and unmatched items across systems, ledgers, custodians, market infrastructures and external data sources.
- Define reconciliation logic, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows and control dashboards.
- Drive simplification and automation of reconciliation processes using workflow, analytics, AI and intelligent automation.
- Support target operating model design for exception management, control ownership, SLA management and regulatory evidence.

Technical Know-How – Good to Have
Candidates are not expected to be deep technologists but should have working knowledge of data platforms, feeds, tools and industry data flows relevant to Capital Markets.
Data Feeds and Standards
Good to have exposure to:

- Trade lifecycle data flows across OMS, EMS, risk, settlement, accounting, reporting and reconciliation platforms.
- Corporate actions, securities master, pricing, ratings, benchmarks, calendars, legal entity, counterparty and client reference data.

- Ataccama

- Own BRDs, FRDs, user stories, functional specifications and requirement traceability.
- Support data discovery, data profiling, source-to-target mapping and data lineage documentation.
- Support design of data quality rules, data controls, reconciliation rules and exception workflows.
- Analyze data issues, reconciliation breaks and operational exceptions.
- Support UAT planning, test case preparation, test execution and defect triage.

- Own program governance, project planning, RAID management, status reporting and delivery quality.

- Drive data issue resolution, reconciliation remediation, control uplift and operational efficiency initiatives.

- Build client relationships and support account growth.
- Contribute to offering development, POVs, methodology refinement, training and capability building.
- Manage people development, staffing, delivery quality and risk management.

- Drive Capital Markets data, AI and reinvention-led transformation opportunities.
- Shape large-scale programs across data management, governance, analytics, reconciliations, operations and technology modernization.

jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture Strategy. Through deep industry expertise, analytics, and insights, we empower clients to survive and thrive in the new, the now and the unknown. To stay agile in a world dominated by change, the C-suite must keep the core business running while simultaneously identifying and investing in the new. Accenture Strategy consulting enables leaders to act quickly and confidently as they pivot to the future. Known for our ability to execute at speed, we help clients determine clear, actionable paths to competitive agility by bringing them new thinking on business and technology.

You Are:

A Strategy Consulting Manager with significant experience in the finance or energy industry and a focus on investment and trading. Your expertise? Using state-of-the-art quantitative analysis, analytics, and risk management techniques to help clients achieve their investment, trading, and risk management strategies. You have energy and drive in abundance, along with personal resilience, a passion for serving clients, and a love of continual learning. You have a flair for breaking down processes into logical parts and constructing crystal-clear reasoning and analyses. Communication and people skills? You’re rich in both, and you’re ready to hit the ground running in a team setting where you’re a natural at appreciating diverse perspectives and bringing out the best in people.

The Work:
Accenture Commodity Markets & Trading is a growing team that works globally to help our clients navigate commodity risk and unlock value through commodity risk management, investment advisory, and commercial optimization. We work with diverse clients across commodity value chains for industries ranging from energy to soft commodities to capital markets.

- Advise clients on the top priorities of their asset portfolios, such as corporate restructuring, capital planning, and balance-sheet optimization; and revamp their value chains based on market and industry conditions

- Provide energy consulting to help clients to navigate the energy transition through development of new, cutting-edge business models, advising on sustainability strategies and developing market outlooks

- Help commodity trading organizations set up and expand their trading and risk management activities across energy markets and other commodity value chains

- Lead project teams to shape clients’ investment/divestment transactions, and help create innovative, agile business models that help clients pivot to the New

- Lead analysis of clients’ businesses and advise them on how they can grow their product margin, boost supply certainty, and reduce price/volumetric volatility

- Use quantitative and qualitative analysis to craft strategies to help clients enter new markets that can boost growth.

- Strengthen relationships with clients to sustain Accenture’s profile as a long-term trusted advisor and partner.

- Lead teams in driving insights and recommendations using data models and visualization tools

- Manage junior members of the Strategy team

- Travel as needed, up to 80%

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum 6 years of experience in the consulting industry or equivalent in an internal consulting role, or minimum 6 years experience working in the energy industry, commodity markets or investment banking.
- A Bachelor’s degree

- You have an MBA or equivalent graduate degree
- Strong quantitative skills and analytical thinker with 2-3 years of prior experience in driving insights using statistics or data analysis
- You know how global markets work, you have a grasp of commodity trends, and you’ve worked in commodity marketing and trading
- You’ve been exposed to one or more of the following industries: energy, chemicals, soft commodities, agriculture, metals, mining, utilities, transportation, consumer goods, or capital markets

jobs.title: Digital Core – Technology AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Technology Strategy & Transformation Lead – Philippines

Join our Technology Strategy & Transformation Global Network practice in the Philippines for an exciting opportunity to build and lead a world-class AI-enabled consulting capability for global clients. You will define and execute the practice growth agenda, drive AI-led consulting engagements, and position our Philippines delivery hub as a premier destination for AI strategy and transformation talent.

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Delivery Network
Areas of Work: AI led Technology Consulting Practice Development & Client Delivery
Level: Consulting Lead / Associate Director
Location: Manila / Taguig (Philippines) Years of Exp: 15+ years

Explore an Exciting Career Opportunity

Do you thrive on building consulting practices from the ground up, winning and delivering high-impact AI transformation engagements, and helping global clients navigate complex technology change? Are you a consulting leader who can operate with equal conviction in a C-suite boardroom and in a delivery team sprint? Are you passionate about elevating technology talent onto the world stage? If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join our Technology Strategy & Transformation Global Network practice and take ownership of building a credible, scalable AI enabled consulting capability in the Philippines. You will define the practice service lines, recruit and develop a high-performing local team, win and grow global client accounts, and serve as the most senior delivery and client relationship owner in market. This is a rare opportunity to shape a practice from the ground up while working with some of the world’s largest enterprises.

The Practice – A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value. We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale program delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys — from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support: The Philippines hub sits at the intersection of three global trends: the maturation of AI ready enterprise technology, the rise of the country as a high-value knowledge services hub, and the growing demand from global CIOs and CTOs for consulting capability that can combine strategic advisory with cost-competitive delivery. You will be the leader who capitalizes on all three.

These are the initiatives you will own and drive:

- Practice Set up and Growth : Establish the Philippines’ Tech Strategy and Transformation capability from the ground up — define Sub Capability growth, build delivery playbooks, and create repeatable solution assets that enable the practice to scale.

- Client Growth & Account Development: Identify growth opportunities and key critical clients and work with Client leads to upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing relationships, provide solution support and own end to end delivery, build a lighthouse client base with referenceable outcomes that drive market presence.

- AI Delivery Excellence: Lead delivery quality across all AI and Transformation engagements — establish governance, risk, and benefits realization frameworks aligned to global best practice.

- Team Building & Talent Development: Recruit, develop and retain a high performing team of consultants, architects, data engineers and domain specialists; design career pathways and a competency framework that makes the Philippines hub competitive for top AI talent.

- Market Positioning & Thought Leadership: Build brand equity in the Philippines Accenture ecosystem; engage with other Reinvention Partners, produce thought leadership and represent the practice at industry forums to drive visibility and pipeline.

- Global Practice Alignment: Serve as the primary connector between the Philippines practice and global delivery leadership; share innovations, contribute to global offerings, and ensure the hub is fully integrated into international client delivery programs.

What’s in it for you?

- An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
- Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
- Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
- Develop your advisory acumen
- Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

About Accenture: Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

About Digital Core Reinvention Partner: Digital Core Reinvention Partner helps clients reinvent their digital foundations — including technology strategy and architecture, AI and data, modernizing and managing applications, infrastructure, and cloud.
