jobs.title: Security Consulting Consultant - Products
jobs.description:
Job Role: Security Consulting Consultant - Products
Location: UK (Hybrid)
Career Level: Manager (CL9)

As a team:
Accenture Security helps organisations build cyber resilience and navigate complex business and technology transformation. We work with some of the world's leading organisations to manage cyber risk, modernise security capabilities and drive secure innovation.
Joining our team means working alongside a global network of security professionals who combine deep technical expertise with industry insight to help clients solve their most pressing security challenges. You will have the opportunity to work on complex programmes, develop new skills, and grow your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation and continuous learning.

About the Role:
As a Security Consulting Consultant in the Products Security industry group, you will be responsible for overseeing security-related activities at one of our clients in areas such as Retail, Consumer Goods, Industrials and Life Sciences.
You will support clients in addressing cybersecurity challenges by combining technical, business and industry knowledge across a range of security domains.
We are looking for candidates with experience in one or more cybersecurity domains and an interest in developing industry and commercial skills.
In this role, you will work with delivery teams to ensure existing projects are operating as expected, while also building relationships and developing new opportunities with clients. You will act as a bridge between the client, the client account team, and our group of experts in the security domain teams.

In this role you will:
- Conduct cybersecurity strategy assessments, maturity and readiness evaluations, and discovery workshops using industry frameworks and compliance mandates

- Lead security workstreams and deliver agreed outcomes, managing activities, dependencies and quality throughout delivery.

- Perform detailed analysis of risks, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending mitigations aligned with industry standards

- Create high-quality deliverables including threat and risk assessments, security policies, procedures, and compliance evidence

- Work collaboratively with project teams to embed security controls and risk management practices into technology solutions from design through to operation.

- Support design and implementation of robust cybersecurity solutions tailored to client environments and risk profiles

- Stay current on emerging threats, AI-driven security solutions, and regulatory developments, contributing insights to shape client strategies

- Contribute to sales pursuits, proposals, and commercial responses

- Develop strong industry-specific knowledge to help clients define, implement, and run tailored security solutions.

- Develop expertise in a wide range of innovative tools, technologies, and methodologies across all Security offerings.

We are looking for experience in the following skills:
- 3–5 years of work experience in Cyber Security

- Proven experience in consultancy projects and/ or large organizations

- Relevant experience in one of these domains: GRC, IAM, Cloud Security, Application Security, Operational Technology (OT) security and Security Operations.

- Familiarity with at least one recognised security framework

- Experience delivering cybersecurity assessments, security initiatives or technical implementation projects.

- Experience working with multidisciplinary teams across security, technology and business functions.

- Experience producing client-facing deliverables, reports, presentations and recommendations.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed security recommendations based on technical evidence.

- High attention to detail and rigorous logical thinking ability

- Good communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage client stakeholders

- Willingness to travel across the UK as projects require

Set yourself apart:
- Professional certifications: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP or equivalent.

- Experience in one of these sectors: Retail, Consumer Goods, Industrials or Life Sciences.

- Commercial awareness and an interest in understanding how cybersecurity supports business outcomes.

- Familiarity with AI security risks, AI-enabled security capabilities, and other emerging technologies and practices, with an understanding of how they are influencing the cybersecurity landscape.

jobs.title: Risk Consultant - Strategy & Consulting
jobs.description:
Are you a driven Risk professional eager to shape the future of financial services through the power of AI and advanced technology? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial risk, data and innovation — and are you ready to bring that expertise to some of the most complex transformation programmes in banking, financial services and pension funds?

Are you motivated to help financial institutions navigate an era of rapid regulatory change, increasing complexity and AI-driven disruption? And do you want to do so within a team of bold thinkers and delivery experts who are redefining what risk consulting looks like?

Then look no further. As a Consultant within our Strategy & Consulting – Risk practice, you will be at the forefront of risk transformation. You will support leading banks, financial services organisations and pension funds in delivering large-scale transformation programmes, with a focus on AI implementation, regulatory change and risk framework modernisation.
Team:

Our Team
Our Risk consultants sit at the heart of financial services transformation, combining deep risk expertise with AI and advanced analytics to help clients build smarter, more resilient risk functions. From day one, you will take ownership of workstreams, accelerate your development and build strong, long-term client relationships—working alongside risk specialists, data scientists and regulatory experts to deliver meaningful impact.

What You’ll Do:
Risk Governance & Oversight
• Support AI governance, model risk and risk framework design, including controls lifecycle management
• Strengthen oversight, controls and compliance across risk functions

Risk Analytics & Intelligence
• Deliver financial risk modelling, scenario analysis and stress testing
• Leverage data, automation and machine learning to enhance risk insights and decision-making

Operational Risk Management
• Design and enhance operational risk frameworks, embedding data, automation and AI-driven capabilities
• Help clients strengthen resilience through improved controls and intelligent risk management

AI Implementation in Risk (at the core)
• Support the transition from proof-of-concept to production-grade AI
• Embed machine learning into risk pipelines and deploy automated control testing
• Build auditable AI-driven solutions, including risk co-pilots

Interested?  Please apply with your CV and motivation letter.

#LI-EU

What you’ll need:
• Experience in risk consulting or a risk function within banking, financial services, pension funds or insurance
• A solid foundation in Risk Governance & Oversight, Risk Analytics & Intelligence and/or Operational Risk Management
• Hands-on experience with AI or advanced analytics in a regulated environment (e.g. model development, deployment, validation or governance)
• Exposure to risk-related system implementations (e.g. credit origination, GRC tooling, risk data platforms)

jobs.description:

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Our Utilities CFO & Enterprise Value Practice sits at the intersection of two of the most dynamic transformations in industry — the reinvention of the Office of the CFO and the energy transition reshaping electric, gas, and water utilities. We partner with utilities CFOs and finance leaders to modernize the close, accounting, fixed assets, controllership, regulatory reporting, planning, and rate-case-ready data — unlocking insight, productivity, and measurable enterprise value as our clients navigate clean energy, grid modernization, and capital-intensive investment cycles.

You Are:
A trusted advisor to finance leaders who helps modernize accounting, fixed assets, and finance operations. You combine hands-on finance and ERP experience with strong consulting, communication, and delivery skills, and you bring a working understanding of the priorities that shape capital-intensive, regulated industries such as utilities. You are comfortable partnering across business, technology, client, product, testing, training, and offshore teams to align priorities, solve complex finance problems, and guide users through new ways of working. You bring practical knowledge of finance process design, fixed asset and capital accounting, and finance data, and you know how to translate CFO priorities into scalable solutions that improve controllership, decision support, and enterprise value.

The Work:
- Support finance transformation programs for utilities CFO and controller organizations, including finance process redesign, solution design, data conversion, testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live adoption.

- Lead or contribute to workstreams across core finance areas — General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets / capital accounting, Project Accounting, Intercompany, and regulatory/FERC reporting — aligning design to the client’s chart of accounts, accounting policies, and controllership requirements.

- Design and deliver Fixed Asset and capital accounting capabilities tailored to utilities — including CWIP, unitization, asset retirement obligations (AROs), depreciation studies, regulatory asset treatment, and integration with Projects and GL.

- Translate utilities CFO priorities into measurable enterprise value cases — building business cases, value architectures, and KPI baselines that link finance capabilities to outcomes such as faster close, improved forecast accuracy, rate-case readiness, and reduced cost-to-serve.

- Analyze finance process data — chart of accounts, sub-ledger mappings, master data, journals, asset registers, and reconciliations — to inform design, cleanse legacy data, and validate cutover readiness.

- Collaborate across client stakeholders, Accenture delivery teams, product teams, integration teams, testing teams, training teams, and offshore resources to deliver coordinated finance transformation outcomes.

- Support scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, user story development, acceptance criteria, demos, and defect triage for finance workstreams.

- Provide hands-on training, coaching, and enablement for utilities finance users, super users, and project team members to support long-term adoption.

- Support execution of cutover activities, deployment readiness, change enablement, and stakeholder communications for finance releases.

- Identify opportunities to improve delivery methods, solution quality, and cross-team collaboration while helping utilities CFOs realize finance transformation value.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

What You Need:
- Minimum of 3 years Finance transformation consulting experience — including process design, controllership, close optimization, or CFO advisory work.

- Minimum of 3 years hands-on experience implementing or supporting ERP Finance solutions (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP) across GL, AP, AR, or Fixed Assets.

- Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Fixed Asset / capital accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, and integration with Projects.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience working with finance process data — chart of accounts design, sub-ledger to ledger reconciliation, data conversion, or finance master data management.

- Minimum of 1 years of experience serving utilities clients (electric, gas, or water) or in a utilities finance, controllership, or regulatory function.

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (6 years) work experience. If an Associate's Degree, 3 years of work experience is required.

Bonus Points If:
- You have a CPA, CMA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent accounting/finance credential.

- You have familiarity with utilities-specific accounting and reporting — FERC/USoA chart of accounts, regulatory assets and liabilities, rate cases, AROs, CWIP, and unitization.

- You have ERP Finance certification (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting, Oracle Cloud ERP Financials).

- You have experience with EPM tools (SAP Group Reporting/SAC, Oracle EPM) and how they connect to finance.

- You have familiarity with embedding GenAI / agentic AI into close, controls, planning, and reporting processes.

- You have experience working in Scrum or Agile delivery environments, including user stories, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, demos, or defect resolution.

- You have experience collaborating across cross-functional business, technology, integration, testing, training, client, and offshore teams.

jobs.title: Strategy & Consulting | Tech Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
In Technology Strategy & Advisory we help our clients to shape their technological vision and execute on their digital and technology.
Our focus is on helping clients harness technology and innovation to create exceptional, sustainable value from the investments they're making and about helping them reinvent their business.
We like to think our Technology Strategy & Advisory practice as one hand in technology and one hand in the business slide of the equation, working in the C- Suite, advising boards of directors on topics of technology both current and future, and helping them design these transformations for exceptional value.

📌 We're organized into 3 domains:
- Tech- Driven Growth Strategy
- Tech Value, Debt Management and Cost Takeout
- Tech Operating Model and Organizational Design for Technology

Tech- Driven Growth Strategy

Our clients call us when they want to create new technology-based revenue streams, have a major business event and are questioning how technology can best be used to respond (acquisition/divestiture, EPS miss, activist investor, change in c-suite leadership), or have doubts about the ability for technology or the IT organization to deliver value.

Type of work (examples, not exhaustive)
- Digital Strategy / Digital Strategy Roadmap
- Technology/IT Strategy / Platform Business Strategy
- Enterprise Technology Assessments
- M&A Due Diligence: Tech Separation (Carve-Out) Strategy / PMI Integration
- Portfolio Optimization
- Technology Visioning & Future Tech
- Cloud Strategy & Roadmap

Tech Value, Debt Management and Cost Takeout

Help clients ensure that technology investments are aligned to business outcomes – revenue growth or profitability increase, – and transparently communicate the value of technology to the business through data-driven cost transparency, tracking tech spend and allocation of dollars to initiatives, products and business units. Advise and provide transformation assurance services focused on legacy system elimination and reduction in technical debt, to allow for holistic and composable enterprise architectures. Offer cost-takeout solutions for utilizing technology to maximize enterprise efficiency and effectiveness by shifting spend away from the ‘old’ and adopting flexible mindset for managing platforms.

Type of work (examples, not exhaustive)
- Tech Business Management Strategy & Design
- Service Catalog Design & Chargeback Model Design
- IT Finance / IT Expense Analysis & Hypothesis Creation
- FinOps Strategy & Design / FinOps Op Model Design
- Investment Governance & Prioritization
- Technology Funding Model
- Value Measurement/OKR Strategy
- Value Stream Mapping and Taxonomy
- Cloud Cost Optimization
- Labor Cost Optimization

Tech Operating Model and Organizational Design for Technology

Help clients drive improvements in technology product/service quality, agility, and cost in concert. Provide a clear, consensus-driven blueprint for the holistic set of enterprise capabilities required to create, deliver, and maintain technology-enabled products/services to meet business strategy and customer experience expectations.
Bring industry-specific context to determine how technology is harnessed and measured to create digital customer experiences that differentiate from competitors and design the products and services that will deliver those experiences.

Type of work (examples, not exhaustive)
- Enterprise Operating Model design for Tech. Services / Tech Operating Model / IT Operating Model Design / Product Operating Model
- Operating Model for Gen AI and ML powered Tech
- Lean Portfolio Management (LPM) Design
- Tech Workforce Strategy and Design ( inc Talent, Reskilling, Productivity & Enablement) / Tech Organization Sizing and Design
- Tech Career Model Design with Defined Competencies and Career Paths
- Sourcing Strategy and Client Captive Strategy
- Tech Scorecard/ Performance Metrics (OKRs aligning work to outcomes)
- Tech Operating Model for M&A or Tech Separation (Carve-Out)

- Bachelor’s degree (completed): Engineering careers, would be preferred   - MBA may be a plus.
- High proficiency of English (level C1 required)

- Experience leading large technology programs/transformations (+5 years)
- Experience on Tech Strategy Domains (at least one of them)

jobs.title: Security Consultant
jobs.description:
Role description
Join Accenture's Cyber Security practice
At Accenture, we protect the world's leading organizations against an ever-evolving threat landscape. We're looking for a Security Consultant to join our growing Cyber Security practice, someone who brings deep expertise in at least one security domain and the drive to make a real impact for our clients.

What you'll do
- Advise clients on their security posture and help them design and implement tailored solutions
- Conduct assessments, gap analyses, and roadmap planning aligned to industry standards
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, both internally and on the client side, to deliver security programs end to end
- Stay ahead of emerging threats, technologies, and regulations to bring fresh thinking to every engagement
- Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, and the development of Accenture's security offerings

We welcome candidates with a strong background in any of the following areas:
- Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) : risk frameworks, regulatory compliance (ISO 27001, NIST, SOC2), policy development, and audit support
- Identity & Access Management / Privileged Access Management (IAM/PAM) :  identity lifecycle, privileged access governance, SSO/MFA, directory services, and PAM tooling (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Sailpoint)
- Cloud Security : securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), cloud architecture reviews, CSPM, and DevSecOps practices
- Security Operations (SOC/SIEM) : threat detection and response, SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar), incident management, and security monitoring
- Application Security : secure SDLC, code reviews, penetration testing, vulnerability management, and OWASP frameworks
- Data Privacy & Protection : data classification, DLP strategies, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), and data governance programs
- Threat Intelligence & Hunting : adversary profiling, IOC analysis, proactive threat hunting, and intelligence-led defense
- Network & Infrastructure Security : firewall and perimeter management, zero trust architecture, endpoint security, and network segmentation

What we're looking for
- 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in one or more cybersecurity domains
- A solid understanding of the security landscape and the ability to translate technical risk into business language
- Experience working in consulting, professional services, or a client-facing role is a plus
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Relevant certifications are valued (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CyberArk Defender, Azure/AWS Security, or equivalent)
- A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, project-driven environment

Why Accenture?
You'll work alongside some of the sharpest minds in the industry, on some of the most complex security challenges in the world. We invest in your growth through continuous learning, certifications, and career development and we celebrate the diversity of backgrounds and perspectives that make our teams stronger.
Accenture is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Retail Merchandising and Planning – Consultant
We Are
Accenture's Retail Merchandising and Planning practice helps the world's leading retailers reinvent how they buy, plan, allocate, and manage product across the value chain. We work at the intersection of merchandising strategy, planning process design, and AI-enabled decision making, helping clients across apparel, hardlines, grocery, and specialty retail modernize their operating models and improve performance in demand forecasting, assortment planning, and inventory productivity.
You Are
A retail merchandising and planning professional who pairs functional expertise with a strong aptitude for learning and a drive to deliver. You've built a foundation close to the buy — in category management, merchandise financial planning, assortment, allocation, replenishment, or demand/supply planning — and you understand how these functions connect end-to-end. Depth in every area isn't expected at this level; what matters is that you bring real functional knowledge, apply it to solve client problems, and build quickly on your base. You're comfortable executing analysis, contributing to client-ready deliverables, and engaging with client stakeholders day to day, and you're eager to grow into broader leadership as you take on more responsibility.
The Work
As a Consultant, you will execute and contribute to workstreams within larger transformation engagements for retail clients, working alongside client stakeholders and Accenture leadership to develop recommendations, drive delivery, and help realize results.
Project Execution
- Contribute to the delivery of a workstream within a broader transformation program, owning discrete tasks, key components of deliverables, and analyses end-to-end
- Synthesize disparate data sources into insights and clear, client-ready deliverables
- Work with clients to identify and interpret key project requirements
- Develop and nurture relationships with client stakeholders within your scope
- Support project planning and coordination to ensure effective, on-time delivery of client work
- Coordinate with subject matter experts within the firm to align on priorities and accomplish objectives
- Produce high-quality, timely work and exhibit integrity in decisions and firm relationships

Merchandising & Planning Transformation
- Support assessments of current-state merchandising, planning, and inventory management capabilities against industry-leading practices
- Contribute to future-state operating model design spanning category management, merchandise financial planning, assortment planning, allocation, replenishment, demand planning, and supply planning
- Support the development of capability strategies, transformation roadmaps, and value cases that quantify the impact of change
- Apply sub-industry nuance across apparel, hardlines, and/or grocery to help tailor recommendations to client-specific dynamics

AI & Technology Enablement
- Bring current knowledge of AI, analytics, and emerging planning technologies to help identify where they can solve merchandising and planning business problems
- Support clients in evaluating planning platforms and AI-enabled decision-making tools as part of broader transformation
- Contribute to the design and delivery of GenAI- and agentic-enabled planning capabilities where applicable to client roadmaps

Business Development & Practice Development
- Provide merchandising and planning insights and benchmarking
- Support the development and review of client-facing summaries and analyses
- Work with the team to identify and assess opportunities for value creation and performance improvement
- Create and curate deliverable content (POV slides, working session prep, case studies) to capture merchandising and planning knowledge and support internal knowledge share and business development
- Help aggregate and manage data and intellectual capital for ongoing benchmarking, and insight generation
- Collaborate closely with junior and senior Accenture team members

Basic Qualifications
- 3 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the following: Category Management, Merchandise Financial Planning (MFP), Assortment Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Demand Planning, or Supply Planning at a Retailer
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in professional services at a consulting firm (or equivalent internal consulting experience)
- Strong problem-solving ability and sound business judgment
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a dynamic, fast-moving environment
- Comfort operating in ambiguous situations
- Familiarity with the operational nuances of one or more retail sub-industries, including apparel, hardlines, or grocery
- Experience supporting operating model design, process reinvention, capability assessments, roadmaps, or value case development
- Experience developing deliverable content
- Working knowledge of current trends in technology, analytics, and AI, and how they apply to merchandising and planning business problems
- Prior industry experience in Buying, Planning, or Product Development
- Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini in a professional environment
- Familiarity with leading planning platforms such as o9, Blue Yonder, Anaplan, Oracle, or RELEX
- MBA or equivalent advanced degree

jobs.description:
Role: CRM Business Architect
Practice: Accenture Song Service
Career Level: 8 - Associate Manager
Location:  Dublin, Ireland

Role Overview
We are expanding the Accenture Song CRM practice in Ireland and are seeking a CRM Business Architect with a strong technology consulting background to help clients translate growth, customer and operational priorities into practical CRM capabilities, target architectures and transformation roadmaps.
This mid-senior role combines business architecture, CRM strategy, marketing technology, enterprise AI and solution architecture. You will assess current capabilities, define pragmatic target states and design integrated solutions across CRM, data and AI ecosystems, working with senior stakeholders and specialist teams to turn business priorities into feasible transformation roadmaps and delivery plans.

Key Responsibilities
Business Architecture & Consulting
- Lead discovery with senior business and technology stakeholders to define priorities, pain points, constraints and value opportunities.

- Develop current- and future-state business architectures spanning customer journeys, capabilities, processes, operating model, governance, data and technology.

- Translate business outcomes into prioritised roadmaps, architecture artefacts and executive recommendations that align stakeholders around a shared target state.

CRM Solution Architecture & Technology Strategy
- Shape end-to-end CRM and martech architectures connecting customer experience, data, identity, content, decisioning, channels, workflow and integration.

- Design interoperable solutions across major ecosystems, including Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics 365. Adobe Workfront, AEP, AEM and AJO experience is particularly relevant.

- Assess technology estates, define architecture principles and integration patterns, and recommend secure, scalable and operable platform solutions.

Enterprise AI & Intelligent Customer Architecture
- Define enterprise AI architectures for customer engagement across intelligent profiles, governed data and context, models, agents, tools, workflows and channels.

- Design secure MCP and integration layers and enterprise orchestration across events, decision engines, workflows, AI agents and human approval points.

- Set production requirements for grounding, evaluation, observability, privacy, security, resilience, cost and responsible AI governance.

Solution Shaping, Delivery & Practice Leadership
- Shape architecture-led opportunities and proposals, including scope, approach, estimates, risks, dependencies and value case.

- Bridge strategy and implementation through architecture governance, design assurance and collaboration across product, design, data, engineering and delivery teams.

- Strengthen the Song CRM practice through reusable methods, reference architecture and thought leadership.

We’re looking for an experienced technology consultant who can connect business outcomes, customer strategy and enterprise architecture. You will bring structure to ambiguity, move confidently between executive and technical conversations, and lead multidisciplinary teams from discovery through solution shaping and delivery.

- 4+ years’ experience across technology consulting, business or solution architecture, CRM, martech or enterprise transformation.

- Strong business architecture capability, including current- and future-state assessment, capability and value-stream modelling, operating models, roadmaps and transition planning.

- Practical solution architecture experience across customer platforms, data, cloud, APIs, integration and non-functional requirements in complex enterprise environments.

- Depth in at least one leading CRM or martech ecosystem. Adobe Experience Cloud experience, particularly Workfront, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager or Adobe Journey Optimizer, is highly desirable. Equivalent expertise in Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or another major ecosystem is also valued.

- Strong understanding of enterprise AI and intelligent customer architecture, including unified profiles, grounding and context management, MCP-based integration, agent and workflow orchestration, observability, security and responsible AI controls.

- Ability to translate complex business and technical information into clear architecture options, executive recommendations, commercially sound proposals and feasible delivery plans.

- Confidence influencing senior marketing, customer, data and technology stakeholders and facilitating decisions across competing priorities.

Desirable Qualifications
- Relevant architecture, platform, data, AI or cloud certifications.
- Experience using practical architecture methods and tools to model capabilities, processes, solutions and technology decisions.
- Experience with agentic AI platforms, knowledge retrieval or graph patterns, event-driven integration, API management and enterprise workflow orchestration.
- Experience delivering transformation in regulated or complex sectors such as financial services, healthcare, retail, consumer goods or technology.

jobs.title: AI Security (Senior) Consultant
jobs.description:
Lead with expertise, drive innovation.

Are you an experienced professional ready to take your career to the next level? At Accenture the Netherlands, we're seeking AI Security (Senior) Consultant who bring deep expertise, strategic thinking, and a passion for innovation to help us solve complex challenges and deliver exceptional results.

We are open to candidates coming from either of the directions below. You do not need to be strong in both – but you should be clearly strong in one.

A. AI for Security, industry-focused. You understand how AI changes the way security work gets done, and you can apply that to a specific industry context — financial services, public sector, healthcare, or another regulated sector. You know the operating models and the regulatory pressures of your sector, and you can articulate the value AI brings for clients in that space.
B. Secure AI, implementation-focused. You come from a more technical background and are interested in how organizations securely adopt and deploy AI. You engage credibly with engineering and MLOps teams, assess the security posture of AI systems, and help clients build AI capability that does not create new risk faster than it delivers value.

What you'll do:
- Deliver client engagements across AI security assessment, advisory, and implementation support, with increasing ownership as you develop.

- Assess and improve the security of AI systems, applying frameworks such as the OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS to real client environments, identifying gaps and recommending practical remediation.

- Support AI-native security delivery, contributing to Cyber.AI deployments and agent-based security workflows alongside forward-deployed engineers.

- Translate between technical and business audiences, explaining AI security risk to a CISO and translating control requirements for a development team, often in the same week.

- Translate regulatory frameworks such as DORA, NIS2 and the EU AI Act into concrete client requirements and solution designs for AI systems.

- Advise clients on securing AI across people, process, and technology, not technology alone.

- Contribute to methodology, assessment tooling, sector-specific points of view, and business development including proposals and RFPs.

How We Reinvent

At Accenture, our teams operate within one of our core service lines – Digital Core, Industry & Enterprise, Supply Chain & Engineering, Cybersecurity, Song, Finance, Talent, Client Groups, Global Operations, Reinvention Services – each designed to drive reinvention at scale. This role falls under Cybersecurity, where we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients secure the AI systems they are building, and to deliver security itself through AI – protecting our clients as they reinvent.

You'll be part of a multidisciplinary team composed of security consultants, AI engineers, forward-deployed engineers, architects, and industry specialists, working collaboratively to solve complex challenges and shape the future of intelligent business. Whether it's transforming digital cores, embedding AI into operations, or designing human-centric experiences, our teams are empowered to innovate boldly and deliver measurable impact.

We go to market by industry, leveraging our global delivery network and strategic partnerships with ecosystem leaders like Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, AWS, and Google. Our culture of shared success and continuous learning ensures that every team member contributes to – and benefits from – our reinvention journey.

What we're looking for:
- Education : Education: Master's degree in a relevant field – computer science, cybersecurity, information security, artificial intelligence, engineering, or similar.

- Experience : Approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology consulting, security engineering, or a closely related field.

- Skills: Working understanding of AI and machine learning systems – you do not need to have trained models, but you should understand how LLM applications, RAG architectures, and agentic systems actually work. Solid cybersecurity foundation across frameworks, controls, and risk assessment. Understanding of the intersection between securing AI and the responsible use of AI. Ability to engage credibly with engineering and MLOps teams. Strong structuring and communication skills.

- Leadership: Genuine curiosity about AI security as a discipline. This field changes monthly; the role suits someone who stays current because they want to, not because they have to. Comfort with ambiguity, and the confidence to form a view and defend it.

Bonus points for :
- Consulting or professional services background.

- Dutch language proficiency.

- Depth in a specific industry vertical – financial services, public sector, healthcare, or another regulated sector – and the ability to articulate the value AI brings for clients in that space.

About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Find out more about us at  www.accenture.com

YOU ARE
You own the full process transformation design cycle for your industry or function — from assessing how market forces, regulatory shifts, and technology changes are reshaping the landscape, through specifying the future-state process, to defining how people will adopt new ways of working. You're the domain authority on your team: clients and colleagues come to you because of what you know about how this industry or function actually works. You combine business expertise, technical literacy and AI process to drive transfromation.
You are AX designing at the intersection of human, agent, and process as part of the transformation work. When you design a future-state process, you naturally consider how AI agent experiences should be shaped to serve both the business outcome and the people working alongside those agents.

THE WORK
Embed AI into future state design for clients as well as in ways of working for your team using the appropriate AI tools and creating agents strategically to aid in deliverable creation.
- Lead future-state process specification, AI integration design, operating model changes, and adoption planning for your assigned industry or functional area.

- Run client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership; manage day-to-day client relationships and issue resolution.

- Drive benchmarking analysis and change-impact assessments grounded in deep knowledge of how your industry or function operates.

- Facilitate design thinking sessions and co-creation workshops with cross-functional client teams.

- Connect operating model to future-state processes to drive transformation approaches that are practical and credible.

- Build and maintain documented redesign methods and playbook contributions for your assigned functional process areas.

- Contribute to business development by qualifying opportunities and co-authoring proposals.

- Coach junior practitioners on process redesign methods, domain-specific trend assessment, and operating model design.

- Embed AX Design principles into process specifications — defining how AI agent experiences should be shaped within each process step in your domain, including agent autonomy levels, escalation triggers, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.

EDUCATION
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION
- Minimum 5 years of experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting

- Demonstrated ability to lead client discovery workshops and present recommendations to senior leadership

- Proven track record building benchmarking analyses and change-impact assessments

- Experience using AI-assisted tools for benchmarking, analytics, or workshop facilitation

- Minimum of 1 year experience designing future-state processes with AI to reinvent the way the work is done (e.g. operating model changes, adoption approaches, etc.)

Minimum 1 year
- Applied knowledge of AI Design principles — specifying AI agent experiences within process designs, including autonomy levels, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoff quality

jobs.title: Guidewire Senior Consultant – Policy Center
jobs.description:
About Accenture
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Find out more about us at  www.accenture.com .

Join a leading Accenture programme delivering transformational Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation for a Tier-1 Australian insurer.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Guidewire Senior Consultant to join our Sydney-based delivery team. This is a high-impact, client-facing role embedded within a large-scale Guidewire Cloud implementation programme covering PolicyCenter (PC), BillingCenter (BC). The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of delivery, technical excellence, and client engagement, bringing both deep Guidewire expertise and an AI-forward mindset to drive programme outcomes.

1. Roles & Responsibilities
Delivery & Technical Leadership
- Lead end-to-end configuration, development, and integration activities across Guidewire InsuranceSuite (PC / BC ).
- Drive technical design discussions and solution architecture in alignment with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) best practices.
- Oversee code quality, peer reviews, and adherence to Guidewire coding standards across Gosu, APD, and Integration Gateway.
- Collaborate with Scrum Masters and value stream leads to manage sprint delivery, resolve blockers, and maintain velocity.

AI & Automation Enablement
- Champion the adoption of Guidewire's GenAI-powered Developer Assistants (Gosu, Integrations, and Jutro) to accelerate development cycles by up to 60%.
- Leverage Guidewire Autopilot Workflow Service to design and automate complex insurance business processes end-to-end.
- Contribute to the programme's AI roadmap by evaluating and implementing Guidewire's Agentic Framework, Agent Studio, and GenAI Services for claims, underwriting, and policy workflows.
- Support the integration of Guidewire Claims Intel predictive scores and AI-assisted pricing insights within core workflows.

Integration & Platform
- Design and implement integrations via MuleSoft, Integration Gateway, and Guidewire Cloud APIs, ensuring real-time data access and system interoperability.
- Work with Datahub / Cloud Data Access (CDA) for reporting and analytics integration across the InsuranceSuite.
- Contribute to Advanced Product Designer (APD) adoption and InsuranceSuite product model modernisation.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders, presenting solutions and progress in a clear, business-aligned manner.
- Participate in client workshops, sprint reviews, and executive reporting sessions alongside the Head of Platform.
- Support onshore-offshore coordination, ensuring seamless knowledge transfer and delivery continuity between Sydney and the offshore team.

Mandatory Qualifications & Certifications
- Required:  Minimum Guidewire Associate Certification (ACE) in at least one InsuranceSuite product: PolicyCenter, BillingCenter.
- Required:  Demonstrated experience on at least one full-cycle Guidewire cloud implementation or migration project.
- Required:  Proficiency in Gosu scripting, PCF configuration, and data model extensions within Guidewire.

Technical Skills
- Hands-on experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) including release management, upgrade cycles (Palisades / Mammoth / Olos), and cloud deployment tooling.
- Working knowledge of Guidewire's AI tooling: Developer Assistant (Gosu / Integrations / Jutro), Autopilot Workflow Service, Guidewire Rules Service, and Guidewire Functions.
- Integration experience with REST APIs, MuleSoft, and Guidewire Integration Gateway or equivalent enterprise integration patterns.
- Familiarity with modern development practices including CI/CD, version control (Git), and automated testing frameworks within the Guidewire ecosystem.
- Exposure to Jutro Digital Platform and React-based front-end development for Guidewire digital experiences.
- Understanding of P&C insurance domain: policy lifecycle, claims handling, billing, and underwriting.

jobs.description:

Accenture is a leading global provider of a broad range of professional services in strategy and consulting, interactive marketing, information technology and business operations services, with digital capabilities in all of these areas. Are you a forward-thinking, analytical and tech-savvy professional eager to deepen your impact in consulting, strategy, and tech-driven business? Join our Strategy & Consulting team as a Senior Business Consultant and work on multinational transformation programs for clients across industries such as Telecommunications, EU Institutions, Financial Services, and Utilities. We work closely with our clients to support them in making data-driven decisions to move their business forward. Leveraging AI, cloud, automation, and other modern digital tools and systems, we develop and deliver leading transformations that combine business expertise with modern technologies.

jobs.description:

Through unmatched industry experience, leading technologies from our ecosystem partners and startups, and the largest delivery network in the world, we provide a powerful range of capabilities that can be tailored to our clients’ most complex business needs. In Accenture Technology, with over 100 innovation hubs deployed around the world, we help clients continuously innovate at speed and at scale so they can outpace their peers. You will bring innovation, intelligence and industry experience together with the newest technologies to help clients innovate at scale and transform their businesses.

We are seeking an experienced Senior ATOSS Consultant to join our team and lead complex implementations of ATOSS workforce management solutions. In this role, you will be part of end-to-end project delivery for enterprise clients, translating business requirements into robust, compliant, and efficient system configurations. You will play a key role in optimizing workforce processes - including time & attendance, demand-driven scheduling, personnel deployment, and employee self-services - to enhance productivity, compliance, and employee satisfaction.

What You’ll Do
- Lead and deliver end-to-end ATOSS Workforce Management implementations, from project kick-off through go-live and post-implementation support.

- Run requirement-gathering workshops with client stakeholders to analyze HR processes, workforce challenges, integrations, and compliance needs.

- Design ATOSS-based solutions, producing functional specifications, process blueprints, and best-practice recommendations aligned with client objectives.

- Configure and customize the ATOSS platform, including time models, shift planning rules, access rights, reporting, analytics, and system interfaces (e.g. payroll, ERP, SAP).

- Collaborate closely with project managers, client teams, and internal delivery teams to ensure timely delivery, risk mitigation, and high-quality outcomes.

- Act as a trusted advisor to clients, supporting decision-making and ensuring long-term solution adoption and value realization.

What You’ll Bring
- Hands-on experience with ATOSS Workforce Management software, with deep expertise in configuration and implementation.

- Proven experience delivering at least 3 full end-to-end ATOSS implementations, preferably in complex, multi-site and/or multi-country environments.

- Strong background in requirements gathering, business process analysis, and functional specification creation.

- Advanced expertise in ATOSS modules such as time management, workforce scheduling, demand forecasting, interfaces, and employee self-service.

- Solid understanding of HR processes, labor compliance, payroll integration, and workforce optimization concepts.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

Legal : Must own a valid work permit or EU/Schengen Space Nationality to legally work in Portugal.

What Will Set You Apart
- Hands-on implementation experience in the Netherlands (NL), including knowledge of Dutch labor laws, CAO structures, and compliance requirements.

- ATOSS certifications or formal training (e.g. ATOSS Academy).

- Experience with cloud-based deployments and modern workforce management features, including AI-driven capabilities.

- Integration experience with SAP, other ERP systems or payroll providers.

- Exposure to large-scale, international rollouts with multi-country compliance requirements.

- Additional European languages, especially Dutch.

Flexibility for occasionally travels for key project deliveries and client meetings.

jobs.description:

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) is the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000* people across 24 countries, ATCs will provide our clients seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions.

Stronger together!

For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges.

An experienced Epic Tapestry Certified - Utilization Management -   Consultant

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant IT Service Management (all genders)
jobs.description:
Du hast Lust, Digitalisierungsvorhaben und Cloud-Transformationen von weltweit führenden Unternehmen zu begleiten und mitzugestalten? Und du weißt die damit verbundenen Einblicke in die IT-Organisationen und Betriebsmodelle der Kunden ebenso zu schätzen wie die Möglichkeit, sie aktiv zu verändern und zu optimieren? Das ist genau dein Ding?

Dann lebe deine Leidenschaft in einer Position, in der du mit unseren Angeboten im Bereich Service Management Consulting unsere Kunden dabei unterstützt, deren IT Betriebsmodelle service- und kundenorientiert auszurichten, um die Skalierung des Geschäfts mit bestmöglicher Agilität vorantreiben zu können. Dabei gestaltest du nicht nur die Transformation klassischer ITSM-Organisationen, sondern unterstützt Unternehmen auch dabei, das Potenzial von Generative AI, Agentic AI und AIOps für ihre Service-Management-Prozesse und Operating Models zu erschließen.

Die Komplexität der „New Hybrid World“ mit traditionellen ITSM Ansätzen als auch agilen wie DevOps und SRE sowie AI-gestützten Services und Betriebsmodellen zu verstehen und optimal zu kombinieren ist nur ein Aspekt unserer vielseitigen Aufgaben als Berater:in – und das nicht nur in für Fragestellungen in der IT, sondern auch darüber hinaus. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden entwickeln wir zukunftsfähige Service-Organisationen, steigern Produktivität und Effizienz durch intelligente Automatisierung und schaffen die Grundlage für moderne, AI-unterstützte Betriebsmodelle.

Das erwartet dich
- An der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie berätst du unsere Kunden ganzheitlich zur Digitalisierung und Cloud-Transformation, analysierst ihre IT-Service-Management-Modelle, entwickelst fachliche und technische Konzepte und bist an der Planung und deren Umsetzung in agilen Teams beteiligt.

- Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Service-Management-Organisationen und identifizierst Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Generative AI, Agentic AI und AIOps, um Prozesse zu optimieren, die Servicequalität zu steigern und zukunftsfähige Betriebsmodelle zu etablieren.

- Auf Basis deiner Business Analyse (technische Assessments, Gap-Analysen, Reifegradbewertungen) berätst du Kunden strategisch und gestaltest ihre Target IT-Governance- und Operating-Modelle.

- Zur Steuerung des IT-Betriebs unserer Kunden etablierst du effiziente Service-Delivery-Modelle, die sowohl Legacy wie auch Cloud Services umfassen.

- In globalen digitalen Transformationsprojekten übernimmst du in allen Prozessphasen das Management und die Verantwortung unter Verwendung neuer Technologien und innovativer Methoden (Design Thinking, Safe, Scrum, SRE).

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – auch Quereinsteiger:innen mit ausgeprägter IT-Affinität sind willkommen

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und Einblicke ins Consulting-Umfeld, abhängig vom individuellen Einstiegslevel
→ Du bringst die Erfahrung und Souveränität mit, um Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu steuern und erfolgreich umzusetzen

- Interesse an aktuellen Technologien und Trends rund um Generative AI, Agentic AI und AIOps sowie deren Einsatz in IT-Service-Management-Organisationen

- Fundierte Methodenkenntnisse in einem oder mehreren Frameworks wie ITIL, Scrum, SAFe, Design Thinking, SRE oder DevOps

- Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Hyperscalern (z. B. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) sowie ITSM-Tools (z. B. ServiceNow)

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick, sicheres Expectation Management sowie Führungskompetenz

Deine Vorteile bei Accenture
Du als Mensch bist uns wichtig. Das wirst du täglich spüren und erleben. Denn unsere Arbeitswelt ist auf dich ausgerichtet und bietet dir die umfassenden Benefits eines großen, verantwortungsvollen Arbeitgebers. Dein zukünftiges Team schätzt vor allem

- Mentoring, umfassende Trainingsangebote, Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

- interessante und spannende Karriereoptionen sowie Einblick in moderne und innovative Cloud-Technologien und Service Management Lösungen

- unsere offene und agile Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert

- flexible Arbeits-/Urlaubszeitmodelle (Job-Konfigurator) und mobiles Arbeiten

- Parental Leave Programm und Betreuungsmöglichkeiten

Dein Kontakt
Du hast Fragen? Dann schick gerne eine E-Mail an deine Recruiterin anne.rauch@accenture.com  oder bewirb dich direkt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Pharma/MedTech Fulfillment & Global Trade Senior Consultant/Manager
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
We are Accenture's Supply Chain and Engineering reinvention partner for Life Sciences. We embed innovation, intelligence, and AI-native operations into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes products. We serve Life Sciences clients across the value chain to help bring lifesaving medicines and products to patients through harnessing the power of advanced technologies.

The Work:
Accenture is seeking a Senior Consultant or Manager to lead compliance-driven fulfillment transformation within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice for Life Sciences. We work with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and specialty distributor clients globally to navigate an era of unprecedented regulatory pressure and global trade volatility — combining deep domain expertise with AI-enabled technology to modernize how life sciences products move through the supply chain.  The role is responsible for delivering large-scale Life Sciences Fulfillment and Global Trade programs — spanning product traceability and distribution compliance, GDP-aligned operations, import/export management, and cold chain logistics — while building Accenture’s differentiated Fulfillment capability.

Key Responsibilities:
At a Senior Consultant / Manager level, key responsibilities could include:
- Lead delivery of product traceability and distribution compliance programs, helping clients design and implement the processes, governance, and technology architectures needed to meet evolving regulatory obligations across pharmaceutical and medical device supply chains.

- Drive AI-enabled fulfillment transformation — applying intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and advanced analytics across the full spectrum of fulfillment functions including order management, transportation, warehousing, global trade, and reverse logistics to help clients operate with greater speed, visibility, and efficiency.

- Design and implement cold chain distribution networks and temperature-controlled logistics strategies, including carrier qualification, deviation management, and continuous monitoring technology integration applicable to both pharma and medical device products.

- Lead import/export compliance workstreams across FDA, CBP, and cross-border documentation requirements — managing trade lane risk, tariff exposure, and regulatory alignment across APAC and LATAM corridors for both drug and device product categories.

- Lead client programs associated with warehouse management system transformation — overseeing design, implementation, and optimization across platforms including SAP EWM, Manhattan Active WMS, Blue Yonder, and others — with a focus on GxP-regulated life sciences distribution environments.

- Translate complex regulatory requirements — GDP, GxP quality system standards, and applicable distribution compliance frameworks — into technology and process architectures that are both compliant and operationally intelligent.

- Apply data and AI capabilities to supply chain visibility, traceability exception management, and global trade analytics — helping clients move from reactive compliance to proactive, insight-driven operations.

- Support sales origination and business development by building client relationships, contributing to proposals, and shaping go-to-market offerings across Life Sciences Fulfillment and Global Trade.

- Coach and develop junior team members, building practice capability and contributing reusable delivery assets.

Travel - candidates must be willing to travel up to 75% to client locations.

Here’s What You Need:
- Minimum 4 years of experience delivering fulfillment or supply chain transformation programs in pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader life sciences environments, ideally within consulting or professional services.
- Minimum of 4 years of experience leading product traceability and distribution compliance programs in life sciences — with working knowledge of GDP, GxP quality system requirements, and applicable regulatory distribution frameworks across pharma and/or medical device.
- Bachelor's degree

Key Skills:
- Familiarity with import/export compliance — FDA, CBP, cross-border documentation — and multi-corridor trade lane management for life sciences products.
- Cold chain logistics expertise including temperature-controlled warehousing design, carrier qualification, and deviation response for pharma and/or medical device products.
- Experience leading warehouse management system transformation programs in life sciences or regulated environments — across platforms such as SAP EWM, Manhattan Active WMS, Blue Yonder, or equivalent; deep platform expertise in one or more is strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients, lead workstreams independently, and deliver with excellence in fast-moving regulatory environments.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical compliance requirements into clear, executive-ready narratives.
- Familiarity with AI, automation, and digital capabilities as applied to life sciences distribution compliance and supply chain visibility — and genuine curiosity about their evolving application.

Bonus Points If You Have:
- Hybrid experience in both consulting and in-house pharmaceutical or medical device supply chain or 3PL operations.
- Exposure to agentic AI platforms applied to supply chain visibility or compliance monitoring.
- Experience with global trade volatility scenarios — tariff mitigation, reshoring strategy, or APAC/LATAM distribution network redesign across life sciences product categories.

Job Description
Entity : - Accenture Strategy & Consulting
Team : - Global Network – Data & AI
Practice : - Supply Chain & Operations
Title : - I&F Decision Sci Practitioner Senior Manager
Job location : - Bangalore or Gurgaon
Accenture Global Network - Data & AI Practice helps our clients reinvent and grow their business. Using a combination of expertise in industry, function, data science and technology, we lead transformation for our clients’ businesses. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytics capabilities to outperform their competition and improve customer loyalty.
As part of our Data & AI Practice, you will join a network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in the use of leading data science methods including Generative AI, ML, and Statistical tools, across 15 major industries. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed insights and scalable solutions to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Job Description
The ideal candidate for a Senior Manager in the Supply Chain team shall be,

jobs.description:
Ole oma itsesi,
Vaikuta tulevaisuuteen
Oletko valmis viemään osaamisesi uudelle tasolle?

Accenture Cybersecurity – meillä työpäivät eivät ole koskaan samanlaisia ja juuri siksi viihdymme täällä! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden rakentaa palkitseva ura kyberturvallisuusratkaisujen myynnin parissa ja kukoistaa rennon rohkeassa porukassa, lahjakkaiden ja menestystäsi tukevien kollegoiden kanssa. Tuemme yksilöllistä osaamistasi mukaansa tempaavalla työyhteisöllä, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä. Accenturella pääset työskentelemään asiakasprojekteissa maailman johtavissa organisaatioissa.

Haemme joukkoomme tieto-/kyberturvaratkaisujen myyjää

Etsimme kokenutta myynnin ammattilaista, jolla on kokemusta kyberturvallisuuspalveluiden ja -ratkaisujen myynnistä, mieluiten suurten yritysasiakkaiden kanssa. Olet mukavuusalueellasi niin luomassa uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia kuin johtaessasi monimutkaisia myyntihankkeita aina kaupan päättämiseen asti. Menestyt suuressa, kansainvälisessä organisaatiossa, jossa yhteistyö, suhteiden rakentaminen ja toteutuksen huippuosaaminen ovat menestyksen kannalta olennaisia.
Tarjoamme merkityksellisiä työtehtäviä, kilpailukykyisen palkan ja työsuhde-etuja. Etsimme henkilöitä, joilla on kaupallinen, teknologia-, IT- tai turvallisuustausta ja muuten soveltuvuutta rooliin sekä ymmärrystä kyberturvallisuuden monipuolisesta alasta.
Hae rohkeasti mukaan kasvavaan tiimiimme!

Mitä työnkuvaan kuuluu
- Tunnistat ja luot uusia myyntimahdollisuuksia Suomessa, kohdistuen suuriin strategisiin- ja prioriteettiasiakkaisiin.

- Rakennat ja ylläpidät vahvoja suhteita asiakkaiden johtaviin päättäjiin eri toimialoilta sekä Accenturen asiakkuustiimeihin.

- Johdat myyntitapahtumia koko niiden elinkaaren ajan, aina alkuvaiheen asiakaskohtaamisesta ja ratkaisujen muotoilusta sopimusneuvotteluihin ja kaupan päättämiseen.

- Jäsennät ja neuvottelet kaupallisia sopimuksia Accenturen viitekehysten, prosessien ja hallintomallien mukaisesti.

- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kyberturvallisuusasiantuntijoiden ja asiantuntijatiimien kanssa kehittäen ratkaisuja, jotka vastaavat asiakkaiden liiketoiminta- ja turvallisuustarpeisiin.

- Otat vastaan erilaisia rooleja myyntiprosessin aikana, mukaan lukien osallistumispäätösten arviointi, tarjousten laadinta, sopimusten muotoilu, ja sopimusneuvotteluiden vetäminen.

Toivomme että sinulla on…
- Vahvaa myyntikokemusta kyberturvallisuuspalveluiden, konsultoinnin tai teknologiaratkaisuiden parissa.

- Näyttöä strategisten yritysasiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien luomisesta.

- Laaja verkosto suomalaisilla markkinoilla – yritysasiakkaat, teknologiakumppanit ja muut keskeiset sidosryhmät.

- Kyky käydä luontevasti sekä teknisiä että strategisia keskusteluja asiakkaiden päättäjätason kanssa.

- Vahva kyberturvallisuusosaaminen sekä hyvä käsitys alan sääntelyvaatimuksista, standardeista ja Euroopan kehittyvästä tietoturvaympäristöstä.

- Erinomaiset viestintä-, neuvottelu- ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisen taidot.

- Joustavuus eri työskentelytilanteisiin – osaat toimia itsenäisesti ja tarvittaessa osana laajempaa myyntitiimiä.

- Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito ammatillisissa yhteyksissä.

Tarjoamme Sinulle
- Kattava koulutustarjonta (myynnillisistä koulutuksista kyberturvakoulutukseen)

- Joustavat työajat ja mahdollisuus etätyöskentelyyn

- Mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan rooliin kiinnostuksen ja osaamisprofiilin perusteella

- Jatkuvaa oppimista ja edistystä – perustaidoista toimialakohtaiseen sisältöön

- Oman uraohjaajan, jonka avulla pääset sparraamaan urakehitystäsi ja muovaamaan omaa urapolkuasi

- Mahtavat edut, kuten kattava työterveyshuolto

- Aktiivista tukea hyvinvointiin ja jaksamiseen. Olemme saaneet "Great Place to Work" tunnustuksen

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille cv:si ja hakemuksesi 15.10.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuajan aikana.
Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää roolista tai rekrytointiprosessista, ole hyvä ja ota yhteyttä karl.kego@accenture.com
Tutustu Accentureen ja lue lisää meistä https://www.accenture.com/fi-en/about/company-index
Seuraa myös toimintaamme Facebookissa , Instagramissa ja LinkedInissä .

Me Accenturella uskomme, että erilaiset ihmiset saavat yhdessä aikaan suurempia asioita kuin keskenään samanlaiset ihmiset, ja sen vuoksi haluamme sinut sellaisena kuin olet – riippumatta sukupuolestasi, etnisestä alkuperästäsi, kulttuuristasi, kansallisuudestasi, uskonnostasi ja uskomuksistasi, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisestasi ja sukupuoli-identiteetistäsi. Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. What would you do? • This position is responsible for performing a wide range of duties associated with the sales and use tax (SUT) compliance function. The primary duty of this role is to ensure that client sales and use tax returns are filed and paid in an accurate and timely manner and that client satisfaction is high.

• Determine appropriate resourcing of staff in order to achieve goals and objectives.
• Define annual Key Performance Indicators aligned with corporate goals.
• Manage and mentor employees on performance gaps, career development opportunities, and strategies.

• Specific knowledge of multi-state tax preparation software and preparation of monthly SUT returns.
• Understand various business entities (i.e. retail, software, manufacturing, leasing, etc.) and the related SUT compliance details involved.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Must be detailed oriented, a team player, and have strong organizational skills.
What are we looking for? • Bachelor degree in accounting or similar field or equivalent experience required.
• Seven (7) plus years of experience in a Sales and Use Tax returns role required with three (3) plus years of leadership experience
• Public accounting or big four experience preferred.
• Or equivalent combination of education and or experience
Roles and Responsibilities: • Manage, coach, develop, train and mentor tax returns processing staff to achieve personal and business goals.
• Overall ownership of the returns process.
• Continuous identification of returns process and system improvements (that support the compliance process).
• Implement and manage process and system changes.
• Work with product management, treasury and development staff to improve and prioritize manual and automated processes.
• Identify and help to solve system issues.
• Ensure SOC II controls related to the compliance process are continuously updated and followed.
• Manage the client onboarding process ensuring customers are onboarded on time.
• Act as an escalation point for internal and external customers.
• Ensure clients tax returns and tax data are reviewed for accuracy, investigate questionable data and lead and take corrective actions.
• Ensure that clients tax mail (forms, notices, and bulletins) is reviewed and addressed.
• Ensure response to, resolution, and tracking notices from taxing jurisdictions in a timely manner through written and verbal communication with state and local tax representatives.
• Ensure complete notice documentation is on the client portal to ensure transparency.
• Document unusual out-of-scope issues both internally and externally.
• Ensure continuing development and documentation of internal processes and procedures.
• Must be available for overtime, as the nature of this service typically requires overtime between the 9th and the 17th of each month.
• Exercise professional judgment to resolve issues.
• Work with Customer Support and Implementation leadership to resolve customer issues.
• Fulfill speaking engagements on topics of importance to Client Inc.
• Occasional travel may be required.
• Participate in other projects or duties.

Any Graduation

jobs.title: AWS Edge Mid-Market Portfolio Sales Leader
jobs.location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior, market-facing sales leader to build and lead a high-performing, quota-carrying hunting sales team for a newly formed Accenture Edge for AWS business unit focused on creating net-new business with mid-market companies up to $3B in annual revenue. This leader will be responsible for building the sales motion from the ground up, setting and managing aggressive sales quotas, generating new-logo revenue, accelerating AWS-led transformation opportunities, and making Accenture Edge the preferred channel for mid-market customers that need enterprise-grade AWS innovation delivered with speed, transparency, predictable economics, and measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep credibility in the AWS ecosystem, including established relationships with AWS sellers, partner sales managers, sales leaders, solution architects, marketplace teams, and field leadership. They will be equally comfortable engaging C-suite customers, shaping AWS co-sell and ACE motions, building demand-generation channels, coaching dedicated Accenture Edge sellers, and converting productized AWS offerings into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead a newly formed growth business: Define and execute the hunting strategy for a new Accenture Edge for AWS business unit, with clear focus on net-new logo acquisition, first-time customer wins, market creation, and repeatable revenue growth among mid-market companies up to $3B in annual revenue.

- Build and manage a high-performing quota-carrying hunting team: Recruit, develop, coach, and lead dedicated Accenture Edge sellers who are energized by creating new demand, opening new accounts, building pipeline from whitespace, converting first-time buyers into long-term customers, and consistently meeting or exceeding individual sales quotas.

- Drive AWS co-sell and ACE discipline: Build strong working relationships with AWS account teams, partner sales managers, sales leaders, solution architects, marketplace stakeholders, and ACE operations teams to identify, register, fund, shape, and close joint opportunities.

- Activate productized AWS offerings: Lead sales motions around Accenture Edge for AWS offerings such as cloud migration and modernization, VMware migration, secure cloud foundation, AWS managed services, cloud optimization and FinOps, data and AI modernization, Amazon Connect, and responsible AI services.

- Develop close customer relationships: Establish trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, business leaders, technology leaders, and buying committees at mid-market companies up to $3B in annual revenue to position Accenture Edge as a simpler, faster, right-sized partner for AWS transformation.

- Create and manage pipeline: Own pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, opportunity progression, and sales cadence across marketing-generated, AWS-referred, seller-originated, and internal whitespace opportunities.

- Scale demand generation and lead conversion: Partner with marketing, AWS, and internal teams to convert campaigns, Storefront interest, marketplace opportunities, partner referrals, and targeted account lists into qualified pursuits.

- Strengthen Edge operating model interlocks: Work across Accenture Edge, AABG, Navisite, NeuraFlash, delivery, solutioning, client success, and market teams to ensure clear ownership from lead origination through solutioning, contracting, delivery, and expansion.

- Lead executive-level pursuits: Personally sponsor strategic deals, orchestrate pursuit teams, lead commercial conversations, and support complex negotiations through closure.

- Measure and improve quota performance: Establish pipeline reviews, AWS inspection rhythm, win/loss analysis, account planning, seller productivity metrics, quota attainment reviews, and QBR cadence to create accountability and continuous improvement.

Success Measures
- Achievement of annual sales quota, bookings, revenue, margin, and pipeline targets for Accenture Edge for AWS with mid-market companies up to $3B in annual revenue.

jobs.title: Sales Manager - Client Groups (CMT)
jobs.description:
As a Sales Manager (Enterprise Deal Lead), you will win and close complex, high-value consulting and technology services deals—typically $10M+—from first qualification through contract signature. You will lead the full pursuit, define how we will win, run the commercial and contractual negotiations, and mobilize the right internal experts to build a compelling, deliverable solution that creates measurable outcomes for the client and profitable growth for Accenture.

Who we are
Accenture’s CMT Client Group combines deep industry expertise with world‑class technology capabilities to help clients transform at speed and scale. You will work with multidisciplinary teams that bring together cloud, data, AI, managed services, security, digital engineering and strategic consulting.
Backed by Accenture’s global delivery network and innovation ecosystem, you will shape deals that unlock growth and deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Leadership & Closing
- Own large deal pursuits end-to-end (often multi-service, multi-country, and involving multiple decision-makers), typically >$10M.

- Act as the overall deal lead for your opportunities, or lead a major workstream within a larger pursuit.

- Drive disciplined execution across the sales cycle: qualify → shape solution → build proposal → negotiate → close.

Strategy, Value Proposition & Differentiation
- Define and run the win strategy (why the client chooses us), competitive strategy (how we beat alternatives), and close plan (how we get to signature).

- Build an outcome-based business case and value proposition (e.g., cost reduction, faster time-to-market, risk reduction, customer experience improvement).

- Translate client challenges into a clear solution approach by leveraging Accenture capabilities, reusable assets, and proven delivery methods (no prior Accenture knowledge required—this means “use what we have and what works to solve the problem”).

Client Relationship Development
- Build and expand senior client relationships that enable access, influence, and decision clarity.

- Navigate complex buying groups (IT, business, procurement, finance, legal, risk) and influence decision-makers through structured messaging and trust.

Pursuit Orchestration & Stakeholder Alignment
- Lead a cross-functional pursuit team (solution experts, delivery leaders, finance, legal, contracting, industry specialists).

- Create and maintain a stakeholder map and influence plan to anticipate objections and unblock decisions.

- Quickly resolve issues across scope, pricing, solution feasibility, risk, timeline, and governance—with the client and internally.

Contracting, Risk & Approvals
- Lead or support development of key sales documents, including proposal, pricing/commercial model, and Statement of Work (SoW) (what we will deliver, by when, and under what assumptions).

- Drive alignment on contract terms and conditions (e.g., liabilities, service levels, change control, acceptance criteria) in collaboration with legal and risk teams.

- Ensure the deal follows internal review and approval steps before signature.

Qualifications
- A Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
- Several years of experience in sales, business development or large‑deal pursuit roles, ideally in the Communications, Media & High-Tech sector or within complex B2B environments.
- Proven track record in closing high‑value deals involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience working in international or matrixed environments is an advantage.
- Strong commercial acumen and ability to structure complex deals.
- Experience with value articulation, business cases and competitive differentiation.
- Excellent communication, negotiation and storytelling capabilities.
- Ability to coordinate cross‑functional teams under tight timelines.
- Strong problem‑solving, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to influence senior decision-makers and build trust.
- Disciplined pursuit management and ability to drive momentum.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort in ambiguity and fast‑paced environments.
- Team leadership and the ability to motivate diverse specialists toward a shared win strategy.
- English with fluency in either French or Dutch required.

Bonus Points
- Experience with CMT industry clients (telecom, media, high-tech).
- Understanding of technology-led transformations (cloud, data, AI, modern engineering).

This senior leadership role has expanded accountability for strategic partner acquisition, advanced consultative sales execution, and pipeline health, in addition to people leadership and operational excellence.

This role partners closely with senior client stakeholders and internal leadership to influence go-to-market strategy, drive revenue growth, and scale best in class sales practices across markets.

- Own end-to-end business results for one or more sales segments (Inside Sales,

- SMB Account Management, PM), ensuring revenue, KPI, and SLA targets are

- consistently exceeded.

- Set strategic direction for sales execution, translating business goals into operating plans, performance frameworks, and execution playbooks.

- Lead, coach, and develop sales teams and front‑line leaders, building a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline.

- Drive advanced sales capability across teams, including prospecting rigor, discovery excellence, consultative selling, objection handling, and deal progression.

You drive executive-level conversations focused on business transformation, AI adoption, data modernization, customer engagement, and industry reinvention while positioning the combined value of Microsoft and Accenture.

- Agentic AI and Enterprise AI Transformation using Copilot and Github Copilot

- Data-to-AI modernization leveraging Microsoft Fabric modern data architectures.

- Cybersecurity transformation using Microsoft Security Operations and cyber resilience solutions.

- Industry-specific AI and digital transformation solutions across Travel, Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Communications, Media, and Technology.

- Develop and execute joint Accenture-Microsoft growth strategies and co-sell motions for assigned accounts/clients.

- Build executive relationships with Microsoft Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineers, Industry Leaders, and Account Teams.

- Originate opportunities involving Microsoft Technologies.

- Work closely with Accenture and Avanade Microsoft leadership team to drive pipeline growth.

- Lead executive workshops, innovation sessions, and value realization discussions.

- Develop business cases and ROI narratives that align technology investments to measurable business outcomes.

- Influence Microsoft leadership to position Accenture as the preferred transformation partner.

- Create differentiated industry solutions, thought leadership, and joint offerings aligned to Microsoft priorities.
