jobs.description:
As the Ecosystem Business Development Director (all genders), you are a growth focused professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.

You have an understanding of business development phases of a sales cycle, including account development, opportunity identification, relationship development, and qualification by applying strategic sales processes .

You have a specialization in the Ecosystem Partners technologies and offerings. You develop strategic relationships with the Ecosystem Partner to keep abreast of all the latest developments in their offerings.

Your focus is on origination of opportunities with the said Ecosystem Partner using your sales expertise and specialized knowledge.

You will drive origination and lead with the value of the Ecosystem Partner + Accenture for our clients.

You develop primary relationships with key Accenture and your Ecosystem Partner account personnel, most significantly client account leads, to identify and qualify opportunities to solve client pain points and growth objectives utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest Ecosystem Partners technologies and accelerators. Additionally, you will support the account personnel in building relationships with key buyers through bringing business and technical expertise to business development conversations and qualify and progress originated deals.

You are integrated as one Accenture with the Accenture Commercial leaders to ensure the best of One Accenture is brought to our clients and ensure that the Partner Offerings you are specialized in are socialized with the leaders in your Market as well as surrounded with the winning team and win strategy.

Your focus on the Ecosystem partnership is a key objective and ensuring that the relationship is nurtured and a culture of trust is established, to ensure successful deal flow, client satisfaction and trusted partnerships. To win deals our partners and customers (internal and external) must love us.

The work:
• Prospects new opportunities proactively through client account leads and direct client contact

• Drive a partner-aligned co-sell motion, including go to market development, alignment & customer targeting, joint opportunity origination & qualification and regional communications, awareness & enablement

• Create awareness of the Ecosystem Partners incumbency, joint solutions offerings, and capabilities with all relevant Accenture and Ecosystem Partner stakeholders

• Engage in holistic partner planning including overall strategy, go to market development and alignment, financial success, tailored campaigns and joint client engagements

• Identify complex technology business problems / opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs and Accenture + Ecosystem Partner solutions that drive in year ROI and have an in quarter revenue opportunity

• Create differentiated opportunities based on Ecosystem Partner offerings and joint go-to-market

• Develop thought leadership to raise awareness of joint value proposition. Enable the Ecosystem Partner and Accenture teams on our unique joint value proposition, communicate investment levers and manage partner investments

• Interact with senior management levels at clients, within Accenture and the Ecosystem Partner to develop, align and execute pursuit strategies, develop client contact plans and relationship maps, and apply industry-leading transformation and operations strategies and practices

Here's what you need
• Relevant degree in Economics, IT, Industrial Engineering or vocational training

• Minimum of around 8 years of Business Development expertise in the professional services space

• Channel and Ecosystem partner management experience and ways of working

• Fluent German and English language skills

• Client facing experience and willingness to travel within Germany

Bonus points if you have
• Previous experience in conceptualizing, planning, and implementing transformation programmes

• Experience working within G2000 customers

• Experience with C Level client relationship building and relationship management

• Ability to discuss latest technology hot topics on the fly with VP clients and working level technical resources

• Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision making abilities

• Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility and character

You and Accenture

In this role, you’ll be part of the Global Accenture Sales Group. We leverage the full spectrum of digital technologies to simplify our clients’ everyday operations and lead their businesses into the future.

jobs.title: Ecosystem Business Development Director ( Sailpoint-Security)
jobs.description:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud, data, AI, and security. Across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, and Accenture Song, we partner with the world’s leading technology providers to help healthcare organizations reinvent how care is delivered, experienced, and operated.

The Work:
As the Ecosystem Business Development Director, you are a growth focused professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.
You have an understanding of business development phases of a sales cycle, including account development, opportunity identification, relationship development, and qualification by applying strategic sales processes.  You have a specialization in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and your Ecosystem Partner's technologies and offerings, specifically SailPoint's Identity Security Cloud, IGA, and PAM solutions. You develop strategic relationships with the Ecosystem Partner to keep abreast of all the latest developments in their offerings.  Your focus is on origination of opportunities with the said Ecosystem Partner using your sales expertise and specialized knowledge in identity governance, access certifications, and zero trust frameworks.  You will drive origination and lead with the value of the Ecosystem Partner + Accenture for our clients, articulating the business value of identity security as a board-level risk and compliance priority.  You develop primary relationships with key Accenture and your Ecosystem Partner account personnel, most significantly client account leads (Accenture CALs), to identify and qualify opportunities to solve client pain points and growth objectives utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest Ecosystem Partner technologies and accelerators. Additionally, you will support the account personnel in building relationships with key buyers including CISOs, CIOs, and IAM program owners through bringing business and technical expertise to business development conversations and qualify and progress originated deals.

You are integrated as one Accenture with the Accenture Commercial leaders to ensure the best of One Accenture is brought to our clients and ensure that the Partner Offerings you are specialized in are socialized with the leaders in your Market as well as surrounded with the winning team and win strategy.  Your focus on Ecosystem partnership is a key objective and ensuring that the relationship is nurtured and a culture of trust is established, to ensure successful deal flow, client satisfaction and trusted partnerships. To win deals our partners and customers (internal and external) must love us.

Key Responsibilities:
- Prospects new opportunities proactively through client account leads and direct client contact
- Drive a partner-aligned co-sell motion, including go to market development, alignment & customer targeting, joint opportunity origination & qualification and regional communications, awareness & enablement
- Create awareness of the Ecosystem Partner's incumbency, joint solutions offerings, and capabilities with all relevant Accenture and Ecosystem Partner stakeholders, with particular focus on IAM modernization, IGA transformation, and identity-led zero trust programs
- Engage in holistic partner planning including overall strategy, go to market development and alignment, financial success, tailored campaigns and joint client engagements
- Influence partner leaders to position Accenture as partner of choice
- Participate in partner business planning and product briefings
- Identify complex technology business problems/opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs and Accenture + Ecosystem Partner solutions that drive in year ROI and have an in-quarter revenue opportunity, including regulatory compliance drivers (SOX, HIPAA, NIS2) that create urgency around identity security investments
- Create differentiated opportunities based on Ecosystem Partner offerings and joint go-to-market
- Shape partner specific joint sales and solution assets needed to run a successful campaign
- Develop thought leadership to raise awareness of joint value proposition. Enable the Ecosystem Partner and Accenture teams on our unique joint value proposition, communicate investment levers and manage partner investments
- Interact with senior management levels at clients, within Accenture and the Ecosystem Partner to develop, align and execute pursuit strategies, develop client contact plans and relationship maps, and apply industry-leading transformation and operations strategies and practices
- Orchestrate joint origination sessions with the Ecosystem Partner and Accenture teams. Host or participate in key industry events in conjunction with the Ecosystem Partner
- Client facing and able to travel Monday-Thursday (as required)

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelors or College Diploma in related field.
- Minimum of 8 years of Business Development in the professional services space
- Minimum of 10 years' Successful Sales Pursuit Management experience
- Channel and Ecosystem partner management experience and ways of working
- Demonstrated experience selling or originating IAM, IGA, or identity security solutions in a complex enterprise environment
- Familiarity with the SailPoint product portfolio including Identity Security Cloud, IdentityNow, and File Access Manager
- Understanding of core IAM concepts including access certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access management (PAM), and identity lifecycle management
- Experience with C-Level client relationship building
- Proven ability to operate within a team-oriented environment
- Demonstrated commitment, teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting
- High energy level, focus and ability to work well in demanding client environments
- Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills
- Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision-making abilities
- Previous experience in conceptualizing, planning, and implementing identity governance transformation programs

Preferred Qualifications:
- SailPoint partner or sales certifications

jobs.title: Oracle Ecosystem Business Development Senior Manager
jobs.description:
As the Oracle Market Activation Director, you are responsible for driving internal pipeline growth across Accenture’s Oracle practice by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities within Accenture’s Market Units and Industry groups. You serve as the internal sales engine for the Oracle practice — surfacing demand, building awareness, and connecting the right opportunities to Sales Capture Leads for pursuit and close.

You are a trusted advisor to Accenture Market Unit and Industry leadership, acting as the primary point of engagement for Oracle-related opportunities. You bring deep expertise in Oracle processes, procurement transformation, and the leading platforms and solutions that underpin modern Oracle programs.

You drive internal conversations focused on Oracle opportunity qualification, pipeline development, and practice positioning — ensuring the Oracle practice is recognized as the premier capability for procurement and supply chain transformation across Accenture’s client portfolio.
Strategic Focus Areas
- Procurement and supply chain transformation leveraging leading Oracle platforms

- Intelligent procurement using AI, analytics, and automation to drive spend visibility and supplier intelligence.

- Industry-specific Oracle solutions across Resources, Health and Products sectors.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and qualify Oracle opportunities within assigned Accenture Market Units and Industries, developing a robust internal pipeline.

- Build strong working relationships with Accenture Market Unit leads, Industry account teams, and client group leads to surface procurement transformation opportunities.

- Qualify opportunities against Oracle practice fit criteria and pass qualified leads to the appropriate Sales Capture Lead for pursuit and close.

- Collaborate closely with Oracle practice leadership and Sales Capture Leads to ensure smooth opportunity handoffs and alignment on pursuit strategy.

- Conduct internal activation sessions, lunch-and-learns, and deal qualification workshops to raise Oracle awareness across Accenture’s go-to-market teams.

- Develop opportunity briefs and preliminary business cases to support early-stage qualification and internal stakeholder alignment.

- Serve as the Oracle practice ambassador internally, ensuring Market Unit and Industry teams understand the practice’s capabilities, differentiators, and recent wins.

- Maintain a current view of Oracle market trends, competitor activity, and Accenture win themes to support effective internal positioning.

- Track and report on pipeline activity, opportunity status, and activation outcomes to Oracle practice leadership on a regular cadence.

Travel is required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on internal meeting requirements and practice events.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum 6 years of experience in business development, internal sales, pre-sales, or consulting within a professional services or technology environment.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in Source-to-Pay, procurement, or supply chain transformation.
- Minimum 3 years' experience working within or alongside large, matrixed organizations to identify and qualify opportunities.
- Minimum 3 years' experience of S2P processes, platforms, and transformation levers across direct and indirect spend.
- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and translate business conversations into qualified pipeline, preferably $15M or more
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Zip, Basware, Medius or similar.
- Experience supporting or participating in complex, multi-stakeholder pursuit processes within a professional services firm.
- Experience working in or with Accenture Market Units, Industry groups, or account teams.
- Strong communication, storytelling, and internal influencing skills.
- Ability to navigate Accenture’s internal go-to-market structure and engage Market Unit Leads, Industry Leads, CALs in qualifying conversations.

Impulsar el desarrollo y fidelización del canal inmobiliario asociado a FAI, posicionando a Repsol como partner energético de referencia mediante propuestas de valor Multienergía adaptadas al sector Real Estate.

Funciones
- Diseñar y desplegar campañas Multienergía dirigidas a empleados y clientes de inmobiliarias asociadas a FAI.
- Captar y desarrollar nuevas promotoras inmobiliarias, adaptando la propuesta de valor a las distintas fases del ciclo inmobiliario.
- Gestionar y fidelizar la red de asociados y colaboradores FAI Premium.
- Gestionar consultas, incidencias y necesidades de agencias y colaboradores.
- Analizar y segmentar clientes para identificar oportunidades y adaptar la propuesta de valor.
- Gestionar canales y servicios preferenciales para asociados y colaboradores.
- Desarrollar estrategias de captación, fidelización y expansión en el mercado inmobiliario residencial.
- Elaborar la newsletter quincenal para asociados Real Estate y desarrollar acciones de comunicación.
- Identificar nuevas oportunidades de valor añadido para clientes, incluyendo soluciones de eficiencia energética y CAEs.

Requisitos
- Experiencia en desarrollo de negocio, gestión de clientes, partnerships o canales comerciales.
- Valorable experiencia en el sector inmobiliario, energético o servicios B2B.
- Capacidad para gestionar y desarrollar redes de colaboradores y partners.
- Experiencia en análisis de clientes, segmentación y detección de oportunidades.
- Habilidades de comunicación, negociación y gestión de relaciones.
- Perfil autónomo, organizado y orientado a resultados.
- Capacidad para coordinar diferentes iniciativas y stakeholders.
- Valorable conocimiento de soluciones energéticas, eficiencia energética y/o movilidad eléctrica.

jobs.title: Ecosystem Business Development Director (all genders) - IBM
jobs.description:
As the Ecosystem Business Development Director (all genders), you are a growth focused professional who has successfully created positive impact through year-on-year business expansion.

You have an understanding of business development phases of a sales cycle, including account development, opportunity identification, relationship development, and qualification by applying strategic sales processes .

You have a specialization in the Ecosystem Partners technologies and offerings. You develop strategic relationships with the Ecosystem Partner to keep abreast of all the latest developments in their offerings.

Your focus is on origination of opportunities with the said Ecosystem Partner using your sales expertise and specialized knowledge.

You will drive origination and lead with the value of the Ecosystem Partner + Accenture for our clients.

You develop primary relationships with key Accenture and your Ecosystem Partner account personnel, most significantly client account leads, to identify and qualify opportunities to solve client pain points and growth objectives utilizing a differentiated roadmap and framework leveraging the latest Ecosystem Partners technologies and accelerators. Additionally, you will support the account personnel in building relationships with key buyers through bringing business and technical expertise to business development conversations and qualify and progress originated deals.

You are integrated as one Accenture with the Accenture Commercial leaders to ensure the best of One Accenture is brought to our clients and ensure that the Partner Offerings you are specialized in are socialized with the leaders in your Market as well as surrounded with the winning team and win strategy.

Your focus on the Ecosystem partnership is a key objective and ensuring that the relationship is nurtured and a culture of trust is established, to ensure successful deal flow, client satisfaction and trusted partnerships. To win deals our partners and customers (internal and external) must love us.

The work:
• Prospects new opportunities proactively through client account leads and direct client contact

• Drive a partner-aligned co-sell motion, including go to market development, alignment & customer targeting, joint opportunity origination & qualification and regional communications, awareness & enablement

• Create awareness of the Ecosystem Partners incumbency, joint solutions offerings, and capabilities with all relevant Accenture and Ecosystem Partner stakeholders

• Engage in holistic partner planning including overall strategy, go to market development and alignment, financial success, tailored campaigns and joint client engagements

• Identify complex technology business problems / opportunities requiring in-depth knowledge of client buyer needs and Accenture + Ecosystem Partner solutions that drive in year ROI and have an in quarter revenue opportunity

• Create differentiated opportunities based on Ecosystem Partner offerings and joint go-to-market

• Develop thought leadership to raise awareness of joint value proposition. Enable the Ecosystem Partner and Accenture teams on our unique joint value proposition, communicate investment levers and manage partner investments

• Interact with senior management levels at clients, within Accenture and the Ecosystem Partner to develop, align and execute pursuit strategies, develop client contact plans and relationship maps, and apply industry-leading transformation and operations strategies and practices

Here's what you need
• Relevant degree in Economics, IT, Industrial Engineering or vocational training

• Minimum of around 8 years of Business Development expertise in the professional services space

• Channel and Ecosystem partner management experience and ways of working

• Fluent German and English language skills

• Client facing experience and willingness to travel within Germany

Bonus points if you have
• Previous experience in conceptualizing, planning, and implementing transformation programmes

• Experience working within G2000 customers

• Experience with C Level client relationship building and relationship management

• Ability to discuss latest technology hot topics on the fly with VP clients and working level technical resources

• Strong leadership, problem solving, and decision making abilities

• Unquestionable professional integrity, credibility and character

You and Accenture

In this role, you’ll be part of the Global Accenture Sales Group. We leverage the full spectrum of digital technologies to simplify our clients’ everyday operations and lead their businesses into the future.

The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU Make the Difference

Your skills, personality, and ambitions make you unique. And when diverse talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something extraordinary happens: ideas that truly make an impact. That’s why Accenture champions diversity and individual freedom. Create a work environment where you thrive—with tasks you care about, a workload that suits you, and a working style aligned with your goals. How you network, learn, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We’re here to help you shape it the way you envision.

Still have questions? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team by email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com or by phone at 00800 45045045.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Source to Pay Ecosystem Business Development Senior Manager
jobs.description:
As the S2P Market Activation Director, you are responsible for driving internal pipeline growth across Accenture’s Source-to-Pay (S2P) practice by identifying, qualifying, and advancing opportunities within Accenture’s Market Units and Industry groups. You serve as the internal sales engine for the S2P practice — surfacing demand, building awareness, and connecting the right opportunities to Sales Capture Leads for pursuit and close.

You are a trusted advisor to Accenture Market Unit and Industry leadership, acting as the primary point of engagement for S2P-related opportunities. You bring deep expertise in Source-to-Pay processes, procurement transformation, and the leading platforms and solutions that underpin modern S2P programs.

You drive internal conversations focused on S2P opportunity qualification, pipeline development, and practice positioning — ensuring the S2P practice is recognized as the premier capability for procurement and supply chain transformation across Accenture’s client portfolio.

Strategic Focus Areas
- Procurement and supply chain transformation leveraging leading S2P platforms

- Intelligent procurement using AI, analytics, and automation to drive spend visibility and supplier intelligence.

- Industry-specific S2P solutions across Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Consumer Goods, Industrial, and Public Service sectors.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and qualify S2P opportunities within assigned Accenture Market Units and Industries, developing a robust internal pipeline.

- Build strong working relationships with Accenture Market Unit leads, Industry account teams, and client group leads to surface procurement transformation opportunities.

- Qualify opportunities against S2P practice fit criteria and pass qualified leads to the appropriate Sales Capture Lead for pursuit and close.

- Collaborate closely with S2P practice leadership and Sales Capture Leads to ensure smooth opportunity handoffs and alignment on pursuit strategy.

- Conduct internal activation sessions, lunch-and-learns, and deal qualification workshops to raise S2P awareness across Accenture’s go-to-market teams.

- Develop opportunity briefs and preliminary business cases to support early-stage qualification and internal stakeholder alignment.

- Serve as the S2P practice ambassador internally, ensuring Market Unit and Industry teams understand the practice’s capabilities, differentiators, and recent wins.

- Maintain a current view of S2P market trends, competitor activity, and Accenture win themes to support effective internal positioning.

- Track and report on pipeline activity, opportunity status, and activation outcomes to S2P practice leadership on a regular cadence.

Travel is required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on internal meeting requirements and practice events.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum 6 years of experience in business development, internal sales, pre-sales, or consulting within a professional services or technology environment.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in Source-to-Pay, procurement, or supply chain transformation.
- Experience working within or alongside large, matrixed organizations to identify and qualify opportunities.
- Strong understanding of S2P processes, platforms, and transformation levers across direct and indirect spend.
- Proven ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and translate business conversations into qualified pipeline of $15M+
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with leading S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Zip, Basware, Medius or similar.
- Experience supporting or participating in complex, multi-stakeholder pursuit processes within a professional services firm.
- Experience working in or with Accenture Market Units, Industry groups, or account teams.
- Strong communication, storytelling, and internal influencing skills.
- Ability to navigate Accenture’s internal go-to-market structure and engage Market Unit Leads, Industry Leads, CALs in qualifying conversations.

This senior leadership role has expanded accountability for strategic partner acquisition, advanced consultative sales execution, and pipeline health, in addition to people leadership and operational excellence. The Senior Sales Manager is responsible for ensuring teams consistently execute high-quality prospecting, discovery, and closing motions while delivering measurable advertiser outcomes. This role partners closely with senior client stakeholders and internal leadership to influence go-to-market strategy, drive revenue growth, and scale best in class sales practices across markets.

● Proven success leading high performing sales, account management, or strategic partner teams in fast paced, metrics driven environments.

● Language Requirement - English proficiency at B2/B1 level
● Experience in advertising sales, digital marketing, ad tech, SaaS, or media agency environments.
● Familiarity with digital media buying, advertising KPIs, and advertiser/agency ecosystems.
● Experience leading multi-team or multi-segmented sales organizations.
● Proficiency with analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau) to surface revenue risks and opportunities.
● Strong organizational and prioritization skills in complex, fast-moving environments.
● Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain senior sales talent.

jobs.title: Security Sales Manager - Secteur Public et Santé F/H
jobs.description:
Imaginez, transformez et impactez le monde   positivement : venez vivre au cœur du changement en tant que membre actif et spécialisé dans les problématiques de sécurité de l’information.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Commercial pour intégrer nos équipes Cyber pour contribuer activement aux différentes activités en cours et participer au développement de nos capacités de l’ensemble de nos lignes de services.

Vos responsabilités seront multiples , et décrites ci-dessous :

Votre rôle est à la croisée de chemins entre la vente complexe, la compréhension de nos institutions et l’expertise du domaine de la Cyber. Vos missions seront les suivantes :
1.    Développer le business cyber sur un portefeuille de comptes du Secteur Public :
•    Porter la responsabilité du chiffre (pipeline, bookings, revenus) sur un ou plusieurs comptes stratégiques
•    Co-définir et exécuter le plan de compte Cyber avec le Client Account Lead et le Security Account Lead (priorités, portefeuille d’offres, calendrier d’actions)
•    Piloter le pipe dans le CRM : qualification, priorisation, prévisions fiables (forecast), hygiène des opportunités et rigueur de conversion par étape
•    Orchestrer les forces internes (conseil, delivery, ingénierie, alliances, juridique, finance, marketing) pour adresser les besoins clients et maximiser l’attach/cross-sell
•    Développer et entretenir sur le long terme des relations C-level (CISO, CIO, COO, CFO) et influenceurs clés (Risk, Compliance, Achats)
2.    Conduire les cycles de vente complexes (origination → closing) et comprendre les spécificités du secteur public :
•  Réponses aux appels d’offres des Marchés Publics :
- Veille et analyse, évaluation de la pertinence d’y répondre en qualifiant les opportunités (valeur, différenciation, sponsors, concurrence, critères de décision)

- Pilotage de la réponse : accompagner les équipes opérationnelles sur le la construction de l’offre commerciale : cadrage du besoin, solutioning, staffing, estimation des charges, calendrier et gouvernance de réponse

- Elaborer la proposition de valeur, modéliser le business case, structurer le contrat (forfait, régie, managed services/ARR), sécuriser la marge

- Conduire la soutenance : narratif exécutif, démonstrations, POC, références, ROI et plan de réduction des risques

•    Maitriser les cycles de vente long et gérer des cycles de décisions dans la durée : conditions commerciales, SLA, pénalités, MSA, conformité réglementaire (DORA, NIS2, RGPD)
•    Connaissance des normes et maitrise des notions et organismes clés : ANSSI, SecNumCloud, etc
•    Relations institutionnelles : entretenir des liens avec les organismes régulateurs et les centrales d’achat (UGAP par exemple)

En tant que commercial cyber pour le secteur public, vous utiliserez votre expertise sectorielle pour conseiller les clients dans l’élaboration, la mise en œuvre et la gestion de solution de cyber sécurité. Vous intègrerez une équipe dynamique, polyvalente, ambitieuse et en pleine croissance, et participerez à la vente de projets de transformation et d’innovation.

- Formation commerciale ou ingénieur Bac+5 ;

- Expérience démontrée dans la création et la gestion de partenariats stratégiques avec des entreprises technologiques de premier plan ;

- Culture de cyber sécurité démontrée et compréhension de l'écosystème Cyber, des solutions et des offres ;

- Solides compétences en communication et en négociation, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec des équipes multifonctionnelles ;

- Résilience, rigueur et force de travail ;

- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, tout en étant un contributeur efficace au sein d'une équipe interfonctionnelle.

A propos de nous :

The LA will work with both internal and external teams, including Vendor Tele Renewal specialists (VT RS), Microsoft Field Representatives (Commercial Executives (CE), Microsoft Channel Partners (LSP) and Operational resources.

The Role of the Licensing Associate (LA) is to provide LICENSING CONSULTANCY & DEAL CONSTRUCT SUPPORT for selected Commercial Volume licensing programs (as indicated by Microsoft) including but not limited to: Enterprise Agreements (EA, EAS, SCE), Open program (OLP, OV, OVS) Microsoft Products and Services Agreement (MPSA) New Commerce agreement (CSP, MCA-E). OSPA (China)

Collaborating with the Vendor Renewal Specialist (RS) & the Deal Acceleration Manager (DAS), the LA charter is to secure the customers renewal agreement on time, identifying up sell and cross sell opportunities aligned to the customer needs. It is also to sell new customers agreements based on demand triggers.
This is done by working with the Renewal Specialist to:
Know the customer’s business & licensing scenario. Know the customer’s stakeholders & timelines. Identify the potential up-sell and cross-sell scenarios for that customer. Prepare the value proposition for these scenarios with the RS. Leverage Microsoft resources such as Deal books and Solution assessment workshop. Gather what the customer wants to achieve as business outcomes now and in future. Migrate customers to other Microsoft programs where possible, Ensure that customers are delighted by Microsoft products and services.

- Support Microsoft Cloud and Licensing deals for the designated Territory/region.

- Work with RS/DAS to provide the best licensing solution for the customer and how to execute this aligned to Microsoft’s strategy & policy’s

- Deal book preparation.

- Works with partners and sub stakeholders to understand the sales hurdles being encountered during deal conversations - escalate as appropriate and assist in developing the needed innovations to smooth the sales cycle.

- Understand our competitors cloud licensing strategies, help our account teams position the benefits of the Microsoft cloud solution to customers and support Cloud compete offers including Customer/Channel Price Sheets (CPS) and any applicable concessions via an amendment.

- The LA will work to ensure secure all necessary pre-approvals from the authorized Microsoft stakeholder.

- The LA will co-ordinate any necessary approvals by Microsoft in required Microsoft tools for the customer agreement (new or renewal).

- The LA will ensure adherence to Microsoft policy’s and procedures.

- The LA will ensure a quality driven service, including continuous learning and identifying areas for process improvement.

Experience/Knowledge:
- 2+ years of experience working in Microsoft licensing contracts negotiations and deal construct
- In-depth understanding of Microsoft Commercial VL licensing programs particularly EA, MPSA, MCA & CSP
- Knowledge and experience of Microsoft or other Cloud and Online Services solutions
- Excellent communication and analytical skills with the ability to distill complex thoughts and strategies into simple, actionable recommendation.
- Experienced in establishing trusted advisor/strategic consultant relationships with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.​
- Able to help customers make the best choices in tough macroeconomic environments

Preferred qualifications:
- 4-year degree preferred
- 2-3+ years Licensing experience with a proven track record of success preferred
- Experience working with or selling Office 365, M365, Azure, Modern work, Biz apps preferred

jobs.title: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation & Variable Pay Lead
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking a  SuccessFactors Compensation & Variable Pay Lead  to drive the design, configuration, and delivery of compensation and variable pay solutions within a complex, global enterprise operating across multiple business clusters, legal entities, and joint ventures.
The role will lead the end-to-end delivery of SAP SuccessFactors Compensation and Variable Pay modules across multiple instances, ensuring alignment with global compensation strategies, local regulatory requirements, and evolving business needs.

Key Responsibilities
1. Compensation & Variable Pay Solution Design
- Lead the design and configuration of SAP SuccessFactors Compensation and Variable Pay modules across multiple instances.

- Define global compensation templates, plans, and workflows while accommodating regional and legal entity variations including documented region-specific plan variations (proration logic, payout calendars, plan suspension/redesign scenarios).

- Translate compensation strategy and business rules into scalable, configurable solutions.

- Design and implement salary planning, bonus programs, and merit-based pay structures; assess and document SF capability boundaries for executive compensation, and define integration/handoff requirements for external vendors.

2. Multi-Instance Strategy & Harmonization
- Drive compensation solution harmonization across multiple SAP SF instances.

- Identify opportunities for standardization of compensation plans, guidelines, and eligibility rules across clusters.

- Establish governance standards for configuration management, testing, and release cycles.

3. Variable Pay & Incentive Program Delivery
- Design and deliver variable pay programs including annual bonuses, sales incentives, spot awards, and performance-linked payouts

- Configure eligibility rules, proration logic, funding models, and payout calculations

- Ensure alignment between variable pay design and business performance frameworks, including configuration of integration with Performance & Goals Management to consume calibration outputs in variable pay worksheets

4. Integration & Data Architecture
Define integration requirements between Compensation/Variable Pay and:
- Employee Central (job, org, pay data)

- Performance Management (ratings, calibration outputs)

- Payroll and finance systems

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and auditability across compensation flows

- Support data migration and conversion activities for compensation-related data

5. Compliance, Governance & Reporting
- Ensure compensation solutions comply with local labor laws, pay equity regulations, and internal policies

- Design and deliver compensation analytics including SAP SuccessFactors Reports (SAP-delivered suite), executive dashboards, and ad hoc reporting.

- Support audit readiness through proper documentation and controls

6. Stakeholder Management & Team Leadership
- Partner with HR, Total Rewards, Finance, and IT stakeholders across regions

- Lead and mentor a team of functional consultants and analysts

- Drive workshops, requirement gathering, and solution walkthroughs with business and technical teams

- Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for all compensation and variable pay related decisions

7. Business Value Realization
Align solution design to core business outcomes:
- Improved accuracy and efficiency in compensation cycles

- Reduced manual effort and processing time

- Enhanced data quality to support pay equity and analytics

- Improved employee and manager experience during compensation events

Establish KPIs and value tracking mechanisms

Key Requirements

Experience

- 8+ years in HR technology with   deep expertise in SAP SuccessFactors Compensation and Variable Pay

- Proven experience as a   Compensation Lead or Senior Consultant   on large-scale, global HR transformation programs

- Experience handling:

- Multi-instance SAP SF compensation landscapes

- Global organizations with multiple legal entities, pay structures, and currencies

- End-to-end compensation cycle delivery (planning, approval, payout)

Functional & Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

- SAP SuccessFactors Compensation, Variable Pay, and related modules

- Compensation plan design, budgeting, guidelines, and eligibility rules

- Pay equity, market benchmarking, and total rewards frameworks

Experience with:

- Integration with Employee Central, Performance Management, and Payroll

- Compensation data migration and conversion

- Compensation reporting and analytics (Story Reports, Ad Hoc Reports)

Transformation & Innovation

Strong understanding of:

- Compensation trends including pay transparency and pay equity

- Application of AI / GenAI in compensation analytics and decision support

- Automation of compensation workflows and approval processes

Leadership & Consulting Skills

Ability to:

- Lead cross-functional teams and manage delivery across multiple workstreams

- Translate complex compensation business rules into system configurations

- Influence senior stakeholders including Total Rewards and HR leadership

- Manage competing priorities across clusters and geographies

Required   Qualifications

- SAP   SuccessFactors   Compensation and/or Variable Pay certification   are   required.

- Working knowledge of   Performance & Goals Management (PMGM) and payroll integration   principles, given the direct dependencies between compensation cycles, performance outcomes, and payroll execution

- Experience with   global pay structures, multi-currency compensation, and cross-border compliance .

- Exposure to   Total Rewards strategy, executive compensation, or incentive plan design .

- Experience in   highly regulated or complex global industries .

jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will apply strong analytical skills, problem-solving, and business judgment to deliver sourcing activities and contribute to measurable client outcomes.

In this role, you will support sourcing strategies, execute sourcing events, and conduct supplier and market analyses. You will also champion the practical application of AI and digital tools to accelerate workflows, enhance reporting, and ensure quality of deliverables.

As a collaborative contributor, you will work with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, while developing your own expertise through continuous learning, coaching, and applied experience.

Key Responsibilities / The Work
• Lead or support (depending on complexity) sourcing initiatives across the S2C lifecycle, including supplier outreach, RFx support, negotiations, award recommendations, and contract preparation.
• Leverage industry and supplier research, and market intelligence to perform financial and commercial analysis to support negotiation strategies, identify savings opportunities, and highlight risks.
• Assist in development of market insights and collaborate to create content that enables knowledge sharing across the organization and contributes to thought leadership.
• Support creation of category strategy in partnership with more senior resources with identified opportunities that achieve client goals and mature their procurement function.
• Apply AI and digital tools (enterprise-approved assistants, GenAI platforms) to sourcing tasks such as RFx drafting, spend classification, contract clause review, and data summarization, ensuring outputs are validated and compliant.
• Willingness to travel up to 50% to multiple customer locations.
Qualifications (remaining):
• Market & Analytical Skills: Strong numeric and text-based analysis; ability to evaluate supplier proposals, contracts, and pricing.
• Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Ability to build supplier and stakeholder trust; effective communicator across remote and in-person environments.
• Project Management: Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams; adapts effectively to complex organizational structures and matrixed environments.
• Behaviors: Strong critical thinker, self-starter, adaptable problem-solver; passionate about continuous self-learning and professional growth.
• Communication & Storytelling: Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to prepare structured deliverables and tailor messaging for diverse audiences, including executives.
• Tools & Platforms: Proficiency in procurement platforms, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

Join Accenture’s in-house Leadership Recruitment team and shape how we identify and engage Managing Director and Partner-level talent across Asia Pacific. This is a strategic sourcing leadership role for someone who combines executive presence, market insight and disciplined search execution with the initiative to get beyond desktop research and into the market.

THE ROLE
You will work across Australia & New Zealand, South-East Asia, Greater China and Japan, partnering with Executive Recruiters and senior business leaders to translate growth priorities into executive sourcing strategies. You will lead briefing discussions, challenge assumptions and provide informed market insight on talent availability, competitor dynamics and candidate motivations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
• Senior stakeholders view you as a credible, well-prepared advisor who improves search strategy and decision quality.
• You consistently uncover high-calibre, diverse and previously untapped executive talent through direct market engagement and strong networks.

Ultimately you contribute meaningful results through directly sourcing leadership candidates who develop successful careers at Accenture

• Demonstrated experience in executive sourcing, executive search or senior leadership recruitment, ideally across Asia Pacific.

• Ability to translate research into insight and influence stakeholders through a credible market point of view.
• A proactive, externally oriented sourcing style built on personal networking, referrals and creative talent origination.
• Knowledge of executive talent markets across technology and consulting.
• Strong communication skills, including executive updates, candidate assessments and market presentations.
• Commercial acumen, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguity within a complex global organisation.
• Exceptional discretion, stakeholder management, project management and attention to detail.
• Experience with search platforms, professional networks and applicant tracking systems. WorkDay experience is advantageous.

EXPERIENCE
- Minimum 5 years experience delivering executive sourcing or leadership recruitment assignments, including direct engagement with senior candidates and hiring leaders.

- Experience in an executive search firm, a specialist search environment or an in-house executive recruiting team, with exposure to technology or consulting markets across APAC.

Depending on the role, Business Process Services professionals may be based at a client’s office or in one of Accenture’s 50 delivery centers around the world.

In this capacity, you will work directly with an Accenture customer/s with responsibility for delivering category management services including, but not limited to, strategic sourcing, client stakeholder management, supplier performance management, and continuous cost and performance improvement. Additionally, you will develop and provide oversight for the execution of multiple Industrial sourcing strategies that support each customer’s business goals while achieving optimal pricing, quality and service levels.

- Develop broad network of strong client stakeholder relationships, particularly in Engineering and Maintenance teams, to facilitate delivery of services and achievement of contractual requirements (savings targets, SLAs)

- Provide oversight and program management to ensure efficient delivery of a portfolio of strategic sourcing projects
- Work collaboratively with suppliers and customer stakeholders to identify and execute continuous cost and performance improvement strategies
- Identify and resolve strategic supplier performance issues to ensure customer satisfaction
- Measure and manage suppliers/service providers’ performance relative to contracted service levels.
- Conduct/ leverage supply-market research to develop and share market insights with clients and within Accenture

- Further advance program and senior client relationship management skills

jobs.title: Sourcing and Procurement Data & AI Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

We are:
Sourcing & Procurement, and we move fast, think fast, and work fast. Our clients need big-picture change, so we come at their challenges from all sides with functional insights, data power, digital leadership, and extensive industry know-how. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in cost-out, strategic category management, and procurement operations.

You are:
A Sourcing and Procurement professional who helps clients develop strategies and operating models to advance procurement capabilities and drive bottom-line financial impact. You use your data skills to develop and implement strategies that improve the value and performance delivered by clients’ supply base, while establishing strategic procurement category plans and processes to sustain long-term value. You’ve also got the communication skills to make sure that everyone understands your ideas and how to get them working as quickly as possible. Your experience means that people look to you for guidance and ideas. And you know how to make sure teams get their work done on time, every time.

The Work:
This is not a consulting role. It is not a project delivery role. It is not a research position. A Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to make complex AI platforms work in real, messy organizational environments. You own outcomes: time-to-value, adoption, reliability, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.

The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated: AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role.

Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry. Within the Sourcing & Procurement practice, this means tackling the full spectrum of enterprise procurement transformation — from strategic category management and supplier risk to autonomous sourcing agents and AI-driven spend analytics — at scale.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead enterprise AI platform deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments — Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir — owning the full programme from architecture through adoption, including Sourcing & Procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, or Jaggaer

- Own programme-level delivery outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability across multiple concurrent workstreams, with commercial metrics attached

- Lead rapid experimentation at pace: drive ambiguous business problems to working production systems in days or weeks across complex enterprise environments

- Architect and govern enterprise AI solutions across the full technology stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and multi-system workflow integration at programme scale

- Shape AI reinvention strategy for client CTO, CFO, and CISO: build value architecture, ROI backlogs, use case prioritisation frameworks, and multi-year AI adoption roadmaps; engage CPOs and Chief Procurement Officers on AI-enabled procurement transformation strategies, connecting cost-out objectives to scalable AI architectures

- Define and publish reusable reinvention blueprints, patterns, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the FDE practice

- Lead architecture design sessions, executive workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and C-suite leadership teams

- Codify delivery learnings, failure patterns, and engineering standards that shape the FDE practice and enable the next generation of forward deployed engineers

- Design and deploy AI-powered procurement solutions including autonomous sourcing agents, intelligent supplier risk monitoring, predictive spend analytics, and contract lifecycle automation within enterprise environments

- Translate S&P functional requirements — strategic sourcing, category management, procure-to-pay, supplier performance — into scalable AI architectures and production-ready agentic workflows

Travel Requirements:
Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here's what you need:
- Minimum 8 years of engineering experience with cloud-native systems, including APIs, microservices, containerization, and serverless architectures

- Minimum of 1 year of experience designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments

- Minimum of 3 years of deep expertise with AI platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, or open-source models), including building abstraction layers for multi-provider pipelines

- Minimum of 8 years of experience leading software engineering teams, including delivery oversight, resource allocation, and professional development of direct reports

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points if:
- Demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership in a client-embedded environment

- Experience leading enterprise AI deployments across multi-stakeholder environments

- Experience managing and developing engineering teams, including performance management and development planning

- Experience working with enterprise AI platforms such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir

- Experience defining enterprise AI architecture across identity, data, security, governance, and multi-system integrations

- Experience working directly with senior stakeholders (CTO, CFO, CISO) on AI strategy and investment decisions

- Experience leading executive workshops, architecture design sessions, or cross-functional technical engagements

- Experience working within or deploying AI solutions for Sourcing & Procurement functions, including familiarity with strategic sourcing, category management, procure-to-pay processes, or supplier management platforms

- Familiarity with S&P technology ecosystems (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, or equivalent) and the data and integration patterns common to procurement environments

- Experience in the High Tech industry, including semiconductors, software, hardware, or electronics manufacturing — with an understanding of complex global supply chains, component sourcing, contract manufacturing, and the speed-to-market pressures unique to High Tech procurement and supply chain environments.

jobs.description:
The Senior Partner Manager is a strategic, revenue-driving role responsible for   acquiring   and onboarding net-new business, while developing long-term relationships with a portfolio of Indie Agencies. This role combines full-cycle sales, account   strategy   and digital marketing   expertise   to drive revenue growth and partner success.

Senior Partner Managers act as trusted advisors, working directly with agencies to   identify   opportunities and close deals for new business. The Senior Partner Manager   leverages   digital advertising   expertise   to navigate complex sales cycles and agency relationships. They collaborate cross-functionally to deliver measurable results. Agency engagement, networking, and building strong relationships across multiple key decision makers will be central to   day ‑ to ‑ day   responsibilities, and the role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking, data-driven execution, and stakeholder management across complex business structures.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct sales conversations with agencies, focused on activating accounts and working to grow depth of active accounts in agency portfolios.

- Develop and implement full-funnel sales strategies for net-new business, activating new clients and   facilitating   platform onboarding.

- Manage and grow digital marketing agency relationships,   leveraging   Learning Sessions, Media Plans, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), to drive revenue, retention, and market share expansion.

- Maintain a strong understanding of agency client portfolios, planning cycles, and business priorities to unlock incremental growth.

- Collaborate with agency leadership to align on strategy, product adoption, and mutual success metrics.

- Lead complex, consultative conversations with senior   decision ‑ makers , uncovering business   objectives   and positioning tailored digital advertising solutions to address partner challenges.

- Build and manage a pipeline of high-impact agency partners, owning relationships from prospecting through onboarding and ensuring a smooth handoff to Account Managers.

- Deliver on monthly and quarterly revenue KPIs and agreed performance objectives

- Maintain   accurate   pipeline, account activity, and forecasting in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).

- Maintain core sales capabilities, including objection handling, active listening, and   value ‑ based   communication.

- Consistently meet or exceed individual and team KPIs while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

- 2 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Sales, and/or Account Management, with exposure to full-cycle sales or ongoing account ownership.

Preferred Qualifications

- Proven experience managing client or partner relationships in fast paced, performance-driven environments.

- Strong consultative selling skills, including discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.

- Ability to manage priorities,   maintain   pipeline discipline, and execute against revenue goals.

- Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, SaaS, or media platforms.

- Experience working with agency partners.

- Hands ‑ on   experience using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) for pipeline, account management, and forecasting.

- Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills for executive-level audiences.

- Familiarity with digital media buying, attribution, and marketing funnel concepts.

- Ability to   operate   both strategically and tactically in dynamic, growth-oriented environments.

- Bachelor’s degree.

jobs.description:
Principales Responsabilidades
•    Construir y gestionar un pipeline de cuentas estratégicas de ecommerce, actuando como el principal punto de contacto desde la prospección hasta el lanzamiento de la primera campaña en la plataforma.
•    Comprender en profundidad los desafíos, objetivos y estrategias digitales de cada cliente, ofreciendo una consultoría personalizada en todas las etapas de la venta.

•    Mínimo 1.5 años de experiencia sólida en ventas consultivas y complejas, con perfil hunter, liderando todo el ciclo (prospección, abordaje, negociación y cierre).

•    Capacidad de organizar el pipeline, seguir procesos y actuar de manera disciplinada para garantizar resultados.

•    Experiencia con clientes de e-commerce o soluciones de medios digitales.
•    Experiencia trabajando con Agencias de Marketing.
•    Historial consistente en apertura y cierre de cuentas estratégicas .
•    Facilidad para presentaciones y reuniones con decisores (remoto y presencial).
•    Perfil analítico para evaluar oportunidades y resultados.

Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations.  We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human + AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI & Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

You are:
An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

The Learning & Development Partner designs and delivers role-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope. This role builds the training curriculum, coordinates delivery alongside each AI release, and measures learning effectiveness to ensure the organization is ready to operate in new ways.

The work:
- Design and deliver role-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope
- Build the training curriculum and coordinate delivery alongside each new technology and AI agent release
- Translate process and role redesigns into practical, accessible learning content for functional audiences
- Measure training effectiveness and learner adoption — adjust curriculum based on feedback and adoption data
- Collaborate with the Workforce Design Lead and change management team to align training with the overall change plan.
- Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

- Instructional design, curriculum development, or enterprise learning in a consulting or corporate environment
- Designing role-based training programs for technology or process transformation programs
- Experience with digital training delivery platforms and learning management systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or equivalent)
- Ability to translate technical process and role changes into practical, accessible learning content for non-technical audiences
- Experience measuring training effectiveness with data-driven curriculum refinement

- ATD, CPTD, or equivalent instructional design certification
- Experience using AI-generated content tools to accelerate training curriculum development and personalization
- Background in Life Sciences regulatory or compliance training design
- Familiarity with AI-enabled learning platforms and adaptive learning technologies
- Experience coordinating training delivery across multiple simultaneous technology releases

jobs.title: Organization Design Consultant (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wie müssen Unternehmen aufgebaut sein, damit sie Ihre Strategien umsetzen und im Wettbewerb den entscheidenden Vorteil erreichen können? Mit welchen Maßnahmen können Unternehmen den Spagat zwischen globaler Effizienz und lokaler Agilität meistern? Und wie können Unternehmen neue Wachstumsfelder erschließen und dabei nachhaltig und verantwortlich handeln?

Diese und viele weitere Fragestellungen erwarten Dich in unserem europäischen Team mit welchem Du die Transformationen vom globalen Großkonzern bis zum disruptiven Start-up aktiv mitgestaltest. Interessiert? Dann denke mit uns Organisationen neu!

Deine Mission
Als Organization Design Consultant arbeitest Du auf Vorstandsebene und berätst unsere Kunden wie sie Ihre Organisation transformieren können, um ihr Unternehmen zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Hierbei beräts du unsere Kunden bei:
Enterprise, Function & Shared Service Design: Oft erfordert eine neue Geschäftsstrategie eine umfassende Reorganisation des Unternehmens. Wir beraten unsere Kunden, wie sie ihr Operating Model, besteht aus Organisation, Governance, Prozessen, Incentives, Workforce und Kultur, anpassen müssen, um langfristig erfolgreich zu sein. Dabei kann es um das gesamte Unternehmen oder einzelne Fachbereiche wie Innovation oder Finance gehen. In diesem Kontext spielen Shared Services bei vielen unserer Kunden eine zentrale Rolle, da sie die Möglichkeit bieten, Prozesse zu zentralisieren und so über verschiedene Bereiche hinweg signifikante Effizienzgewinne zu erzielen.
Organisation Optimization & Activation : Darüber hinaus beraten wir unsere Kunden, wie sie durch Wachstumsprogramme oder Kostensenkungsmaßnahmen ihre Organisation optimieren und innovieren können, um Komplexität zu reduzieren, Redundanzen zu vermeiden und Abläufe effizienter zu gestalten. Sobald die strategischen Konzepte definiert sind, begleiten wir sie bei der Umsetzung und unterstützen sie in zentralen Fragen der Implementierung, wie der Kommunikation einer Transformation, der Rolle des Leaderships, der Erfolgsmessung und den erforderlichen Trainingsmaßnahmen für Mitarbeiter.

Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Das erwartet dich
- Ein internationales Team : Als Teil von Accenture Strategy bist Du Teil eines europäischen Teams mit international führenden Expert:innen aus allen Branchen und Funktionen.

- Unterschiedliche Industrien:  Durch unseren methodischen Fokus hast Du die Möglichkeit unterschiedliche Industrien kennenzulernen - von Automobilherstellern über Energieproduzenten bis zu Technologie Start-ups ist alles vertreten.

- Vielfältige Aufgabenbereiche:  Durch die breite Perspektive unserer Projekte erwartet Dich ebenfalls ein vielfältiges Aufgabenspektrum, welches eine steile Lernkurve garantiert. Du beschäftigst Dich sowohl mit tiefgehenden qualitativen Organisationsfragen und unterstützt zur gleichzeitig bei quantitativen Analysen und Benchmarking, z.B. für Mitarbeiterkosten oder Teamgrößen.

Darauf freuen wir uns
- Du hast Dein Master Studium überdurchschnittlich gut abgeschlossen – idealerweise mit Fokus BWL oder VWL, oder alternativ im MINT-Bereich

- 2+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Strategie- oder Unternehmensberatung bzw. in einer strategischen Funktion innerhalb eines Industrieunternehmens mit Schwerpunkt auf Themen wie Organization Strategy & Design, Corporate Development, Shared Services oder Operating Model Transformation (Optimization)

- Du zeichnest Dich durch ein strukturiertes Vorgehen und konzeptionelles Denken aus und kannst aus Analysen konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten

- Du verlierst auch in komplizierten Situationen nicht den Kopf und motivierst Dein Umfeld durch eine „can-do“ attitude

- Du sprichst mindestens sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch

Was wir dir bieten
- Individuelles Arbeitszeitmodell mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

- Hybrides Arbeiten – Beim Kunden vor Ort, an einem Accenture Standort oder zuhause

- Umfangreiche Angebote für Fort- und Weiterbildung

- Attraktive Aufstiegschancen

- Eine Arbeitskultur, die Diversität und Inklusion fördert

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied
Deine Fähigkeiten, Dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen Dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe Dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die Dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu Dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an Deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie Du Dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei Dir. Es ist Deine Karriere. Wir helfen Dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie Du es Dir vorstellst.

jobs.title: Manager Operating Model & Organization Design (F/H) (Open)
jobs.description:
Job Description
Vous souhaitez façonner les organisations de demain ? Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement organisationnel ? Vous avez envie de conseiller les comités exécutifs d'entreprises nationales et internationales, et de mener à bien des réorganisations globales ?
Rejoignez-nous pour repenser les entreprises et leurs structures organisationnelles, et contribuer aux transformations majeures aussi bien de Groupes mondiaux que de start-ups disruptives !

Votre mission
En tant que « Manager Operating Model & Organization Design » , vous travaillerez avec les comités exécutifs (C-suite) et conseillerez nos clients sur la manière de se transformer. Vous mettrez à profit votre expérience en projets de transformation afin d’aider à résoudre des problèmes de grande envergure ayant un impact à long terme, tout en guidant et en inspirant les équipes projets. Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur nos 4 différents piliers :

Design d’Operating Models à l’échelle d’une entreprise : Souvent déclenché par une nouvelle stratégie ou un nouveau modèle d'entreprise, ce pilier implique le réalignement des Business Units individuelles ou de l'ensemble de l’Operating Model. Nous conseillons nos clients sur les « capabilities » distinctives de la future organisation, les nouveaux rôles d’entreprise et le rôle du central, la structure leadership requise, ainsi que sur la manière dont les différentes Business Units peuvent être intégrées les unes aux autres.

Design de fonctions et de services partagés : Nous concevons des Operating Models fonctionnels en étroite collaboration avec les comités exécutifs et les patrons de fonctions (ex : RH, Finance, Achats, R&D…). Nous alignons les fonctions afin de répondre à de nouvelles stratégies de croissance et de coûts, et nous nous assurons de les relier plus étroitement à la stratégie globale. Pour ce faire nous définissons les « capabilities » requises, les modèles de prestation de services et adressons la question des processus et de la gouvernance. Nous conseillons nos clients sur la manière de mettre en place ou de développer leurs organisations de services partagés afin d'accroître leur compétitivité tout en favorisant la digitalisation et la standardisation.

Optimisation et innovation d’Operating Models existants : Comment réduire la complexité des entreprises, les redondances dans les équipes et les activités, et rendre les processus plus efficaces ? Ensemble, nous conseillons nos clients sur la manière d'accroître leur efficacité organisationnelle, sur le rôle que jouent les données et l'analyse dans ce domaine et sur la manière d’atteindre leur niveau de performance cible en s’appuyant sur des benchmarks quantitatifs.

Activation des Operating Models : Outre le design, vous accompagnerez la mise en œuvre de nouveaux Operating Models en équipe et conseillerez nos clients sur les questions centrales de la mise en œuvre : Comment et quand une transformation globale doit-elle être communiquée et quel est le rôle du leadership à cet égard ? Comment mesurer l'avancement et le succès de la mise en œuvre et quelles sont les mesures de formation nécessaires pour les employés

Ce que nous recherchons
- 5+ ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou en management ou à un poste stratégique au sein d'une entreprise industrielle, avec une spécialisation dans des domaines tels que la stratégie et le design d’organisation, le développement de l'entreprise, les services partagés, la transformation d’Operating Model (optimisation) ou la stratégie et le développement des talents.
- Un diplôme universitaire ou grandes écoles, idéalement dans les domaines de l'économie, de la psychologie, des STIM ou dans un domaine comparable (un MBA ou un doctorat est un avantage).
- De très bonnes capacités d'analyse et de communication, assurance face à des membres de comités exécutifs, et capacité à transmettre des questions complexes à l'oral et à l'écrit dans un très bon français et anglais.
- Une compréhension approfondie des méthodes de gestion de projet, leur adaptation aux besoins clients ainsi qu'un savoir-faire démontré dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de concepts stratégiques, y compris des sujets liés à la technologie et à la digitalisation.
- Un intérêt pour les sujets liés à la technologie et à la digitalisation, plaisir à mener des projets dans un environnement national et international, ainsi que la flexibilité et la mobilité nécessaires dans le cadre des activités de conseil quotidiennes.
- Une attitude "can-do" qui vous permet de garder le cap dans les situations compliquées et de motiver votre entourage.
- Excellente maîtrise des langues Anglais et Français

- Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution while business priorities and learning needs evolve.
- Set up the project by defining the required processes, team structure, and ways of working; create and manage workplans to mitigate risks; establish collaborative working relationships; and support successful project execution.
- Manage and mentor a team of instructional designers and media/technology designers across different locations and provide guidance for developing instructionally sound, creative and high-quality solutions with high-impact outcomes.
- Manage ecosystem partners for addressing learning needs, as needed.
- Manage budget, scope, timelines and effort needed to design and develop varied learning solutions across multiple programs; and align with internal and external stakeholders to manage and fulfill business expectations and commitments.

- A diverse and socially active workforce

- Flexible working hours and opportunity to work from home

- Prior experience implementing Workday HCM / Compensation / Advanced Compensation / Benefits or relevant on-premise or cloud-based platforms

- Ability to meet client travel requirements as needed and efficiently manage a team(s) and client interactions

- Thrive in a diverse, dynamic environment, meet deadlines despite conflicting demands, analytical thinking and problem solving skills

- Excellent communication skills in English and German, both verbal and written, and can clearly articulate complex messages and requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, Fluency in English and German

Set yourself apart:
- Strong HR background with experience working in the Workday platform, either as a consultant or in a client role owning and driving the Workday HCM and (Advanced) Compensation and Benefits workstreams

- Up to date Workday certifications

jobs.title: Global Compensation Senior Manager – EU Pay Transparency
jobs.description:
Global Compensation Senior Manager – EU Pay Transparency
As a Compensation Senior Manager, you will lead global compensation strategies as part of a team responsible for designing, building, and communicating rewards policies, processes, and programs that deliver our long-term HR strategy. This role is pivotal in managing Accenture's global Compensation philosophy and processes, ensuring a consistent and equitable experience for our people worldwide, with a primary focus on EU Pay Transparency, pay equity, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

EU Pay Transparency & Pay Equity
- Lead the design, implementation, and governance of Total Rewards programs, with a focus on pay equity, regulatory compliance, and EU Pay Transparency directives.

- Drive compliance monitoring and pay equity analysis, ensuring adherence to evolving EU pay transparency requirements across all applicable markets.

- Partner with HR, Legal, and business leaders to enhance pay equity frameworks and continuously improve compensation technology and EU Pay Transparency practices.

Compensation Strategy & Advisory
- Provide compensation subject matter expertise to stakeholders and advise senior leadership on best practices for total rewards in talent attraction and retention.

- Oversee market intelligence and compensation analytics to evaluate competitive positioning, identify pay trends, and generate data-driven insights that inform Total Rewards strategy and decision-making.

- Lead process optimization initiatives leveraging technology, automation, and analytics to enhance compensation operations and reporting.

Team Leadership & Collaboration
- Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team responsible for day-to-day compensation processes, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and solution-oriented culture.

- Inspire and motivate team members by modeling a positive, accountable attitude, championing open communication, mutual respect, and shared ownership of results.

- Build strong cross-functional relationships with HR, Finance, Legal, and business partners to align compensation programs with organizational goals and people strategy.

Qualifications & Experience Required
- 8+ years of direct compensation experience, including expertise in total rewards, market intelligence, and global compensation strategy.

- Demonstrated experience in pay equity analysis, compliance monitoring, and EU Pay Transparency initiatives.

- Proven leadership skills with experience managing and developing compensation teams in a dynamic, international environment.

- Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across functions and influence without authority.

- Excellent analytical, project management, and communication skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership and handle highly confidential data with discretion.

- Ability to adapt quickly, work at a dynamic pace, and navigate tight timelines and critical deliverables.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI; experience with data analytics and market intelligence platforms.

- Proficient in written and oral English.

- Experience with Workday HRIS Preferred.

- Familiarity with real-time data sources and compensation benchmarking platforms.
